35488866:
Jordi's apartment is in an amazing neighborhood called Gracia. It is less than 3 minutes walk from probably the only metro line you will use in Barcelona as well as many bus stops. There are plazas around every corner with endless restaurant options. I would without a doubt recommend Jordi's apartment to you and I hope you will consider staying here.
Jordi couldn't meet us upon check in as he had business elsewhere but everything was communicated step by step exactly how to get into the apartment. It's on the first floor but an elevator is available in case you have large suitcases. The apartment also has a washing machine which was just what we needed to get a few things washed and dried for the rest of our European holiday.
Overall, our stay was a 10/10 and I'd like to thank Jordi for being an excellent host in Barcelona.

We loved this little quaint apartment in the Gracia neighborhood. It was centrally located to a LOT of great restaurants, bars and public transportation. Upon arrival, we were promptly greeted for check in and was given lots of recommendations as well as a map of the city which was nice! Our only critique was that the blinds weren't working in the living room or bedroom when we arrived. The living room's blinds were stuck shut and the bedroom's blinds were stuck open - which was tough because the bedroom faces a highly trafficked street (mostly foot traffic) and is pretty low to the ground.... On day 2 my fiance was luckily able to fix the blinds in the bedroom, so we could at least close the blinds in the evening for some privacy but the living room blinds we could not fix. Despite the issue with the blinds, we loved the space!

Spent 3 nights here. Place was in a great location. The apartment was ready and clean for our arrival. We were early and Jordi and his house keeper worked hard to get us in earlier.
I have been to a several Airbnb's and I was disappointed that this place so different, as it was bare of amenities.
No brochures or maps of the city. Jordi did sent a picture of a map but unable to see even when enlarged.
No kitchen essentials like paper towels, napkins, foil paper or baggies of any kind. only 1 tea towel. No toaster.
As far as the bathroom we were only given 1 towel each and no face clothes. With no dryer there was no use washer as nothing dried and there was no soap for the washer anyway. The place was barren and from my past experiences this was a big disappointment.
1110775765657684157:
Our three person group stayed here for 2 nights. Overall we enjoyed our stay, sharing our thoughts below.
Pros: apartment matched the images, bigger than it appears, very safe/secure building, helpful staff w/ extra household supplies available downstairs, offered to store our luggage, comfortable beds, A/C, ironing board + washer, 2 cafes within ~2 minute walk, train very close, & walkable neighborhood.
Cons: building smelt incredibly strong of cleaning supplies, the bedroom closest to the street hears a lot of the outside activity (if you’re not a super light sleeper you’ll be okay), not many local eats immediately nearby, front desk was very kind but didn’t have recommendations to share after offering to provide, & when we booked it was listed as a 11am check out but the check out time changed during our stay. The front desk closes at 10pm so any requests/inquires can’t be processed.
Airbnb Recs: adding additional pillows, hand soap + paper towels to the kitchen, & toilet paper

The apartment was fantastic—modern, upscale, and just a four-minute walk from the Lesseps metro station. With all the major attractions only a few metro stops away, the location was absolutely perfect. We loved that there were plenty of cafes, bars, restaurants, and supermarkets within walking distance, making it incredibly convenient for everyday needs.
A heads-up for those coming from the U.S.: be mindful of your hot water usage. The water can run out quickly, especially after multiple showers. On our first day, after the kids showered, we ended up taking cold showers! After chatting with the front desk, we adjusted our shower times, and everything worked out fine from then on.
Aside from that, the apartment and neighborhood were quiet at night and the beds were very comfortable, ensuring we got a good night’s rest. A nice touch was the cleaning kit provided in the apartment, and extra supplies were available at the front desk which was super helpful. I highly recommend this place.

We stayed 10 nights as a family of three in a very clean two-bedroom apartment on the third floor. The AC worked great, the kitchen had quality appliances, and the washing machine was spotless and easy to use. The building felt safe and professionally managed, with kind staff and a reliable elevator. The location was excellent — close to shops, cafés, and transit — and our back unit was peaceful with no street noise.
Midway through our stay, guests moved in above us and were quite loud, dragging furniture and talking late at night. The building responded quickly, which helped somewhat, but noise from above carried through and we were still woken up a few times. The front doors for other units also slam loudly as people come and go. My daughter used a white-noise machine, which helped her sleep, and I think future guests might benefit from one too. The kitchen could use more dishes, tea towels, and paper towels. Overall, a great stay — I’d return but request a top-floor unit next time
34191394:
Fantastic place, and even better service! A beautiful, pristine, contemporary apartment fitted to very high standards and with all of the amenities and comforts you could want for a short or long stay - very clean and modern. Great area too. Central location (only 2 metro stops from Placa Catalunya), and a generally peaceful, pleasant local neighbourhood with many great little restaurants and bars hidden away along the surrounding small streets - you get a good feel for life as a local here. Despite the main street outside being a bit busy at times, in the bedrooms (which face the interior terrace) it is totally quiet. Fantastic terrace and pool too, however, be aware that as it is located in an interior space between low-rise apartment building, for our stay (early August) there was only direct sunlight between about 1030 and 1600.
The hospitality and service of EnjoyBCN was also superb. They were extremely quick, polite, helpful and accommodating, and despite making a very last minute reservation, we were able to check in only about an hour after sending the request. There was a minor maintenance issue during our stay, and within 30 minutes of messaging there was already a staff member at the apartment to check it out. Also very accommodating for my specific checkout request, and afterwards were kind to let me leave my bag at their main office while I enjoyed a final afternoon in the city - and were very helpful in providing some great recommendations of things to do. So kind and professional, already looking forward to my next stay!

Es un edificio moderno y nuevo. Ubicado en el maravilloso barrio de Gracia. Parada de bus en frente que te lleva al centro. Y también los ferrocarriles.
Nuestro apartamento tenía dos habitaciones espaciosas y limpias. Una con cama de matrimonio (tv en el dormitorio grande) y otra con dos camas, todas cómodas con sábanas limpias y muchas almohadas. Dos baños con ducha, uno muy grande. Dotado de toallas para todos, suaves y limpias. Jabón de manos y de ducha. Excelente limpieza y papel de baño.
La cocina y el salón van juntos, con un sofá cama que no utilizamos. Sofás cómodos y una TV Smart Tv. La cocina tiene de todo: cafetera de cápsulas y normal, tostadora, sandwichera, horno, vitro, calentador agua.. y todo el menaje. También lavavajillas y te dejan pastillas y jabón. Todo nuevo y bien colocado.
En el edificio hay un patio privado con piscina, tumbonas y zona de relax muy bien cuidado exclusivo para residentes.
Cerca del piso hay supermercado, mercados y lugares varios de comida.
Sin duda volveremos, atención impecable.

The apartment was spacious and clean. In the kitchen you can find nesspresso coffe machine, two toasters and tea kettle. It has everything you need for preparing your own meals. We got a welcome gift that included olive oil, salt, pepper and vinegar which is helpful if you want to prepare your meals, so you don't need to buy it. The apartment has 2 bathrooms which is great for bigger groups of people. My partner and I stayed there for 11 days and we got a free cleaning during our stay. Everyone from the agency is very kind and very helping. We've got some recommendations for the restaurants, public transport, attractions and everything we have asked for. They reply fast and speak great English. Online check in was easy and simple. There are curtins in the bedrooms so there is a complete dark if needed. The pool is small and mostly in the shade. We were there in late August / early September so it was a bit cold. In the garden you can find a shower, bathroom and shared laundry room.
19028982:
This was the loveliest place we have ever stayed. I know others have already said a lot of great things, and they are all true! Hopefully I can add some new things here as well.
We loved the furnishing of the apartment, although it was all new it felt so much like a home. There were plants and greenery in the vases, USB outlets by the bedside to charge your phone, everything you needed in the kitchen. A bowl for you room card and pocket items by the door. Even the books were nice - as well as books on the shelves in many languages there were good coffee table books of photos, perfect for relaxing. The sheets and linens were really comfortable also. I wish we could hire the interior designer to outfit our apartment at home!
There was delicious lemon bread and champagne waiting for us as well as free water, juice and milk in the fridge. Our daughter's birthday was while we were there and we were surprised to come home to balloons and cake with a candle! It made the whole thing so special for her.
Although it was December we're from Finland and enjoyed both the sauna and a swim after. Gorgeous views of the city from up there.
The place was immaculately clean - I know because I dropped the toothpaste cap and recovered it under the sink where there wasn't a speck of dust.
The staff at the desk made our stay extra nice - arranged taxis and let us know where to find great tapas. One day we needed a quick picnic lunch and they advised an excellent sandwich shop right nearby.
For exploring Barcelona the location was perfect for us - right between the Eixample and the Garcia let us easily walk to many of the things we wanted to see as well as Park Guell and the Gothic Quarter. 24 hour service at the desk and one entrance gave a lovely cozy feeling of security too, even being right in the heart of the city.
Can't recommend this place enough! We can't wait to go back next December!

My family of 6 enjoyed our week long stay at Casagrand. We stayed in the 4 bedroom apartment and it was perfect for us. There was more than enough space and the location was terrific. I feel the best way to do a review is to give good descriptions of everything. So, here goes.
1. Location - the location is excellent. It is within walking distance of most things in Barcelona. 20 minutes to Plaza Catalunya, 25-30 minutes to Sagrada Familia, and 25-30 minutes to Gothic Quarter. Really convenient. There are many restaurants and cafes near by to eat at and there is a a Mercadona Supermarket within a few blocks to buy all of your groceries. Further, the architecture in the buildings nearby is stunning.
2. The Apartment- the apartment checked every box. It was big and we were able to be together or spread out as each person needed during the trip. All the appliances are of high quality and there is more than enough pots, pans, dishes, glasses and cutlery. The showers were good and strong. And the beds and the bedding were very comfortable. Some nights we were hot and we kept the windows open. I am certain that there is air conditioning, but I don't think we ever figured out how to run it. So, with the windows open, there was some noise from the street and other guests of the building since some kids were being loud at night.
3. The Staff. We had an exceptional experience with the staff. The check in was smooth and they were very accommodating. The staff assisted us in getting covid tests for the trip home and made suggestions for other things we needed during the trip. The housekeeping was very thorough and unobtrusive. Bravo to the staff.
Overall it was a great stay and one that we would definitely repeat the next time we go to Barcelona.

We travel a lot and use many services such as Airbnb for our stays. Given all of this, I can't remember a stay where everything was so accurately and well represented in the listing. This place met or exceeded our every expectation. This rarely happens.
This place was fantastic for so many reasons:
1. The people: the front desk, the housekeeping, and everyone that works in the building were so helpful, friendly and went out of their way at every turn to make us feel welcome. Superlative.
2. Building and location: The building was gorgeous, clean, well maintained, and distinctive architecturally. The pool on the roof deck while small and shallow was set up in such a way that it was a vacation in itself to spend time on the deck with the deck chairs, umbrellas, outdoor shower and absolutely gorgeous views. The location, was perfect for us as it allowed us to walk to most major tourist destinations within 15-30 minutes but was outside the old town hustle and bustle (and touristy) nonsense. The neighborhood is very upscale with high-quality shops and restaurants everywhere.
3. Apartment: The apartment itself was decorated, furnished, and kept in A+++ condition. No junk. Everything thoughtfully placed. New modern appliances. Every bedroom was spacious and a winner. Truly a home away from home (or even better) with every amenity one could ask for. If our own home was only as nice...
Given all of this, I would highly recommend this place and it remains one of the few places that we would always come back to. A+
43235590:
Good things about the apartment:
- location (you can walk to the main attractions or you can take the metro, either way everything it’s pretty close)
- the building has video surveillance
- the apartment has everything you need to live there
What we personally didn’t like:
- The apartment is not that bright as presented in the pictures. We would actually use the lights inside even during the day because of how dark it was.
- The apartment had a smell of an old place. Especially the bedroom furniture.
- The apartment was very plain to us. There was no decor as in the pictures (like at all), just plain walls and furniture. It felt like the place has no soul. I guess it’s not a problem for everyone, but we do like cozy places.
- We knew the beds will be separate, but unfortunately they were uncomfortable too.
- It was too noisy. As I understood, this is an issue across all apartments in Barcelona, but we were hearing not only the noise from the street, but also from the neighbors from other apartments, which I think can be fixed or improved.
- The experience with the parking was not the best. I understand why we had to pay separately for the parking (cause it’s a private one). Still, it seemed strange to be charged additionally when the parking even has an entrance directly into the apartment’s building. The remote control wouldn’t work properly. When we checked in, we blocked the road because it wouldn’t open the gates. And when we checked out, we couldn’t exit the parking because the remote wouldn’t work again. We had to wait for another person to use their remote and open the gate.
The host was polite but responded very slowly.
In my opinion, the apartment is too expensive as to how it is right now. If the host will make some improvements, it will be a great place.

We stayed 3 nights at this apartment. The location is the best you could find: right in the heart of Gracia with many restaurants, bars etc. close by. The subway is just a 5-minute walk from the place.
Communication with the host company went well and the arrival instructions were very easy and self-explanatory.
As for the place itself, it was as shown in the pictures. The kitchen was very clean and modern and the rest of the apartment adequately furnished and equipped. The look of the apartment feels a bit impersonal which is probably because the entire block is rented and this apartment is not someone's home as such. We heard some noises from the backyard and especially from our neighbours, but nothing major. Having a proper bedroom door between us and the hallway helped. The windows have proper shades for privacy.
Overall, I would recommend this place, especially for a shorter stay if you want to stay in a simplistic yet clean apartment in the heart of Gracia.
Thank you!

The communications was bad - No instructions were sent before I wrote on the day of arrival that today is when I arrive. 3h before arrival I was asked to fill out a form & pay extra for some tax, after which instructions would be provided. Once instructions received - Instructions of arriving, staying and leaving was clear.
I asked for parking, which was confirmed by the host for the day I needed it. Two days later, when I needed parking host didn't answer. I called the company & they said they can't help and do anything about it. They sent a link of where the closest available parking garage was 30 minutes walk.
Kitchen has water damage and doesn't look nice- damaged panels and rusting fridge. The dishwasher was leaking, so asked to fix that. Otherwise apartment was ok. You could hear everything in the building and streets as the noise isolation was bad.
The sofa bed mattress was stained and sheets had stains as well. Probably clean but stains that didn't come off anymore.
1025981229888939036:
Para pasar un par de días es una opción excelente: muy cerca del centro por metro/bus pero en una zona muy tranquila (con unas camas muy cómodas hemos dormido a pierna suelta).
La limpieza y el estado del piso han sido impecables. Realmente todo estaba muy limpio y como si fuera para estrenar.
Que no parezca que al ser un bajo no es luminoso. Al contrario, por esa zona de patio entraba luz y además la tienen muy bien acondicionada para desayunar en el exterior con el fresco de la mañana. Todo un acierto.
La cocina estaba con todo lo necesario, lo justo para no echar de menos nada si pasas un par de días. Aunque siempre te falta algo (una fuente para las ensaladas, por ejemplo).
El sofá para cualquiera es cómodo y está nuevo, pero para una persona alta (como uno de nosotros) no es muy conveniente.
El personal de recepción sobresaliente: siempre dispuestos a solucionarte cualquier problema
Hay que tener en cuenta que hay un baño y un aseo, no dos baños.
Resumiendo, volveríamos .

Amazing apartment! Central AC is essential for the weather in Barcelona and the apartment has an amazing climatisation system, which is definitely a differential. The kitchen is equiped, the wifi works perfectly for the ones needing to work remote. The apartment terrace is lovely and has direct sun during the afternoon. The apartment is really clean, spacious and comfortable.
The apartment offers pepper, salt, sugar and coffee. However, other seasonings and olive oil are not available. Same for the shower products, body soap available, but not shampoo/conditioner (you must take yours).
Reception is available until 00h in the building, and they also keep your luggage during the check-in or check-out days, which is really helpful. Apartment has a good location, close to the metro and city center. Peaceful neighborhood and apartments are also calm/silent.

Our stay at Carlos's property in Barcelona was absolutely fantastic! From the moment we arrived, check-in went smoothly, and Victor, who welcomed us, was very friendly and helpful, providing us with a lot of great recommendations. The apartment itself was stunning—beautifully decorated, spacious, and impeccably clean.
We were just a 2-minute walk from the metro station (L3), making it easy to get anywhere in the city. The location couldn't have been better.
Carlos and his team were excellent in communication; they were always quick to respond and ensured we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. This property truly felt like a home away from home, and it made our Barcelona experience unforgettable.
We can't recommend Carlos's place highly enough! If you're looking for a fantastic stay in Barcelona, this is definitely the place to be!
1019340307296601080:
We had the best stay at 23! The photos just don't do justice to how amazing the space is, it's well laid out, super clean and every thing has been thought out to the smallest detail.
The kitchen has ample utensils/pots/pans etc.. to prepare a meal, if you don't fancy eating out every day. There is also plenty of storage space.
The shower was heavenly and the 10 minute hot water limit is plenty for two people.
The bed was really comfortable, we had an excellent sleep every night, setting us up perfectly for our full days of exploring everything Barcelona has to offer.
The location is brilliant, a 12 minute walk to La Pedrera and a 17 minute walk to the Sagrada Familia. It is also close to local transport links.
Everyone at 23 was super helpful and friendly, making us feel really welcome. I celebrated my birthday whilst there, and came back to find a pastry had been left in our room in a decorated box, which was such a thoughtful gesture!!
Thank you so so much for a great stay!!

I rarely ever write negative reviews but I feel I must after my experience here. Marj and her lovely other colleague were both charming, super helpful and friendly upon arrival. The room was really nice, super comfy bed, squeaky clean and all looked set to be a fab stay. However, the noise in the building is bad. There is zero sound-proofing and you can hear everything your neighbours next to you and above do. The hotel are clearly aware and have put signs up to ask guests to respect the quiet hours but sadly I had to deal with a dog barking in the room next door, constant door banging everywhere, the stamping of high heels above me until 1am and every time someone went to the bathroom in the night the sliding doors banged. This was through ear plugs. If you are a deep sleeper this place is perfect (it's really clean and nice) but if you are a light sleeper like me, it's impossible. I was awake for 2 nights. Great location - Gracia is awesome. Manager's tone - not so awesome.

Fui a Barcelona con mi mujer por nuestro aniversario de boda y nos hospedamos en Boutique 23. A la llegada nos recibieron con una botella de vino de sorpresa y una sonrisa en la cara. La bienvenida fue genial. El acceso fácil en taxi, te deja en la puerta. Una vez en el edificio, la decoración es espectacular, arquitectónicamente una maravilla. La limpieza es un factor a destacar. Todo huele y se siente como nuevo.
Con respecto a nuestra habitación, es un espacio completo, con cocina baño y dormitorio y un salón en el mismo espacio. Decorado de nuevo con mucho gusto. A nivel comodidades no le falta nada, se siente como un estudio listo para entrar a habitar. La cama es cómoda y hay suficiente espacio de almacenamiento para dos. El baño y la ducha son preciosos y prácticos. El ruido no fue un problema y a nivel climatización es muy confortable.
A nuestra salida pudimos dejar las maletas en el sitio y irnos a dar un paseo sin preocuparnos de ellas. Un diez de sitio.
33816957:
Location: 10/10
Pros: It's within walking distance of some of the greatest activities in BCN (Sagrada Familia, Casa Milà, Casa Batlló). It's also very close to the train, which is the easiest way to get around the city.
Cons: Not sure if there was a holiday, but the streets were closed off at times. Taxis will not turn into this street sometimes. The area is mostly a business district. While there are plenty of places to eat nearby, we had much more saved in areas we had to take the train to.
Cleanliness: 10/10
Pros: flawlessly clean! The floor felt clean enough to be barefoot, and the sheets and towels were very clean.
Cons: none :)
Amenities: 10/10
Pros: the washing machine and place to hang clothes were very useful! Miriam provided bath products, products to clean in the kitchen, clean towels, hangers in the closets, and iron & iron board.
A few cons:
- the elevator can sometimes get stuck
- the bathroom doors can be a little sticky
- there was some construction going on while we stayed there which was disturbing while we tried to work, would be nice if there is a heads up about this
Overall, great value and as other reviews said, the space is even better than the pictures! Miriam was super responsive and also let us stay later on our checkout day since our flight was late in the evening. 10/10 would recommend!

Highly recommend! Miriam’s apartment is well worth the stay in Barcelona. The apartment is located in the heart of the Garcia neighborhood and is easily accessible by walking to many tourist attractions. The neighborhood is very close to local cafes, restaurants, bars, stores and a local supermarket very close by. The apartment itself was very clean and has all the necessary essentials: stove top, microwave, refrigerator, espresso stove top maker only ( no electric coffee machine). Wasn’t a problem, love strong coffee. There is plenty of space to relax and hang out on the balcony and have a cup of coffee to enjoy the view. The space is great for two or three guests, with two separate bedrooms. The beds were very comfortable. The bathroom was super clean and the shower was good, plenty of hot water. Plenty of clean towels and some bathroom toiletries provided. There was a washer but did not use. Miriam was very very friendly and helpful providing area info and a map of the Barcelona area. There is a small elevator after the first landing to the upstairs but not a major problem. Definitely recommended and definitely would stay again upon a return to Barcelona. A super find!

I do not recommend staying here.!!! I’ve lived 3 years in Barcelona and own an apartment there. This is not a nice area, building or owner.
During our whole stay there were construction works going on in the building on another apartment of the SAME owner. She did not inform us about this at all. We had to find out from the construction workers themselves. She kept giving us falls information just to have us stay in the apartment. Saying that the works would only last for 2 hours etc.
The building was dirty due to all the dust flying around. Our laundry got ruined because of the workers cutting tiles on the balcony.m and the dust flying directly to our balcony/laundry.
The walls are so incredibly thin that we heard the upstairs neighbor puke during the night after she had a get together until late. We heard the neighbors dog (!next building!) through the walls and there is a very young baby living somewhere crying all the time.
Gracia is normally a nice place to stay but these building walls are too thin, the owner does NOT communicate and is not worth your money!
20066721:
Wow, wow, WOW!!
Based on past reviews, CASAGRAND seemed to have quite the reputation. My expectations were high before we arrived and yet somehow, every single expectation was exceeded with incredible attention to detail and care. As someone who travels extensively for work on my own, this was my first time planning a family vacation for 6 people, including a baby. I was a bit nervous and thought that perhaps the pictures and featured amenities were too good to be true. Upon our arrival, all of my nerves immediately mentee away.
Our jaws dropped when we stepped into the apartment - immaculately styled, spotless, and so inviting. Everything was so well thought out; from the baby bath to handwritten welcome note and treats to the unbelieve staff who treated us like family every day. Special thanks to Sasha - who greeted us every morning with a huge smile and itinerary for the day - to Eddie and Christiano who made sure we were well taken care of in the evenings. Marta was also a most incredible resource in helping us get around the city and answering our questions and Axel and Orlando kept the apt in impeccable condition.
The location of the apt is truly unbeatable and to be there during the La Merce festival was just a dream. I would not hesitate to book the apt again and cannot thank the staff enough for making this family trip and remarkable one that we will always cherish forever.
My deepest appreciation and gratitude,
Erica
NYC

The Casagrande is not just an Air BnB.....it is a truly one of a kind place that combines the value and spaciousness you would expect from an Air BnB with the finest luxuries you expect from the finest hotel! From the minute you walk into the beautiful lobby in one of the most special parts of Barcelona, you realize what a special place this is.....the staff is amazing and makes you feel like family!
When you enter the apartment your first impression will most likely be “is this truly all ours?”....... you look to the right and there is a long hallway with four beautifully appointed bedrooms with private baths. To the left is a spacious kitchen, living room, dining area and even an office. There are amenities that you would expect in a fine hotel, but are a surprise and delight at an Air BnB....... Molton Brown toiletries, Nespresso coffee, fluffy bathrobes, large towels......nothing is spared and it is easy to get spoiled! Also, at check-in you are given an iPad that has room service, concierge services and even Netflix! Four couples could easily stay here and have complete privacy and never get in each other’s way.....also perfect for a family!
The only caution is staying here will ruin you for staying in other Air BnBs in the future.......it is a magical blend of the finest hotel and a luxurious home with a staff waiting to attend to your every need! Stay at the Casagrande......for the chance to experience this beautiful property firsthand!

The host was very responsive and communicated clearly with us. The location is great. It is not in the middle of the action but very close to it (5 mins walk). We thought this was ideal. We rented a 5 bedroom. It was HUGE and spacious. We loved the long and wide hallways. The decor is modern and stylish with lots of windows and several balconies. The apartment is fully stocked with kitchenware, etc. The rooms, bathrooms and entire space was very clean. The pool on the roof deck was small but functional and relaxing. The Airbnb listing did not show the 5th bedroom but this room was just as nice as the others. The A/C in the master bedroom had challenges cooling the room. Initially, they said it was due to the sun but we had all the curtain and blackout shades shut the entire time. Very minimal improvement. I think it was low on gas. Should be checked. Cecilia and German at the front desk are AMAZING. They exceeded our expectations. However, Chris is just useless and lazy. Disappointing
49963630: We had a great stay here and really liked how comfortable, clean, and bright the apartment was. The host was very responsive and made us feel welcome. The location was conveniently across the street from a Metro station and near many grocery and food stores, restaurants, and shopping of every kind. Gracia, the neighborhood, is lively and busy at times, but the apartment was always very quiet. There is a desk and office chair for working which was appreciated. The large terrace has two seating areas, with a table for eating and a couch for lounging. And the bedroom has extra blinds built into the window which can make the room very dark for sleeping. The apartment is on an upper level floor and there is an elevator which worked well most of the time, but was a little finicky for about a week. Overall, it was a great place and we would love to stay here again.

Book this place if it is available!!
We lived in Sara's place for three months. It was the absolute best experience. The apartment is just like the photos, very comfortable and quickly felt like home. Sara has everything you could need in the apartment and beautiful Malika Favre artwork on display. Comfortable beds, plenty of hot water, lots of good closet space. The terrace was lovely to use on warmer days. The neighborhood of Gracia is fabulous. Walkable, lots of great restaurants nearby and cute little shops and markets. The L3 Metro line is right across the street. Super easy to use though we mainly walked everywhere. Nothing is far.
Highly recommend. We miss it already! And Sara is the best host, she goes out of her way to make sure all is well. Great apartment, great host!!

My boyfriend and I have been to Barcelona quite a few times, and this is by far the best apartment we've stayed in! Everything is brand new and the design is really thoughtful, lots of storage space and different places to work or relax.
The terrace is even nicer than pictured and has a comfy couch and big umbrella, easy to spend lots of time out there. We also loved that the apartment has so many windows and is full of natural light - not the easiest thing to find in Barcelona!
I've got nothing but good things to say - comfy beds, good wifi, washer and dryer, perfect location right across the street from the subway station and next to a bunch of bakeries, grocery stores, pharmacies, etc. Would recommend to anyone, and would come back in a heartbeat!
1100121:
I stayed in the Berga apartment for nearly a month. Sofia's place is right in the heart of the Gracia neighborhood, a two block walk from the L3 Metro that can take you into the heart of the city, and very close to all sorts of great shops and restaurants and the Libertat Market. Sofia provided all sorts of great tips for the neighborhood and one of our new favorite restaurants, La Pubilla, was her recommendation. One of the things that I really like about this apartment is that it is on a very quiet street, making this an unusually restful place. And check in and communication with the host was very easy (Sofia even had some cold beers in the fridge for us when we arrived!)
As far as amenities goes It has a washer and drying rack for clothes, a 4 burner stovetop for cooking and plenty of dishware. There was also a Nespresso machine and juicer for making fresh orange juice. There is no oven, but there is a convection microwave that can be used. When I travel I often like a frozen pizza in the evening so I don't have to eat out. The lack of an oven made this a bit more difficult. However, this was not a big deal.
The place was very clean and Sofia provided fresh linens weekly and tidied up. You can pay an additional fee for a more thorough cleaning if you stay there for longer periods of time. The only issue that I had with the apartment is that the wifi was somewhat spotty, particularly in the main living area. Back in the bedroom area it was much better. Although I don't see this as a problem for the casual tourist, I was in Barcelona running a study abroad program and the slow wifi sometimes made it difficult to make internet calls and upload larger data files.
Otherwise my stay was great, the neighborhood wonderful, and the apartment very comfortable. This is a neat and inexpensive apartment in a very fun neighborhood.

The apartment is a beautiful space in a fantastic location that was perfect for a couple to spend a few days in Barcelona.
Location is perfect, a block away from Fontana Metro station and from Carrer Gran de Gracia, with close access to a fantastic cheese shop and several bakeries and a large public market. Apartment was still very quiet however, as it faces into a small and quiet street off the main busy thoroughfare.
Apartment was furnished very well, and had plenty of usable living space for two. Two AC/heating units quickly warmed the space during the winter, and the shutter/curtain system kept in heat overnight and let in light during the day. Washing machine worked well.
Sofia was very hospitable, explaining Barcelona to us first-timers and recommending a number of excellent shops and dining locations nearby.
Only minor quibbles:
- WiFi was rather weak in the dining/living area, though worked okay in the bedroom
- Could have used some sharper knives and more kitchen cooking essentials like oil and pepper
- No toaster, though for our purposes the panini maker worked just fine for toasting bread
Overall, a fantastic place to stay in Barcelona that I would recommend to others. Thanks Sofia!

We stayed at Sofia's apartment for 1 week and loved every second!

Sofia wasn't around on our arrival but Sonia was there to greet us. There were some excellent recommendations in the information left for us and second all those recommendations - with a couple of extras to add, El Bitxo just round the corner from La Musica, incredible food and great service plus, Rubi Bar / Lime House - over 40 different gins, plus lovely staff who love to chat.

The location of the apartment is excellent - so close to the metro, but within walking distance of everything! We often walked to wherever we were off to for the day, enjoying the gorgeous weather, then got the metro home. The flat really did feel like home very quickly - it's clean, modern, well equipped and very comfortable.

Gracia, the area in which the apartment is situated, has a lovely feel with all amenities very close by; a market within 100yards, coffee shops, restaurants, and lots of shoe shops (Barcelona has a strangely large number of shoe shops...). Absolutely ideal!

Thank you Sofia! We had a wonderful time.
1126613779447054663:
Carlos and team run a tight operation. There is a person at the reception area from morning to midnight to ensure a smooth stay for guests.
They let us in as soon as we arrived, one hour earlier than check-in. And on the last day stored our luggage.
The apartment is super clean, beds and pillows are comfortable, we appreciated there was a detergent to run a quick laundry load. Eerything dried overnight on a rack.
The location is perfect if you want to be off the touristy/party zone, yet close to all attractions (15 min walk to La Pedrera, 10 min walk to bars around the many local squares in Gràcia.
Cross the street to Cafe Milano for breakfast, or night cup on the way home. We did both!
Just a 2 min walk to subway, L3 line that takes you to Placa de Catalonya, and directly to Park Montjuic.
While there was no noise from the street, the walls and floors are paper-thin. That’s just how the building is built, so keep in mind if you are a light sleeper.
Otherwise, we had a perfect stay

Pros: Carlos and Olga were responsive, helpful, friendly, and professional. Their attentive customer service increases the value of this booking. Location near Lesseps metro station very walkable and convenient. The area felt safe and family friendly. The apartment was very clean and comfortable with basic provided amenities, all you should need for a short stay. Roof top was quiet and peaceful. Temporary luggage storage option available to guests.
Cons: VERY poor audio insulation between units. If you are unfortunate like we were and have neighbors above you staying up all night into the wee hours of the morning (beyond 5am in our case) you will not get much sleep. They provide a 24 hour call line, which we eventually utilized, but the guests above continued their all nighter regardless, just at a lower decibel. A second pillow per guest would have been helpful to damper a bit of the radiant noise of loud talking and pacing on the floors. No WiFi available on roof top.

Service is superb. Friendly and helpful staff throughout our stay. There’s a front desk that’s open from morning to evening.
Location is at the boarder of Garcia.
-It is a 2min walk to the metro L3 line, which connects you directly to the main sights of Barcelona. It is also a direct ride to the Gracia or Sants station for RENFE trains for day trips.
-There’s a pharmacy right across the street and a DIA the supermarket up two blocks where we got water, milk, fruits at fair price.
-There are many local eateries in short distance and a selection of Asian cuisine within 10min walk.
-We found three playgrounds nearby for kids to release their energy.
The unit itself is clean and the layout is as seen in the photos. There’s a door to the kitchen / dinning / sofa bed area which wasn’t shown in photos (or you can’t really tell). We found the main bed and sofa beds both comfortable.
You can hear street noise at night but we had no issue with it.
5143895: Im not sure how this place is a super host. We were not happy in the place, this was our second Airbnb from Spain and we stayed 5 days here, I thought it was going to be great because our previous Airbnb was amazing. This one was a disappointment. The apartment looks outdated which wasn’t even a problem to us because we were barely gonna be there but it still wasn’t what I was expecting. We stayed for 5 days, were only given 1 towel each, 2 toilet papers and the body wash was clearly used by the previous people staying there. With my friend Marta and our two girls we decided to spent few days in Barcellona for their birthday. We picked Jordi's appartment since we wanted a small flat in the heart of Barcellona. Our host welcomed us with a big smile at our arrival allowing us to check-in in advance and start quickly our sightseeing. The flat is really clean, sunny and well organized. Our daughters Sophia and Camilla were excited to share the very confortable bed placed in the living room. Jordy nicely showed us the map of the city and the major suggested attraction. He has been very nice contacting us the day after to check if everything was ok with our stay....and we appreciated it very much. The apartment is placed in a very quite district out of the main turistic route with a nice coffee bar where we had tasty breakfasts both days right close to the flat and many different typical restaurants just few minutes walking (quite and safe also at night). We truly recommend it and hope to come back in the future.

Short Review:
Hospitality:10/10
Location:10/10 (2km by walk,3 km by drive to Sagrada familia and 1 km to park guell by walk/drive), Nearby Metro station ✓

1116002947007399192: We had a fabulous few days at Sofia’s apartment (family of 4).  It is a charming, beautifully looked after apartment, with 3 comfortable bedrooms and loads of very well designed storage space. The apartment really worked for our group - plenty of separation for teenagers (downstairs), sharing their own bathroom.  Excellent water pressure for the showers.  We especially enjoyed the light, bright and spacious kitchen / dining / sitting room, a really gorgeous place to hang out after our day’s activities were finished.  The apartment has super proximity to metro (2 mins, v easy to get everywhere), but there are also lots of interesting / fun things in the neighbourhood itself - the local market, the shops, restaurants and bars etc.  We loved the feel of being in a neighbourhood away from crowds, but still walkable (or metro if feeling lazy).  Sofia a very responsive and helpful host. Quick answers to qs about local area and accommodated our unreasonably late check-in.  Thank you so much!

We originally had booked accommodations in the Gothic quarter and as we were taking the train to Barcelona, I found out that our booking had been canceled. I reached out to Sofia and she very graciously excepted my request. She went out of her way to get everything clean and ready for us in an extremely short amount of time. She was not expecting to have guests in those two or three days, but the apartment seemed like it has been prepared specifically for us. and we didn’t arrive until quite late at night. She and her husband, Cesar, could not have been more accommodating and more generous with their time and their compassion for our situation. In the end, even though their apartment was somewhat more expensive we were much much much happier there. it truly is a spacious duplex apartment. There were five of us and we never felt cramped in the least. Her laundry facilities are the best of any Airbnb I’ve seen. The kitchen is top-notch and very well equipped. Brand new, unit. Loved it!

Our family absolutely loved our stay! Upon arrival Cesar was at the bnb to greet us and help us with our bags! He then proceeded to show us the home and all that the surrounding area had to offer. Sofia was very responsive with any and all questions we had. You couldn’t ask for better hosts and the place far exceeded our expectations. We are a family of 5 traveling with one teenager and two little ones and the home fit our needs perfectly. The aesthetic of the home had an older feel with hand laid brick walls and wooden beams with a very modern flair in the updates that they have done which was great! Don’t think twice book this place as you and your travel companions will be happy you did! Lastly make sure to get your morning cup of coffee around the corner at Old Coffee House I promise if you’re a coffee “snob” such as myself and partner you will thank yourself that you did, ran by a father/daughter duo from Columbia and some of the nicest people you will meet in this part of town!
35454439:
We stayed for 4 nights with two adults and two teenagers.
Location:
Location in Vila de Gracia - a family oriented neighbourhood which is made up mostly of locals - is good with a supermarket and traditional food market steps from the apartment . You are also a two minute walk to the Metro stop to access trains and bus routes throughout the city. It is quite far from some of the major tourist areas (Gothic region, Barconaleta Beach, Montjuic) which are spread out so expect to walk 60-90 minutes to see many of them. We ended up getting a 48 hour hop on/off bus tour with Barcelona City Tours which was a great way to see/learn about all points of interests especially if you only have 4 days like we did.
The Apartment
The apartment is nicely decorated with some beautiful accents like exposed brick walls and ceilings. It also has a nice bathroom and new kitchen with induction stove stop which took some time to learn how to work but was great once we did. Beds are very comfortable.
It is a bit smaller than it appears in the photos - for 4 people we found the kitchen and living room a bit too tight for us. Some kitchen utensils that would have been nice to have - cheese grater, spatula - perhaps something to add for future visitors.
The electrical power in the unit went out on us at least 10 times likely because you cannot run more than one major appliance at time - i.e. oven/dishwasher/washing machine. Was fairly easy to reset the breakers though but it may be something for the landlord to address in the future.
Our unit was on a floor one level above the back alley and there were quite a few locals who hung out into the early hours of the morning making noise. My sense is they were fairly harmless but we were not comfortable letting our kids go out when they were there.
Host
Leading up to our trip communication with Yaiza was quite good however, he/she was not as responsive once we had checked in. Two separate messages were not responded to - specifically what to do with the garbage and recycling and the Wifi outage on our final day which was a real inconvenience as we were trying to arrange travel changes. A bit old school but in apartment guidebook to answer frequently asked questions like this would have been helpful.
Barcelona is an amazing city and we really enjoyed it. Next time we might look to stay a bit closer to the water and major points of interest to make the city a bit more accessible in the evenings.

The host Yaiza was quick to respond to any email queries. Following his guidance we were able to get into the apartment a little earlier than the check in time.
The apartment was exactly as it looked in the advertisement. On arrival we found a little bag containing all the basics, washing up liquid, a couple of dishwasher tablets, also some tea bags and some coffee pods (there is a coffee pod machine). There was soap for the bathroom sink, along with shampoo/conditioner and body wash in the shower.
Bedding and towels were clean, and beds were very comfortable.
The apartment is in a great location, with bars, supermarkets and attractions either within a short walk or a short ride on the metro.
We are all vegans and though we made quite a lot of use of the kitchen (which was well equipped), Barcelona has a lot of vegan restaurants and cafés, so there was a lot of choice for places to eat out.
Only one negative, that being lack of sound proofing on the windows. The apartment is on the first floor, the street below narrow, and any noise is echoed, and typically when people have been out into the early hours drinking, they are loud. Not surprisingly Barcelona is a place people go partying and we were woke, a lot, up to about 3am each night.
Overall it's a place to stay, but if you're not one of those out partying bring some ear plugs.

TLDR: Avoid this apartment if you value sleep even a little bit. A beautiful, spacious apartment isn't worth anything when you can't utilize its main function - finding sleep between exhausting days of city exploration.
Pros:
- roomy, tidy, neatly decorated apartment with two bedrooms
- near city centre, lots of places in walking distance or easily reachable by public transport
- great check-in procedure and very friendly contact with the landlord
Cons:
- terrible, I mean really nonexistant noise isolation, it's like the walls and windows were just for show, it did not make a difference whether the windows were closed or not, it always felt like we were standing right next to a buzzing street corner.
- you can clearly hear every word of the neighboring apartment's tenants, especially frustrating when they ignore the apartment's quiet times
- there is a bar directly below the apartments, with people standing outside you have to turn the TV really loud to be able to understand anything
1145481008786845097: This is a stunning Airbnb and my husband and I loved our stay. It’s a really snazzy layout and feels chic, modern, hip, cozy, and inviting. Instructions to get inside were seamless and clear, as well as check out. It’s right next to an awesome vegan restaurant and in a bustling part of town, yet as soon as you step inside it’s quiet and insulated from noise. It has a magnificent view—can’t be understated. Had all supplies needed to do a small load of laundry, make morning coffee, cook a delish meal, and a comfortable bed, which is rare in my Airbnb experience. We stayed in the “off season” and I was shocked to see how crowded the city was though, and I understand the concerns and complaints of locals. The city can’t quite handle that many people, like other cities such as Madrid can (which I was surprised I loved so much!), so only caution is be mindful of when you travel if you don’t like crowds. This airbnb was a great space to chill away from the crowds though! Highly recommend

We had a wonderful stay with our two young children. The apartment was very spacious and the extra living space allowed plenty of room for them to play when we weren’t out exploring the city. The views from every window were amazing. The terrace was a wonderful place to sit and watch the beautiful sunrise. Kitchen was well equipped, shower had great water pressure, bedding was comfortable. The apartment has private entrance on the top floor and requires a passcode in the elevator to access for extra security. The apartment was in a great location to walk to several delicious restaurants, all the high end shopping along Gracia, and the Diagonal Metro stop.
Entry to the building is through an app so make sure to open the file sent and download the app prior to arrival to make sure entry goes smoothly.
The host was always very responsive and helpful if we had any questions or concerns.

The flat was spacious and comfortable for a family of 3. The patio is spectacular! Private elevator access is a plus. The master bedroom is nice with lots of natural light, patio access, and a walk-in closet. There are 2 bathrooms but the small one could only be fit for smurfs or elves. The second bedroom can be challenging on hot days when your only option is to open the windows to the building and street noise. Minimally annoying, but still notable: you need a charged phone with data service to come in and out (no keypad or physical key,) no trash bags or soap (only dishwasher soap.) We had to deal with loud construction workers downstairs all day, so ask before you book! To close on a high note, the views of the Mediterranean, Sagrada Familia, Tibidabo are, again spectacular. Unbeatable location!
39737048:
Giselle and Erica were really welcoming, it was our 1st time in Barcelona.
They went the extra mile to ensure everything was just right for our stay!
They were friendly, helpful and communicated with us prior to our arrival which was nice.
They explained everything we needed to know, & it seemed that nothing was too much trouble for them!
The apartment was just as it is in the photo's.
The apartment & linen was spotlessly clean, & the beds were comfortable, no hard springs!
Giselle offered to make the sofa bed up for us in advance, which was appreciated!
The air conditioning worked really well & there was everything there that we needed.
Giselle & Erica were helpful in route planning & gave us directions to the local supermarket.
We liked the rooftop terrace, the seating was comfortable & it was a relaxing place to spend time together in the evening. It was not overlooked.
They really were 'Super Hosts' & we all agreed we would definitely stay there again! Thank you both.

We decided to stay here because it was a cute little apartment and I was travelling with my mom, sister and baby and we wanted a separate room for my mom and the baby with us and a living room so we can relax while the baby naps and it ended up being exactly what we wanted. The main woman at the front (I forgot her name...maybe Gisela?) was lovely. She gave us lots of recommendations and arranged a taxi  with a carseat for us to the airport. They were also able to provide a crib and high chair for our baby which was really helpful during our stay. And they were also very good at responding to any questions we had during business hours. The location of the Airbnb was also convenient and very walkable, and close to transit. Good amount of restaurants and convenience stores nearby. Only few things that I'd say gave us some trouble was the elevator and how small the second bedroom is. It made my mom feel a bit claustrophobic. Other than that, a pretty good place to stay in Barcelona!!

The apartment is spotless clean, the bathroom and the kitchen are ok. The rooms are spacious. The whole apartment is bigger than the photos. The elevator is only 3 persons max, but the stairs is ok. Only 3 to 5 minutes walk from the train station (metro) depends on how fast you walk. The place, have pharmacy, supermarkets and restaurant nearby with very peaceful and safe surroundings. The Italian woman from the office ( i forgot her name) is very helpful, she gave us fixed information about places to visit, how to visit them, the transportation and everything. I highly reccomend this place. We will be back surely the next time we visit Barcelona
31758760:
Myself and my partner visited Ana's property at the end of April. This is our honest review of our stay at this apartment.
The location was fantastic. You're in the area of Vila De Gracia. This entire area, including the Fontana Metro and surrounding areas, are beautiful delights full of amazing little family/independent businesses, cafes, restaurants, shops and Pizzeria's. There is so much to do and see in this area, it's absolutely amazing. There's even a large second-hand English bookshop, multiple Japanese-themed stores, loads of comic/anime shops and country themed restaurants/shops.
Following down the main high-street (on the road from Fontana metro) takes you down to the main Cafe/Restaurant & Luxury shopping districts. There are many 4/5 star restaurants and cafes here to eat and relax in. Beautiful Tapas menus and the like. The luxury district has every fashion brand you could think of and even cheaper brands like H&M, Primark, etc. Many Gaudi buildings are along this road.
The property itself has a balcony which overlooks Placa Del Sol. This plaza has cafes, bars and restaurants which allows you to fully enjoy Catalan nightlife - The bedroom is on the other side of the apartment so you don't hear much noise, but be aware you will hear people shouting/being loud along the streets all the way to midnight (some nights we heard people still out at 1am on a weekday!) as well as the large heavy-duty metal door slam shut from people entering the complex.
The location is a mere 20 minute walk to all of the main Tourist attractions - 20 minute walk to Parc Guel. 15 to Sagrada Familia. 25 to La Rambla & Gothic Quarter, which is fantastic to save money on travel, as you can walk to these main attractions and to enjoy the beautiful scenic roads of Barcelona.
However, apart from Location - We do not recommend this property at all.
Firstly, the bedsheets were dirty - They smelt of sweat and clearly did not get changed at all. It's unacceptable that the Host did not change the bedsheets. We had to wash them ourselves, which is unacceptable, but as the property had no dryer, the bedsheets took forever to dry. The blankets in the cupboard had black stains, dirt, and also were very dusty. We also found bogey/snot on the underlining of the bed when we stripped it for cleaning.
Talking of the cupboards - Dust everywhere. They were unusable to store clothes in. Not even enough coat hangers for your clothes.
There was dust all over in corners of the property.
The floor was dirty and disgusting. It had not been mopped or properly cleaned at all - Walking around the apartment bare footed or in white socks would dirty them within minutes.
The shower curtain/railing is unstable and fell off during the night whilst we were sleeping.
The hairdryer is also a vintage antique. Started smoking once we turned it on and the fan to blow hot-air out the hairdryer does not work. It's clearly non-functioning and a hazard to use.
The only cooking appliances in the house is a microwave and an electric stove/hob. If you're planning to cook in the property, there is no oven. The electric stove also takes far too long to heat up & the Host should get better frying pans which are more suitable for Electric ceramic stoves.
The kicker to all of this, is the hot water. Do not, under any circumstances, expect to have proper showers. Allegedly, there was a 50ltr depot of hot water which fills up constantly, but this does not provide enough hot/warm water at all for two people to have proper showers. In the summer months where you wish to have cool showers as it's blazing hot, absolutely it might be adequate, but in Winter/Spring? No chance. My partner had to skip washing her hair for two days because were was not enough water for the both of us to shower after each other. 10 minutes is perfectly adequate to wash hair and thoroughly scrub your body clean after a day of sweating, but that was impossible. These were not "long showers", as they suggested we were taking.
You do not get these problems in an equivalent 3-star hotel, charging 3-star hotel prices. I expect these issues in a cheap hostel where you're sharing rooms with random people. If the Host cannot properly clean the apartment, then she should get proper cleaners, like many other Hosts do, to thoroughly clean the apartment.
To summarise, fantastic location. Sub-par and dirty apartment.

I stayed here for 3 weeks and had a great time. The apartment worked well, but I definitely felt slightly mislead reading the prior reviews.
I was expecting to walk into a clean and comfortable apartment.
Upon arrival it seemed up to par but as i started to unpack it didn’t feel clean. For example, there were still crumbs on the chairs and couches assuming from the prior guest. The hand soap in the bathroom was empty after 3 uses, and a used sponge was at the kitchen sink, the coffee maker was dirty as well.
Ana was nice about it and offered to have the cleaning lady come in two days or her nephew come the next day, I ended up just cleaning it myself that day due to wanting to use the furniture but they brought extra hand soap and sponges which I appreciated.
Also the extra sheets smelled weird, I think it’s because the washer was left shut and got moldy (so I also cleaned the washer) but due to this I ended up rewashing my sheets to feel comfortable. And the blanket in the closet smelled like someone had used it so I washed that as well.
I stayed here 3 weeks and I would again for this length of time but just for a couple days I would’ve been disappointed in these hiccups - not fully clean, no hand soap, short hot showers, moldy washer, weird smelling sheets, dirty coffee maker. By the end of the 3 weeks after acquainting myself with the quirks of the place and the cleaning I did, I was able to become comfortable in the apartment
Pros:
The location is great! I love the terraces. She has AC for the summer. Safe and secure! WiFi is great. Natural light!
Cons:
The hot water tank is small (leas than 10 min shower), the apartment is outdated, I wasn’t left enough cleaning supplies - only one extra trash bag which was fine for one person.
(Also the TV is small, about 22 inches)
My review: if you’re fine doing the above and dealing with the quirks the place is great! But be aware it’s older and might come w a couple flaws.
Also, I don’t think this place could fit more than two people because of the hot water, only 2 regular sized towels, and two pillows for the bed.

Ana's apartment felt like home away from home. From the moment I walked in, I absolutely fell in love with it. I appreciated all the amenities provided which made my stay very comfortable.
Her sofa bed was extremely comfortable and slept like a baby. I appreciated she had extra blankets and pillows. After traveling two other countries before visiting Barcelona, I was extremely exhausted and was in desperate need of a good night sleep. My first night at Ana's apartment, I slept so well - I decided to stay in bed until noon which allowed me to regain the energy I need to tackle Barcelona.
The location was amazing. Very close (walking distance) to Passeig de Gracia, overlooking a square where there is a convenient store, restaurants, and a bar. However, please be advised since the apartment is overlooking a square, many locals do hang out until 2 am. I personally did not mind, but if you are looking for a quiet place, this may not be a place for you. But if you are looking for a live vibe, then yes, definitely check this place out.
We took advantage of the location and met so many people in the square.
50799401: Amanda's place is even better than advertised. Very modern, absolutely spotless and perfectly located just on the outer edge of Gràcia -- just a few blocks away from the Fontana Metro station. The location gives you the best of both worlds -- very close proximity to the hustle and bustle of Gràcia but with the serenity and quiet of not being in the middle of it all. The terrace is nice and sunny, the AC operates well, and the apartment has both a new washer AND a dryer (a rarity in Spain). Amanda was a great host. Although we never met, she was always just a message away with a response to anything I needed. She had left me a bottle of Rioja and a large bottled water for my arrival. She arranged a taxi to the airport for me (I had a really early flight), which I really appreciated. Gràcia is a great neighborhood to get a local feel for Barcelona and Catalunya, full of plazas, markets, little shops and places to eat. It's also a safe and simple base point for exploring the city, thanks to  the efficient Metro and ferrocarril systems. I stayed at the apartment even though I was traveling alone, so I used only one of the three bedrooms. Don't hesitate to book this place, even if you are traveling solo or are a couple. It's worth it.

Our stay at Amanda's apartment was absolutely wonderful! The space was exceptionally quiet and comfortable, providing the perfect retreat after exploring this vibrant city. Its prime location deserves special mention - we loved being within easy walking distance of both bus and metro stations, making city navigation effortless.
What truly elevated our experience was Amanda's genuine hospitality. The surprise bottle of excellent wine she left for us was such a heartwarming gesture that showcased her thoughtfulness as a host. Every detail in the apartment contributed to a seamless stay, blending practical amenities with cozy charm.

Thank you, Amanda, for your warm hospitality and for sharing your lovely space with us. We wouldn't hesitate to return and wholeheartedly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting BNC.

We truly cannot say enough good things about Amanda‘s place and Amanda herself. Absolutely 100% would recommend. My best friend and I stayed for a week and could not be happier with our stay.

The host: Before we even arrived Amanda had sent us an entire list of suggestions for places to eat, helpful, local spots, such as markets, etc. She was so responsive, and went above and beyond to make us comfortable. Would definitely return! Thanks Amanda!
3089510:
I highly recommend Ricard’s place and would happily stay again! The bedroom has air conditioning and a very comfortable bed, and stays very dark which made for some of the best night’s sleeps I’ve had in a while. The en suite bathroom were clean and the shower stayed hot and had great pressure. The closet attached to the bedroom had spacious drawers and two rods to hang clothes, so it was very easy to stay organized.
The living room can get a little warm during the hot months, but opening the window or balcony door can let in a cool breeze. The couch was very comfortable and spacious and the TV had Netflix and other streaming apps.
The kitchen was not well stocked so we had to buy our own basics, but there was a large bottle of water left in the fridge, which was exactly what we needed after traveling on a hot day.
The washer worked very well and was easy to use, and there are clotheslines and pins for easy drying. The front terrace is very homey, and has an incredible view of the Sagrada Familia. It was lovely to drink wine and look at the city, do yoga, or enjoy the warm nights from the terrace.
The neighborhood felt very safe and had everything you need nearby. There is a grocery store a minute’s walk away, along with a number of excellent restaurants, bars, and cafes (including one with iced lattes, which are a little hard to find in Europe).
It is easy to hail a taxi out on the main road parallel, and there is an easy walk to the bus and metro.
Ricard was very easy to communicate and always responded within an hour. He provided information on where to get covid tests when asked, as we needed to get them before being allowed back in the US. He gave us a very clean and comfortable place to call home during our time in Barcelona, and I would not hesitate to book with him again!

Our five night stay in Ricard's apartment was just what were looking for, Ricard was great to deal with, friendly, prompt to my email queries and also offering helpful information.

The apartment was exactly as seen online, it is on the fourth floor and has views over to Sagrada Familia. Ricard has prepared a folder of information for his guests to help quickly orientate us on bar/restaurant recommendations, location of supermarkets, etc.

The kitchen is well equipped, washing machine, iron, and the coffee pot was welcome for coffee breaks on the terrace. We appreciated having some English on one of the many television channels. The bed and pillows were comfortable and there was plenty of cupboard space.

In regards to the location it was perfect for our needs, better than I realised. Easy walking to Casa Vicens, La Pedrera, Casa Batllo, and Sagrada Familia. Barcelona Sants is only four metro stops away which made arrival and departure easy; only a 15 minute walk to the metro with our luggage, 10 minutes without. It took me 25 minutes to travel over to the convention centre for my work conference, the reason for our visit.

I would have no hesitation in staying here again or recommend to my family and friends. Please be aware that there is no lift in the building and you must climb many steps to the apartment, no issue for us, a good workout to wear off the yummy food.

Ricard's place is a cozy little nest in the heart of Barcelona. It's less than 5 minutes to the metro, there are plenty of good restaurants in the area, and it's in a very quiet neighborhood. The apartment was squeaky clean. Though we didn't use the kitchen, it looked to be well outfitted for anyone who wanted to cook. There's a washing machine, clothes line and clothes pins on the balcony, and the sitting area is very comfortable. There were extra pillows and blankets, which is always a plus for me, since I like to sleep in a cold room with lots of blankets. And he had umbrellas for the one day it rained!! Very nice touch!
Ricard is a wonderful host. He always communicated with us on a timely bas is, he sent clear entry instructions well in advance of our arrival, he let us leave our luggage there on the morning of our arrival, since we arrived off a cruise ship, and he was always available to help if we had any questions or concerns.
Though this is not a negative, I still think people should know that the bathroom is VERY small (as you would expect it to be in a nest), and anyone over 150 pounds would have great difficulty getting in and out of the shower, or turning around once in the shower without bumping the water temperature control handle.
Thank you, Ricard, for a great stay, and we will definitely book again should we return to Barcelona again.
1216581473387870068:
My sister and I traveled from the US and were absolutely blown away by this Airbnb! Everything was brand new and in pristine condition.
BEDROOM: Cozy, with a super comfortable bed and high-quality linens.
BATHROOM: One of the cleanest I’ve ever seen, with fantastic water pressure and the added bonus of a heated drying rack, which came in handy since dryers are rare in Europe.
WIFI: high-speed, worked great
AC: Amazing
LIVING SPACE: We had ample closet space for our luggage, and the kitchen was next level. It had every utensil you could need if you wanted to stay in and cook a meal. One of our favorite parts was the balcony. Though the apartment is on a popular street, as soon as we closed the door, it was completely peaceful with no outside noise.
The host was incredibly responsive. The location was perfect—bustling but not overly touristy, which made us feel like locals. We absolutely loved staying here and will definitely book again when we return.
Highly recommend!

Exceptional Stay in a Perfect Location!
I recently had the pleasure of staying at this fantastic apartment, and I can't recommend it enough! From the moment I booked, the host was incredibly helpful and responsive, answering all my questions almost immediately.
The apartment itself is brand new and exactly as depicted in the photos. It’s beautifully designed and well-maintained, providing a perfect home away from home. The bed is soft and comfortable, allowing me to fall asleep effortlessly each night.
Located right in the town center, I found it easy to explore nearby attractions like Casa Batlló and La Pedrera, all within walking distance. Supermarkets, souvenirs shop and restaurants are just in a minute downstairs.
Additionally, the apartment is stocked with plenty of kitchen utensils and bathroom towels, making my stay even more convenient.
Overall, this was an excellent experience, and I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and centrally!

We had a great stay here. The location is charming, vibrant, and right in the heart of Gràcia. Literal steps from shops, the metro, and lively squares. We were mindful of Gracia's shifting dynamics -- like many parts of the city, it’s feeling the pressure of tourism and change -- and it's a great place if you're the type who does their part to respect that people live there.
The apartment itself is clean and well-kept. Lots of storage, a sofa that’s comfy enough couch to nap. The bedroom is at the back of the space, away from street noise (double paned doors onto the balcony work great). The kitchen is practical and has enough counter space -- everything worked well for us once Enrique and team helped us understand the stovetop. Great water pressure in the shower, strong toilet flush (always appreciated), and fast internet (we were able to do simultaneous Zoom calls with no issue).
Enrique and his team were super responsive when we needed help.
2781640:
My wife and I stayed at Claudio’s place for about three months while I was working in Barcelona. Claudio is an incredibly warm, kind and attentive host, and has provided us a new friend in Barcelona. He was VERY available during our entire stay to answer questions about the apartment of to give hints on dining or even his favorite chocolate and churros shop. Our comfort was his top priority. The apartment was very clean upon our arrival. He kindly offered periodic cleaning services during our prolonged stay. The neighborhood offers all of the amenities one could want including grocery stores, bakeries, bodegas, and a great restaurant on the corner called Platerets (reservations, Carrer de Milà i Fontanals, 29). The apartment is a 10-15 minute walk to the Verduger (blue and yellow lines), Joanic (yellow line), and Diagonal (a major hub) metro stations. You can get to just about anywhere in Gracia, to the Sagrada Familia, or to the Sant Pau Recinte Modernista, in a 15 minute walk.
The lift is great to get suitcases up and down to the top floor. The kitchen is well equipped. The upstairs deck is a wonderful space for breakfast or to end the day with a glass of wine and some cheese. The bedroom is large with ample closet space and the bed is comfortable. I would highly recommend Claudio and his lovely apartment for your stay in Barcelona.

LOCATION LOCATION LOCATION!  Claudio's apt was perfect for anyone wanting to feel like they were living in Barcelona but close enough to all the tourist attractions as a visitor. We absolutely LOVED the Grazia neighborhood! You must go to 2 restaurants - "Platerets" which is literally on the corner and our favorite  "La Panxa del Bisbe" (we went to twice just to have the gnocchi with Foie again) (we walked but you may want to take a taxi as it's all up hill). Claudio will make a resv - which I highly recommend. Claudio was a fantastic host - he met us at the apt & gave us a map & explained what to do. He had wine, cheese, crackers, water & other goodies waiting for us.  What a nice touch!  His suggestions were perfect. The entire stay he was in touch with us if we needed anything. The patio on the roof was fantastic. We ate breakfast everyday and then had wine & cheese in the evening. The AC kept us so comfortable in July. We were so lucky that for 3 days while we were there they had live music around the corner w/drinks and food to buy. There is a great market down the street to stock the fridge. But the kitchen has a bunch of essentials if you cook. We will absolutely be back to Barcelona & plan to stay at Claudio's - the people, the food, the neighborhood - we fell in love.

My girlfriend and I stayed with Claudio for a month and we had a great experience.
Claudio was a fantastic host with great communication, always quick to reply, good with suggestions of bars, restaurants and places to visit in Barcelona, helped with our luggage and even left us a welcome present.
The apartment was as advertised, it was clean and tidy, with all kitchen and cooking facilities provided, clean towels and sheets, a really comfortable bed and lots of closet space in the bedroom.
The 2 minor down sides were that the shower hot water only lasted for about 3mins although I'm not sure if that was because the setting was wrong or there is a small hot water tank, and the other is the limited access to natural light, mainly due to the direction the apartment is facing, however the rooftop deck was great and made up for this.
Overall we really enjoyed our stay, the Gracia area is a real highlight with a close by fresh food market, fantastic bars and restaurants and an amazing cinema with the cheapest price in Europe right on the corner.
Thank you for our stay Claudio, we loved Barcelona so much that we have decided to stay in the city longer, and we would recommended this place for anyone wanting to visit Barcelona.
Cheers,
Steven
357576:
Barcelona is the greatest! and so was this Airbnb experience. The apartment is exactly as pictured. We loved it in the photos, and we loved it once there. Really special! We were four people and felt it had ample space. It had a good layout too. The outdoor area made it seem even larger. Plants were in the kitchen, bathroom, and outside, surrounding the patio - they made it very warm, and homey. I love Silvia's taste and how everything is presented...

Normally we like the windows open at night, but we shut the front (next to street) window because of some street noise – and, because there was a fan, it was no problem (in fact, each of the three rooms had a fan). The neighborhood is vibrant with shops of all types close by. We would have liked to stay even longer than the six days we did! Too much to see and do.

We didn't cook dinners (too many great places to try, and so close), so I won't comment on the kitchen in detail, but it seemed as if everything you'd need would be there. Suggestion if you come: at the very least, if you are looking for pizza, DO NOT MISS Circus Pizza, Carrer de Terol, 8 -- the BEST anywhere - and very close.

Silvia was super responsive. She arranged a taxi for us when we arrived - great for three exhausted people. My other daughter joined us later and had no problems taking the train from the airport. Silvia had left us some snacks and drinks - very thoughtful and very welcome! Later in our stay there happened to be a street protest - not a common occurrence, but I bring it up because Silvia checked on us a few times to make sure we were all fine - she's just that way!

I felt really good about her and think she's a very caring and thoughtful host. We would come back in a heartbeat!

First impressions…
High high ceilings, glass panes in the tops of doors, glass doors to a long hallway, beautiful arched glass windows looking out to a spectacular courtyard of plants galore, tiled Andalusian floors ancient and worn throughout the space. Colors everywhere. None of this gray on gray throughout. This home is a home. A Catalan household. Exuding charm. Wood beams and brick in the kitchen. Filled with funky chic antique thrift store at its finest, carefully placed and selected. No matter how often you look at things there, something new will appear. Everything is touched with love. Everything is placed from the heart.
The neighborhood of Gracia bustles with local energy…shops throughout abound.
