A safe haven to come to where spared from the long lines and emptying tourist buses are simple neighborhood squares to hang out on a bench with, children laughing and happy they play, a café to have a coffee in while listening to some really good music…Silvia’s neighborhood.
I can see how much it means to Silvia that not just us but all her guests are happy being here. She is efficient, prompt, an excellent communicator, pays close attention to detail, and will go out of her way to make sure you are comfortable. This home of Silvia’s means much to her, and it shows in the way she presents it and shares it with us all.
Something rare and very hard to find. Something special!

We were a little bit apprehensive about taking three kids on their first city break but we needn't have worried... Silvia's place really made our trip relaxing, easy and fun. The place is lovely, just as described and as the photos, and for a family (or adults) the location is brilliant. Silvia was such a lovely host, waiting for us on arrival with juice, biscuits, tea, coffee. So helpful and friendly! The apartment has many things to make a family stay easier, we did not come accross anything we needed but didn't find there. The washing machine/dryer is a godsend for a family travelling light. Gracia is a great area for eating out with kids - close by you will find freshly made burgers, fresh pasta, huge slices of pizza, tapas, churros and chocolate and so much more. Loads of unique shops and supermarkets (several options) within easy reach. We walked up to Parc Güell with relative ease and the centre of town is closer than you might think - we walked back from the Ramblas area, admittedly piggybacking the littlest one most of the way! Metro close by and easy to navigate (buy a T10 ticket).
We had one of our best holidays ever and would without doubt stay here again. Thank you Silvia!
1047089:
I gave this place 4 stars, but would have given 3.5 if there was an option. My stay at Teo’s apartment in Gracia was good. It’s what I paid for- great location, clean space, 2 bedrooms, balcony. Teo sends you a welcome email when you book of places to see, and again when you check in, which is a nice touch. We were VERY grateful for the air conditioning and extra amenities- iron, wine opener, coffee maker, washer and dryer (dryer was a little low power, and can only dry a few things at a time, but not a full load).
The WiFi was not a secure network, and not particularly strong, so don’t expect to work or check your bank balance while you’re here. Additionally, this apartment is on the top floor and is a walk-up of several stories high, and I felt it should have been advertised that way. If there was an elevator, we were not made aware of it. If you stay in the front room, you’ll hear people outside when you go to sleep, so bring ear plugs. While Kumar was great, and Teo okay, we had some communication issues with Patricia, which added a layer of frustration that you don’t want or need while you’re on vacation. She was generally slow to respond (over 24 hours, and sometimes after 48 hours, and only after follow ups. I only asked two questions- flexible check in and flexible check out. She didn’t answer my questions directly, so I often referred back to Teo to answer my questions. When she did respond, her answers were short and incomplete and full of smiley faces. As a host, I couldn’t care less about whether you send smiley faces and give me excuses; I just want you to answer my questions completely and within 48 hours.
Biggest positive: location was perfect. Far enough away from tourist spots, but still within walking distance. Great neighborhood with plenty of restaurants and bars. And still in the heart of Barcelona. We couldn’t have picked a better location.
Biggest negative: Patricia (our welcome host? I’m not really sure what her role was, since she didn’t ever communicate). Communication is big for me, but may not be important for everyone, so if it’s less important to you then this place is awesome. It was big enough issue for me that I’d give this place a good review, but wouldn’t stay here again.

At the outset, my email communication with Teo, the host, has been very warm and all my queries were promptly answered. When we arrived at Barcelona Airport, our taxi was already waiting to take us to the apartment, and Patricia, the host's representative was already waiting for our arrival. She even helped to carry our suitcases up to the apartment which is on the 3rd floor! Patricia was wonderful, she briefed us everything about the apartment, and gave us tips on the neighbourhood as well as how to get around the city, even though all these written information were available in the apartment. Patricia even went the extra mile to help call a nearby restaurant to have our dinner delivered to the apartment. And we really appreciate this little gesture since it was already quite late in the evening, we were already quite tired and we don't speak Spanish.

The apartment itself is well fitted out with modern conveniences and fittings, although some of the original floor tiles and vaulted ceiling were restored which was wonderful; two of my friends who are architects, really appreciate this. The apartment is perfect for the four of us, with 2 separate bedrooms, and it is very comfortable. And we enjoyed our breakfast time around the dining table, which was another piece of restored furniture. The only downside is that we had to climb up the staircases to get to the apartment which is on the 3rd floor; its not an easy climb up the stairs when we have large suitcases!

The neighbourhood itself is well served with shops, cafes and restaurants, and we could easily flag down a taxi on the street. And the Gaudi landmarks in the city are all not very far and are very easily accessible by taxi from the apartment. Too bad we couldn't stay longer to explore the city.

Again, Patricia had also arranged for a taxi to take us to the airport. I wouldn't mind returning to the apartment, but I hope that the next time around, there will be an elevator in the building. Many thanks to Teo and to Patricia

El apartamento está ubicado en un edificio antiguo en estado regular, en el barrio de Gracia, a 25 minutos caminando del centro. Tienes varios medios de comunicación (Metro / Bus). Cuando llegamos tuvimos que subir, más de 4 pisos por escaleras (alrededor de 75 escalones), Fue bastante ingrato y peligroso subir con varias valijas por unas escaleras angostas. La publicación advierte “hay que subir escaleras”, pero no aclara que se trata de 4 pisos y medio, es engañoso. Cuando llegamos nos cobraron Euros 20 de multa por haber llegado 20 minutos tarde al check in. Si bien lo aclaran en la publicación, se trató de una demora en el vuelo que fue avisada, otro mal momento después de subir los 75 escalones. En el edificio, están instalando un ascensor, por lo tanto hay que convivir con albañiles trabajando con amoladoras, martillos y sierras eléctricas desde las 8:30 hasta las 17:00 bajo “un manto de polvo y escombros” muy molesto. Considero que el apartamento. no está en condiciones de alquilarse a turistas que pagan us$ 150 diarios mientras dure la obra. El apartamento está reciclado a nuevo y tiene todo lo necesario para 4/5 personas. Los aspectos a mejorar  son la conexión a internet (es inestable y de bajo performance y el tamaño de las camas matrimoniales, son muy pequeñas), pero en resumen está muy bien. Conclusión, asegúrate que hayan finalizado las obras de instalación del ascenso y que el mismo funcione, caso contrario, búscate otro apartamento, Barcelona es grande y diversa.
2058080:
We stayed at Phil and Fiona's place for 6 nights and we were very happy with the experience. Phil met us at check in and gave us a tour of the house, and everything that he didn't cover was in the handy house guidebook that was in the kitchen. Everything was very clean and we felt like we were taken care of at all times. For example, we noticed that we were missing a set of towels when we arrived and we let Phil know - we we arrived home from dinner, we had a fresh set of towels waiting for us.
The house was almost perfect, and way that things were handled by the host let us know that if we needed anything, we could have had it. For example, there seemed to be a lack of regular drinking glasses. There were plenty of wine glasses, but just 3-4 normal ones. This wasn't an issue for our group, but we always knew that Phil would have fixed it if we asked. Apart from that, Phil and Fiona actively want to make this a great experience for you and following guests, so they are eager to learn if there was anything wrong or missing. This made the experience feel special and gave it a touch that most AirBnB's don't have.
Another example is that Phil and Fiona went out of town the weekend we were there and they were unavailable during that time. They let us know in advance and shared the number of a friend in case we needed anything. Of course, a breaker tripped that weekend, and we couldn't find the breaker box. We called the number and were immediately helped and informed that the breaker box was behind a painting. Just another example of how Phil and Fiona put in the work to make sure you have everything you need, even if they're not around.
Overall, we had a great time in the house. The location was perfect - in the middle of Gracia, but close to the metro and within walking distance of most major sites. It was super clean. It had a relaxing atmosphere - it truly felt like an oasis in the middle of the city. And, most importantly, we felt taken care of. We'd return here in a heartbeat and we highly recommend it!
Quick things to be aware of:
- No microwave
- Kiltro, a restaurant next to the house, is great!

We were a family of 5 travelling to Barcelona (3 kids aged 23, 14 and 12)

From the beginning of the search and booking process, Phil and Fiona were very responsive and consistent. The booking and confirmation process was smooth and trouble free. They also had a very organised and systematic pre-travel questionnaire that they sent in a timely manner, which helps both parties ensure that all details are covered and that things will progress with no problems during travel and check in.

Our flights from were massively delayed and Phil and Fiona were very accommodating with the effects of this delay on our check in. Check in when we arrived was smooth.

The apartment is very close to the photos shown. The kitchen was very well appointed with everything you could need to actually cook substantial meals if you chose to do so. The ambiance and character of their flat was great and our family appreciated it. I was especially struck by the effort taken to make the flat feel like a home: small details such as decor from all over the world as if they were collected on travels, diverse book selection in the bookcases, artworks; kid's dvd's, board games, well established plants and many more other small details gave the flat a very lived in and homey atmosphere which was much nicer than a sterile hotel. I would describe the flat as warm, cosy and welcoming.

The location was excellent; in the centre of BCN, walking distance to supermarkets, public transport, bars, excellent restaurants. The neighbourhood is groovy and local & allows one to get the feel of local rather than touristy barcelona.

All in all, I would come back and stay in this location and this flat; I would also choose to have Phil and Fiona as my landlords when I return to Barcelona. And definitely, I would recommend their apartment and them. They have many properties in Barcelona. Do check them out!

Thank you Phil and Fiona for helping to make our Barcelona visit memorable and enjoyable.

Wow, we 3 Canadians found our week-long experience in this flat and the beautiful city of Barcelona amazing!
The posting is accurate, yet the house was so much more than can be appreciated via the photographs, worth the price and then some.
Spotlessly clean and tidy, it felt like the owners had gone away from their beautifully designed apartment while we occupied their space, a lovely home away from home: interesting art on the walls; funky tsotchkes; top quality appliances and cooking supplies to cook any and all meals; a home office set-up and more.
The beds were comfortable; the linens of excellent quality. This is a large and spacious home, easily accommodates a couple or a group. We particularly enjoyed the delightful outdoor space in the centre of the house. We loved hanging our wash outside on the rack at the back of the house.
Check-in was great; Phil met us at the door and took us through the house. Phil and Fiona were amazing hosts, checking in frequently to see how we were doing, ensuring that our needs and expectations were met. Any questions we had were promptly answered.
We so very much appreciated the thorough house and neighbourhood manuals that were supplied: clear explanations for every appliance and operating system; much useful information about the ‘hood: restaurants; shopping, etc., even a walking tour was shown on the map.
Gracia is a wonderful part of Barcelona, very close to the metro and a short distance to many famous sights; walking to the waterfront is possible if you like walking. If you want to feel like you are a Barcelonian, this is the place to be. Although we were smack in the middle of a lively neighbourhood, it was very quiet inside the house.
Adios Barcelona! Gracias Fiona and Phil.
35477075: El piso bien, súper grande y con todas las comodidades. Centrico buena ubicacion. Solo una queja. En el anuncio NO indica que las tasas de " alojamiento por turismo", se abonan por separado.  Me parece poco honesto no ponerlo en la descripcion con claridad. Luego de hacer la reserva, al pedir los datos para el check-in nos llevamos la sorpresa de tener que abona 82€ extra de lo que salía el alojamiento inicialmente, ya que este impuesto se paga por persona y por día, por suerte eramos solo 4, y fuimos por pocos días. Por lo que 3 noches nos salieron más de 900€ en total. Cuando el anuncio decía 808€. Al llamar me indicaron que era un impuesto por ser " turista" y lo entiendo, pero lo que no es correcto es que NO sean claros en el anuncio y que NO indiquen que las tasas NO están incluídas. Dijieron que hablarían con " marketing" para corregir la descripción, aunque veo que no lo han cambiado aún. A parte de eso, todo bien.

Our family of 6 really enjoyed the airbnb. The location of this place is close to the metro Glacia station, and walkable to Fontana station. Within one min there’s a big supermarket where you can get anything you need. It has a washer machine that can also dry all the clothes, great for travellers who want to do their laundry during their stay.
The beds are very comfy and the place is very cozy.
The best part is that they provide dish washer detergent and laundry pods for us in a box which is very thoughtful.
Spacious rooms and living rooms makes us feel like home,
Highly recommended for everyone who’s travelling with big group .
Also, there is a great coffee shop Yako near the airbnb. Must go if you want iced latte or hot latte 💪🏾🥰
Will definitely come back next time!
Thanks for communicating very fast via whatsaaap with me ❤️

The location can't be beat! The apartment is located in the Vila de Gracia neighborhood. It is a beautiful building with a blend of modern technology amenities and sleek minimalist lines with Spanish tile flooring throughout, tall Spanish wooden doors, high decorative ceiling. It is near everything...walking distance to super market, restaurants, shops, La Sagrada, Casa Mila - Gaudi and the metro (within 15-20 min from everything including the beach). Additionally, the building is tucked in a quiet street so when you want to get out of the hustle and bustle, the apartment is a respite for some down time.
The apartment has everything you need from plates to towels. Everything was pristine.
My family and I absolutely loved this place and can't wait to come back.
6190328: We stayed here for a week, with my husband and 2 daughters, and it was absolutely fabulous! Perhaps it is one of the best i've ever stayed at. The location just couldn't be better:The neighbourhood is lively and clean, just by plaça del Diamant and Verdi street, the middle of what is going in Gracia. There is the metro 200 metres away but we barely used, we went on foot to the Barri Gotic (25min of a beautiful walk by the all modernist buildings) Another great advantage the nice small and cosy shops around, supermarket and market - just 5 mins walk from home, and you can find lots of high quality fresh fruit, vegetables, seafood and jamon for good price. The apartment itself is pretty spacious and lots of natural light. Its Rosa’s family living there during the year and renting it out for their holidays. So we felt like at home.... not unpersonal and cold feeling of a rented apartment..... Clean and well care for! There's lots of kitchenware if you prefer to cook at home. And my special admiration goes to the bed in the master bedroom - the matress was so comfortable! Loved it! There is 3 bedrooms so every one has it own bedroom. And 2 bathrooms..... Rosa was very responsive and friendly during our stay, and reacted promptly on our requests. It was a real pleasure for my family to stay in this apartment during our trip. We would definitely stay here again if come back to Barcelona, and would recommend it to our friends.

Rosa's place is in a great location - close to the metro and walking distance to most places that we went. It also felt like a real local neighborhood with fewer tourists. The apartment is a lovely place and a rare find with 3 bedrooms and 2 baths. The balcony is a wonderful feature. Nice to have a washing machine and dishwasher!
Rosa is a warm and friendly guide to the area and very responsive to issues that arose. She spent a lot of time helping us figure out where to go and places to eat. We had a couple of minor issues with appliances and she was immediately responsive to help us solve the problems. There is a dryer although it was not pointed out and we did not ask. We hung up our laundry around the apartment and it dried although because it was winter it took a couple of days -- next time I'll ask about the dryer.
One note - it was a bit small for my family of 3 grown sons. There is not a lot of noise separation between sleeping space and main rooms and the kids beds were small. I think it would be great for quieter or younger families. We also spent more time in the apartment because it was winter and because of COVID. I think we would have been out in the evenings more if not for these factors.
It is a wonderful find and I highly recommend it.

Gracia is absolutely the place you should stay when visiting Barcelona. It has all of the character of local life, without the overwhelming tourist throng of the Gothic Quarter. We loved how safe we felt in this neighborhood with many families out walking their dogs, surrounded by cute shops, fun bars, and delightful restaurants. Centrally located near a Metro stop, it’s easy to get anywhere you’d like, in no time.
Besides the delightful neighborhood, we can also wholeheartedly recommend the accommodation. It was very clean and modern, with all of the nice touches, like plenty of towels and plants to add a homey touch to the space. We really felt like locals, staying in our own home.
Then, there are the hosts! Rosa absolutely went above and beyond to make sure we had a great stay, always responding right away, taking the time to thoroughly explain where everything in the house was, giving restaurant and tourist advice, not to mention, paying for a second taxi when our first one dropped us off in the wrong neighborhood upon arrival, gifting us with some super-yummy local chocolates, and arranging our ride to Sitges after our stay in Barcelona.
Staying at Rosa’s place was like visiting a family member who wanted us to have a fantastic visit, and we certainly did!
54077502:
Casa Valeta is truly the best Airbnb experience that we've had so far.
Martin is an excellent host! He kept up closely on our arrival and made sure to receive us personally. We immediately felt welcomed by his warm reception and sincerity to ensure that we have a great first visit to Barcelona. He spent time to brief us on the apartment and also provided ideas on dining and places of interests. The washing machine broke down the day before and he promptly arranged for a new one so there was no disruption to the service.
The apartment itself was lovely. It's airy, spacious and furnished tastefully. It's fully equipped with amenities that guests need to stay comfortably for a lengthy period. The building is unique and quaint, we cherished the experience to stay in such an apartment. Getting around was easy, the apartment location is near to dining choices, shopping and places of interests.
All in all, we can't ask for a better accommodation for our first visit to Barcelona. We certainly recommend Casa Valeta and would love to stay here again when we visit Barcelona.

The two big advantages about Casa Valeta are the location and the host.
Location ; close to the Metro (3 mins walk) and top of two main streets LaRambla and Passeig deGracia. Also on the edge of the Gracia district with many unique shops and bars.
Host ; Martin is the best host we have had on ANY of our European holidays took ages checking our visit plans and recommending bars, cafes, restaurants and things to see. Kept checking in on us (using the most popular chat app) to see if wanted any more advice.
A few watch outs ; we chose one of Martin's apartments that faced the rear enclosed 'courtyard' i.e. away from the Avenguda Diagonal. So cool and free from traffic noise, however this backed onto the courtyard of a large 4* hotel opposite which seemed to host events in that courtyard nearly every night so a fair bit of chatter from guests echoing round. Also remember its an apartment block so you get the sound from above and the sounds of the lift and people talking on the stairs.

Martin was an excellent host. Rarely more than a few minutes to respond to questions. When I met him he was friendly, and spent time with me giving recommendations on local places to visit for food, drink and music. His restaurant recommendations were excellent, by the way. He was also flexible when I needed to make a change to my booking.
The apartment itself is very well located. Although on the busy Diagonal street, the apartment faces the back of the building and is very quiet. You are right on the edge of Gracia, which I was thankful for since during the August festivals the party in Gracia goes all night (so you get to enjoy the party, without the noise). It is a few minutes to the subways and main line rail stations, and those will quickly take you into the old town or to the beaches. If you are a walker, its 25 minutes to the Rambla past some Gaudi architecture.
If you want to be right in touristy old town you may want to book closer to there, but this was ideal for me.
979073: This flat is just as pictured. It's a beautiful home in a great location! My boyfriend and I really enjoyed the coziness of the flat. There was a washer there so we were able to wash clothes and hang them on the clothesline to dry. It was clear that Roberto and Elisenda had good taste in music with some posters of Frank Zappa and Led Zeppelin so that was appreciated. It was easy to get around the city from the flat. It's about a 7 min walk from the underground metro and 15 mins or so walking from Sagrada Familia. My boyfriend and I arrived to Barcelona early (11am) and we were told check in wasn't until 6pm  so we were still under the impression we were just dropping off our bags and then coming back at 6 pm for official check in but when we got there the flat was ready for us. We were taken by surprise but glad we didn't have to wander around for so many hours until checking in. Roberto was very responsive to questions I had during our stay and was helpful prior to arrival as well by giving us directions from the airport to the flat. The neighborhood itself was very safe and quiet as well. It's situated on a small street that's near different restaurants and Markets. We highly recommend this flat to anyone interested in visiting Barcelona.

Our family of four stayed here for six days and it was perfect for us! We have a 4 year old and a 7 year old who were very safe and comfortable in the bunk bed. The place was just like the pictures and was what we expected. Overall it was colorful, comfortable and very safe! I really fell in love with the neighborhood. Passieg de San Joan was right around the corner and on every block there is a playground. We enjoyed shopping the local market (Mercat de l’Abaceria) also on San Joan and the Metro station Verdeguer (about three very short blocks away) made getting around Barcelona a breeze. There are multiple great locations to eat all in easy walking distance. This is an amazing location and absolute value for families! The only small downsides was hard beds and a couple of very minor cleaning issues but frankly we had such great time that it really was no big deal. There is no washer/dryer however there is a laundromat downstairs just on the corner. It was very easy to use and you don’t need laundry soap as it’s included in the machines. Roberto and Elisenda were very quick to respond and we would stay here again in heartbeat!

Roberto’s apartment is located very centrally close to the metro in a quiet street, so perfect for visiting Barcelona as a family. It is very clean and very spacious, with a cute balcony (just about seats 2) on the street side.
The apartment has an classical vibe with beautiful old tiles in the master bedroom which is an extension of the living. The bed is comfortable and there is a lot of closet space.
Next to the kitchen , which has the basic needs, there is also a dining room with tv. The WiFi works well. On the other side of the kitchen is the bathroom equipped with the basics. I did have to some trouble getting the shower on a good temperature between cold and too hot. The toilet is in the bathroom but behind a separate door. Via the kitchen you can also enter the second bedroom with bunk bed and washing machine (which is not for guest use!)
Roberto communicated elaborately , giving a lot of advice on the apartment and the surroundings before you think to ask for it.
39404484:
TLDR; dirty, noisy and unkept
The experience for us with these apartments was horrible. The check in was alright although they make you sign a couple documents without being possible to read them.
The apartment is not like the photos, they have stripped it to the bare minimum there’s not any decorations left so it feels unwelcoming and cold like a cheap motel.
The kitchen was old and missing a lot of necessary appliances to really be worth it as an apartment, more than an airbnb this was a bad hotel.
The room was very dirty. We had to sweep and mop the floor on arrival as it was disgusting, and a puddle of liquid left behind. The bathroom was also unclean and we had to wipe the toilet with hand sanitizer. When we asked the host to clean it the staff was visibly annoyed.
The room was extremely noisy, we had neighbors making noise every single day until 4 am and the host did nothing about it, even though their pointless contract said they would.
Take your money elsewhere

Some facts: I booked 4 nights and checked out early after 1 night. The host agreed because they had gave me a different unit from the listing: instead of the studio flat, they gave us a 2-bed flat with a balcony. The receptionist also gracefully allowed a late 3pm check-out.
Now some thoughts: The "upgraded" apartment was bigger and had a balcony. Lovely except it was directly above the restaurant bar downstairs. You could hear chairs and tables being moved around, scraping on tiled floor. This is likely because the restaurant bar has a mezzanine that was directly below our unit (12). I asked for the original listing but was told the building was full so we could leave early and be refunded. Airbnb refunded me the 3 extra nights but the receptionist agreed to refund me the tourist tax for the remaining 3 nights and still hasn't one week later.
It's clean and kitchen's well-supplied. The staff is available at reception and helpful. Close to metro. All great. Really just that noisy.

- Room was clean and tidy. Towels were provided and we could check in early. Reception staff were helpful and polite. The room was spacious and the access to the pool was nice. The airbnb has good transport links with the metro and bus stop being right outside. My partner and I decided we would walk around the city to see more of it. We had a lovely weekend.  To have raised our rating we would have found a little leaflet of local places to eat in the area helpful. We found a lovely cafe for breakfast but struggled to find anywhere which looked half decent for Dinner. The Lizzaran and Mexican was really poor downstairs so I wouldn’t recommend that to anyone.  The curtains were really see through so if you get uncomfortable changing in the window the bathroom is the only place where you can’t be seen. The downside to the curtains was it let a lot of light through during the evening with lots of cars going past and the street lights being on. Very noisy neighbours but overall a nice place
33697199:
I stayed at Sandra's apartment for 10 weeks while studying in Barcelona. It was a great place to stay as a female alone in Barcelona for the first time.
Transport: Excellent, right next to the Fontana metro station and within easy walking distance of the Gracia FGC. I generally walked everywhere as the main tourist sites are not far. Gran de Gracia (the attached street) turns into Passeig de Gracia (main tourist strip) after a 10 minute walk.
Convenience: The street parallel to the one the apartment is on (d'Asturies) is great for all food shopping including lots of organic produce. I highly recommend the bakery "Mistral" on the corner - you won't miss it as there's always a line. Gracia also has some of the best restaurants and cocktail bars in Barcelona.
Apartment: The apartment is very spacious and fine for two people for a few weeks. Note that it is older, but the kitchen and bathroom have been renovated. It's also very safe (important for a single female), with a double deadbolt on the front door and shutters. The kitchen has all the utensils you need if you prefer to cook at home.
Communication: Sandra is a fantastic host and always responded immediately. She even organised for the cleaner to come a few times during my stay.

Location! Location! Location! You can’t beat this amazing little spot in the heart of the Gracia neighborhood. Situated on a quiet street, only one block from the Main Street where you will find everything you need - restaurants, cafe, supermarket, shopping and the metro station. We enjoyed cooking a couple meals in the apartment, the kitchen is completely functional. We were even able to do our laundry during our stay! We very much appreciated Sandra’s responsiveness and excellent food recommendations. She helped us check in early after a long flight from Cairo which was so appreciated.
A couple notes about the apartment…
- generally speaking, very quiet and peaceful at night but during the day the adjacent school is very noisy so not great for sleeping in.
- this place is eclectic and feels like your best friend’s apartment. That means it’s not perfectly clean and has some personal items such as photos around. We didn’t mind.
- this place is perfect for a couple, a cozy space : )

This small, quaint apartment in an historic building was just right for the two of us. We felt like part of the local neighborhood as we saw children playing at a daycare center from one of the two balconies and enjoyed people-watching on the street from the other. We used the apartment as home-base for activities all over the city that were easily accessible by the Metro. We enjoyed selecting fresh fruit and vegetables from local markets, as well as meats and wine, all within a two-minute walk of the apartment. One caution-- we maintained our cardio fitness on the apartment stairs (we would consider it a three-story walk-up in the US). They could pose a challenge if you are not in reasonable shape. A visit to this apartment will give you a taste of Barcelona city life that you just won't get in a tourist hotel. The nearby plazas are busy in the evening with tapas bars, children playing, and dog walkers. We thoroughly enjoyed our visit!
5130426: Based on how it was represented in the photos, I thought we would have a nice, comfortable stay. That was not our experience. When you walk in, we noticed the paint was peeling, and the walls were stained and dirty. The bathroom door did not close correctly, allowing for no privacy at all. All the furniture is old and sagging. The couch and pillows were stained. The drawers and shelf on the furniture in the bedroom were broken. Technically, there were two single beds in one room, but one is a cama de niño that you pull out from underneath the other and is not sturdy and squeaks every time you shift a little. The other single bed was terrible for sleeping due to old springs. The host mentioned the sofa was also a bed, but that was more stained and uncomfortable than the single bed. Unfortunately, our friend was unable to stay with us the whole time due to the sleeping arrangements. I even got locked in one of the rooms when the door knob fell off the door when I tried to get out. For what you are paying, this is not the place. The location was perfect, but we felt slightly uncomfortable staying there. The only redeeming quality was the kitchen which we used to cook a couple of meals. Overall, I was disappointed. The host company seemed nice and was responsive when I said I wasn't happy with the beds, however, they suggested using the sofa bed. The outsourced check-in service was the best part of the experience. I hope this helps someone else develop more accurate expectations about their stay here.

This apartment is in a great location in the heart of Grazia - very close to shops, cafes and pedestrian streets for wandering. There is also a nearby supermarket open 24/7.
The host was really flexible and met us to hand over the key at a time that suited us - and we changed times as well!
The apartment itself was nice - two comfortable size bedrooms, one double and one we used for our 4 year old in a single bed and our 2 year old in a cot. The host made it very easy and provided the portable cot and high chair too. The kitchen had all the necessary supplies. The living space was comfortable.
The only slight issue I had with the apartment was the cleanliness - it initially looked clean, but once you opened the drawers and happened to look under couch for a toy, I realized it was not that clean unfortunately. The shower had great water pressure but also had a stale smell.
Overall, I would recommend this place - great location and good helpful service from host, just hopefully it gets a more thorough clean next time!

We absolutely loved staying here! From booking to check out, everything went so smoothly. Alice was very responsive and so helpful. We loved everything about this apartment—from how clean everything was, to the location and how close it was to walk and explore the awesome shops around this neighborhood. The place was very clean and spacious… my whole family really felt at home.
We loved walking to the Plaça de la Vila de Gracia to grab coffee at Tiramisu, gelato at Anita’s, or onigiri at Kakigori (really yummy!). We’re currently staying at a different place over in the Gothic Quarter to accomodate more family that will be joining us but I would go back to Alice’s place in a heartbeat if I could. We really felt safe walking around day or night (which is not the case where we’re at now!) and I wish we didn’t have to leave.
Highly recommend and would definitely stay here again (but longer next time!).
16732821:
Where do I start? We had this trip planned for several months, and it was a family reunion in Barcelona... a city none of our group had ever visited. Obviously, we were all very excited to take in the sights and sounds of this beautiful Catalonian city.
Unfortunately, the first sights and sounds we took in after our check-in was that of electric saws, hammering, and workers talking in the common wall apartment next door at 8:00 am. After being awakened by the construction workers, I immediately informed our hosts of the problem. They replied with an apology and said it was out of their control. However, someone was able to obtain a concession from the construction workers that work would not begin until 10:00 am. And, while they were good about that start time until our last morning, it seemed only fitting that we should be awakened by construction noise on our departure date.
I can't impart the horrible experience that each of our group endured as a result of the construction work next door. How the hosts and/or property managers were unaware of the construction work next door is beyond comprehension. If I had been given notice about the work I would have attempted find alternative living arrangements. But that didn't happen. We were stuck in this place for the duration!
What made things worse was that there was a lingering odor that permeated the common area of the apartment. Not until my brother - the civil engineer - arrived did we learn that the odor was likely sewarage that was escaping from the apartment's plumbing caused by faulty or defective venting in one or more of the common-area bathrooms. The smell never went away, even though one got used to it once inside. However, each time we came back to the apartment after a walk about, that smell would hit us.
Additionally, the hot/cold water controls in the north bedroom bathrooms did not work properly. Only scalding hot water came out after an initial period of cool water on shower start. We informed the hosts of this problem on Saturday (April 13). Workers showed up on Tuesday (April 16) night and were unable to fix the problem.
By the way, for those unaware, construction work occurs on Saturdays as well. So, if this is an apartment you are considering, I would suggest you contact the hosts and/or property management company to find out how long the construction project wil be continuing. It looked to us that the entire apartment was being gutted, and refitted.
Finally, and a last comment about the construction work. There is a door that leads to an interior patio and to the washer dryer. It also opens to the apartment across the way. So, to access the washer/dryer, you were possibly standing next to one or more workers. So, our privacy was impacted in an even more uncomfortable way.

On a more pleasant note: The neighborhood of Villa Gracia was marvelous! Hidden gems located throughout. Easy access to the Metro and wonderful restaurants. Remove the horrendous problems stated above, and I can say the apartment was laid out perfectly and created plenty of space for each of our three couples. The bedrooms and common areas had true character and made for an excellent presentation. The outside patio deck was excellent. Late afternoon wine and cheese is a must.
I wish I could have been more positive about the unit, maybe at another time.

Our group of nine (two sets of grandparents, three teens, my husband and myself) stayed three nights at Eduardo’s place.  This apartment is managed by a rental company, I usually prefer staying at privately managed homes.  I wasn’t aware that it was a managed apartment until I received the checkin instructions, as I always communicated directly with Eduardo.  He was great at communicating and always got back to me within 24 hours.  The apartment is located in a great area with easy access to the train station, market, bakeries and restaurants.  The four bedrooms were large each with its own bath along with another 1 1/2 bathrooms in the common areas.  The common areas are small but we hung out around the dining table most of the time. It was too cold to use the terraces but they were beautiful.  Unfortunately we did encounter a few problems; the first being an awful sewage smelling coming from the bathroom in the largest bedroom.  The smell was the first thing we smelt when entering the apartment and immediately gave us pause.  We located where it was coming from and put multiple scents to try to take it away.  We contacted the company immediately and they sent someone the following day to deal with it.  I’m not sure what they did as there was only a slight change in smell, it seems to be a sewage issue, which we just had to get use to.  Another issue, while they were working on the bathroom they took the router causing us to have no WiFi. We had to use our minutes to get in touch with the rental office who informed us that the router had only been there because the modem wasn’t working and it should be fine now.  It wasn’t fine, it didn’t work.  Once again I had to use my minutes to ask them to bring back the working router.  We finally received the working router a few hours later.  Also, if you are a light sleeper you will definitely need earplugs for the two front rooms.  There is a lot of street noise that can be heard throughout the night.  I would recommend that Eduardo or the company provide and informational book for guests in regards to the apartment, appliance directions and local information on things to do.  Overall, despite some of the issues the apartment is spacious, nicely decorated and close proximity to the metro and great for large groups.

The location is really fantastic. You're just a 5 minute walk from the metro station and can get almost anywhere in the city in a matter of 20 minutes. There's also many great bars and restaurants in the area, with a neighborhood feel, and not touristy at all. There's a great square, just behind the building with lots of great places. I'm gluten free and explored some gluten free bakeries and restaurants too.
The space itself is great as well. I do wish there was more of a communal living room area, but the kitchen serves that purpose, and in warmer weather, I'm sure the terrace would have as well. It was also unclear on where the laundry is located (it's on the patio off the kitchen). I think airbnb hosts are supposed to supply toilet paper, shampoo and soap for the entire visit but we only received a starter set and were told we couldn't receive more. It wasn't a huge deal because there's a great little super market across the street.
The rooms also aren't exactly as advertised...they're better in fact. There's 3 rooms with king sized beds and 1 room with 2 queens. The mattresses and pillows were very comfortable and all the rooms were large and spacious. The little alcoves in the back to the terrace were fantastic too. Also, there's 5.5 bathrooms. Plenty for everyone. Overall, this space, in this neighborhood was a total gem and I would highly, highly recommend it.
**One MAJOR issue was that we only received one set of keys upon check in. You're supposed to receive 3. We were told that another copy would be sent to us on day 2. Day 2 came and went and we had called the rental office and the host and though they were working on it, we didn't see another set until day 3 or 4. As you can imagine, with 7 people, who all have different interests and energy levels, this was a real inconvenience. Even with 4 people, to coordinate the passing off of the keys would be a pain. In the end, we only ever had 2 sets, not 3.
10897779: Mònica’s apartment is everything and more! If my family could give her 10 stars we definitely would! Our previous airbnb reservation was cancelled hours before arrival and we found Mònica’s place and immediately booked it at 6am in hopes that it would be available. Normal check in is at 3pm but Mònica saw our message in regards to how our previous reservation was cancelled and immediately contacted me saying that we could check in at 9am! (a 3hour response time especially that early in the morning was spectacular to our ears!). Once we arrived the apartment was just as advertised if not better! Super clean and very well decorated! There are 5 beds (3 rooms), cute living room with TV, a balcony overlooking the city, modern bathroom, and kitchen with a perfect sized table. The WiFi is extremely fast also! The location was perfect as it is in walking distance to many shopping stores, restaurants, and bars/clubs. Additionally there are two supermarkets across the street from the apartment and the metro was a 5 minute walk. Lastly to top off our amazing Barcelona experience with Mònica she allowed us to stay ~3 hours after check out time and ordered us a taxi to pick us up to take us to the airport since our flight left at 6pm. Overall Mònica’s accommodations were truly unmatched and we are already planning another trip back! Highly recommend to all families or small group of friends visiting the beautiful city!

A very comfortable apartment with everything you need including a washing machine and complete kitchen. Perfect for a family with one or two kids, two couples or group of 4 friends. The building also has a lift so there is easy access to the upstairs apartment.
The apartment building is in a good location with access to good restaurants, shops, supermarkets and transport. It takes less than 30 minutes to walk to the old part of town or you buy a 10 trip metro ticket to use the extensive metro network to quickly go just about anywhere in Barcelona.
Communication with Monica was excellent and she really knows how to look after and manage her guests. She is quick to respond and was able to offer us a late check out so we could have lunch and leave in the afternoon to catch an evening flight. She genuinely deserves her status as a super host.
I can highly recommend Monica’s place as a great place to stay in Barcelona. You can probably find cheaper places to stay in the same area, but you get a decent sized apartment with a complete range of amenities that provide everything you need for a very comfortable stay with family or friends. Next time we would like to stay at least a week because there is so much to see and do in Barcelona.
Thanks Monica for your contribution to a very enjoyable time in Barcelona.

El piso de Mónica fue excelente para nuestra estancia en barcelona. Nos quedamos una semana con mi familia, éramos 6 personas incluyendo mi bebé de un año. El lugar es amplio, súper limpio y cómodo para descansar. Pudimos cocinar, lavar y hasta planchar sin problemas. Los 3 dormitorios son pequeños pero tienen todo lo necesario para estar cómodos, suficiente espacio para guardar ropa y demás. Tener en cuenta que solo hay un baño, así que eso puede hacer demorar los planes de salir temprano cuando hay un grupo grande, como nuestro caso, pero nada que un buen cronograma no funcione! El ascensor del edificio es pequeño, por lo que subir muchas maletas puede tomar su tiempo. También nos pasó que Justo hubo una ola de calor muy fuerte y lamentablemente el aire acondicionado no funcionaba por unas reparaciones es externas, pero Mónica se preocupó de poner ventiladores en todos los ambientes. De todas maneras, con el aire acondicionado seguramente el lugar será más que ideal.
En cuanto a Mónica, fue muy amable y nos ayudó en todo el día que llegamos. Siempre estuvo al pendiente de nosotros y de si teníamos todo lo que necesitábamos. Una gran host!!
Recomiendo mucho este lugar!!
891762287658652673:
Joan, as our AirBnb host and his great apartment, was perfect for us! Plenty of space as 3 (female) travelers with 3 bedrooms!...Space to put our stuff.
Easy access to walking the city, very safe area with shops close by. Must mention the excellent pizza and bakery, literally steps away from apt. (and an empanada shop for late snacks)! Much more that we wanted was so close. We walked an incredible amount during our week and truly enjoyed our first trip to Barcelona.
Joan's written online document with advice about Barcelona and our copy of Rick Steves travel guide definitely helped us plan our activities. Pre-paid reservation's necessary at some places.
Check out the map and you can see the proximity to all the areas of Barcelona. So easy to be pleased about this home base and our being comfortable with our plans each day. "Comfortable" is the key. Our chats at the start of
each day: coffee at the big kitchen table and wine as a debrief at the nights end.
Thanks Joan!

El apartamento de Joan es sencillamente excelente y Joan un gran huésped. Por la época del año en la que fuimos y por la cantidad de huéspedes que éramos, sentimos que relación precio/calidad/conveniencia era insuperable. El apartamento se encuentra en una zona céntrica y bien conectada, pero al mismo tiempo en un entorno tranquilo para poder descansar sin problemas. El edificio se lo ve muy nuevo y dispone tanto en la entrada como en la puerta del apartamento cerraduras con tecnología para facilitar el ingreso sin necesidad de recoger llaves en otro sitio ni coordinar con el anfitrión de manera presencial. Algo para destacar es que el edificio no cuenta con ascensor, por lo que es importante remarcar para aquellos viajeros que tengan dificultad para subir escaleras o grandes equipajes. Dentro del aparamento, todo lujo. Las habitaciones muy cómodas, el living muy decorado y bonito, y tanto los baños como la cocina impecables y con excelentes servicios y prestaciones. 100% recomendable!

El departamento estaba bastante bien a pesar de que todo era mini -chiquitito- los lavabos de los baños!! si te lavas los dientes es imposible no salpicar el piso porque es sumamente pequeña es para lavarse las manos y con mucho cuidado. No sabíamos que eran dos pisos por escaleras que cuando son 5 personas como éramos nosotros con 8 valijas y 5 carryon es complicado. Me hubiera gustado que nos dejaran un rollito de bolsas de residuos como nos ocurrió en todos los Airbnb por donde pasamos antes tanto en Italia como en España… es un detalle. La cocina si bien para cocinar era tan pequeña que no había mucho lugar,  podes  solamente comprar comida hecha o hacer alguna pasta. Mi esposo tiene problemas de salud no puede comer mucho afuera y ese fue un tema. Aún así el departamento de Joan estaba muy prolijo muy limpio y las cosas que señale tampoco son graves, la ubicación era inmejorable! Por lo tanto la calificación sería un muy bien! Joan es muy agradable y servicial.Gracias Joan
2078332:
Awesome apartment in what turned out to be my favorite neighborhood in Barcelona. Spent a majority of my trip eating and drinking my way through Gràcia. So many cool local bars, cafes, and restaurants just down the street. Obviously all of Barcelona is beautiful, but if you want to truly immerse yourself in the local culture Gràcia is where it's at! And you're still in super close proximity to all the must sees like Sagrada Familia, La Rambla, and the Gothic Quarter. We walked to all of those places, between 15 and 30 minutes depending on where you're going and how fast you're walking, but the Joanic metro station is only half a block away and the Barcelona subway system is really easy to navigate. The apartment itself was very safe, spacious, clean, and easy to get to. What you see in the photos is exactly what you get. Laia and Aleu were very accommodating and always responded to messages quickly.
As far as getting there from the airport...when we got in around noon on a Monday, Uber rates to the apartment were about 35€. Not too crazy, but we decided to save a little money and took the Aerobus which cost about 7€ per person. We got off at Plaça d'Espanya and then jumped in a taxi to the apartment which was 12€. On the way back to the airport after our trip we took the metro, which involved taking 3 different subway lines. That sounds more complicated than it really is, but was way easier to figure out once we'd gotten used to taking the metro after a few days in Barcelona. Definitely doable on your way in, but you might want to familiarize yourself with the subway map ahead of time to mentally prepare. Metro tickets to/from the airport are just under 5€.
Thanks again to Laia and Aleu for being such great hosts! I 100% recommend this spot.

The apartment was PERFECTLY located less than a block from the metro and in an adorable neighborhood with lots of great restaurants and coffee shops!  We ended up doing a lot more walking than we thought we would because there were so many fun places to go nearby -- incredible restaurants, La Sagrada Familia, coffee shops, cute places to see.  We found the apartment quiet and very clean, and it worked well for our family -- the kids slept in the twin bed room and we slept in the living room on a very comfortable sofa bed (more like a comfy futon than a springy sofa bed), with our brother-in-law in the single bedroom for a couple of nights.  The balcony allowed us a view of the action below and we appreciated being up on the third floor where it was quiet and we had a bit of a lookout at some of the neighborhood.  The elevator, though tiny, was super-helpful, especially at the end of a long day of walking.  Our kids especially loved the playground across the street -- it didn't seem like much, but they really enjoyed it each time we passed it!  We found the check-in and check-out process super-easy -- Aleu was warm and informative.  We would definitely stay there again, as we loved the Gracia neighborhood (away from the noisier touristy areas, but still lots of fun) and the apartment met all of our needs!

This flat is perfectly located in the northern are of Barcelona, especially if you want to escape the hectic city center life but still be rather quickly in it (we once walked to La Rambla).
The building itself is quite old but the apartment looks super modern. An elevator exists which helps. Especially the kitchen is showing off and provides all tools you need for your stay. Rudimentary flavours and cooking oil existed but if you want to cook more exotic meals you need to buy a few more. The living/dining room is easily big enough for 2 and 3 people. I‘m not so sure about the expandable couch and its use as a bed for 2 but if you are in the city for just 2 days it may be enough. The extra sleeping room (single bed) can be used as your changing room and the main 2-bed-room works fine as well. Except those 2 wooden beds. You just breath in them and they make horrific sounds, let alone changing your sleeping position.
The bathroom works absolutely fine for 2 people. It‘s quite small with no place to hang (hooks) or store (shelf) your shampoo, towels etc. That was a bit annoying but as I said, for 2 people it‘s managable. At the end, we really liked our stay and can recommend the apartment for 2-3 people, visiting the city for a few days.
856379874708120145:
This is a fantastic airbnb. Clean, comfortable, great neighborhood with lots of restaurants, cafes, plazas, and walkable areas. Also close to metro stations so it's easy to get around. We were three adults and one child (including my 78 year old mom and our 9-year old son). The place worked well for all of us.
Everything was as described in the listing and the place looked even better than the photos. Joan was very communicative and helpful.
There is some street noise at night, which we expected because this is a lively neighborhood, but the shutters and thick windows help keep the noise down. For us, it wasn't a problem. The apartment is up one flight of stairs. The kitchen is a bit small but has all the basics. We used the kitchen for making breakfasts and a couple meals, and it was fine. Beds were comfortable with nice mattresses. I would definitely stay here again if traveling in Barcelona.

This place is a gem if you are looking for good value, cleanliness, and everything that you would need while traveling. Plenty of towels, an urn and ironing board, hairdryer, coffee maker, etc., were all provided.
The bed was very comfortable. The bedroom had motorized blinds that keep the room super dark while sleeping.
Water pressure in the showers was fantastic.
As mentioned, communication was thorough and quick.
My only issue, if you want to call it that, was beyond the owners control. I have to mention that there are lots of other units nearby and you may hear a barking dog or hear a car horn or something else. This is located right off of a main street so if you’re looking for silence and seclusion, this may not be for you. If you are looking for safe, clean, and with easy access to shops, dining, transportation, etc., this is one to consider.
I would stay hear again.

From the very beginning I felt really looked after, since booking through checking in, staying in the apartment and checking out. The Host is really communicative and proactive, frequently checking if everything is find and how our stay can be improved.
In terms of the apartment, it is absolutely spacious and suitable for 6 persons. Well equipped with all the items that allow you to stay there and feel like at home. Absolutely clean and well prepared, including some starter set like coffee.
Surrounding area is really nice, full of nice restaurants and bars. Walking distance to the main attractions and with good connections with the rest of the city and the airport.
Truly recommend it!
1210009033059543378:
My partner and I stayed for 3 days.
PROS: 1. There's a very small gym area in the apt, but we didn't use it.
2. Huge TV in LR, but we never turned it on.
3. Lots of hot water and good water pressure.
4. Great office space
CONS: 1. Dishes were left in the DW when we arrived.
2. Sheets and towels left on the line outside. they never did dry in the 3 days we were there.
3. Host stated we could leave our bags at 1:30pm (check in at 3pm.) I text at 1:20pm to say we're waiting and let her know we are there. Then she says. sorry the cleaning lady isn't there so no can do on leaving your bags, OK it was a huge inconvenience but we found a storage place. at 3pm we still did not have the code to get key from lockbox. I had to text to remind her.
4. very limited kitchen amenities no paper towels or napkins
5. Apt had a strange sewer smell mixed with basement smell, NOT good.
6. Washer is outside/no dryer
7. Place is Old and a bit tired.
I can't recommend nor will I stay on my return trip.

We had a great stay at Raquel’s apartment! She truly went out of her way to assist us with all our queries and was incredibly accommodating, especially since we were traveling with an infant. We were lucky to meet her in person and put a face to the warm and attentive host who made sure we were fully comfortable throughout our stay. The apartment itself is spacious and well-equipped, and we especially loved the king-size bed — a real perk! The location is also excellent, with easy access to metro lines 3 and 4 within 10–15 minutes. While we did experience a small issue with the air conditioner upon arrival, Raquel was quick to respond and provided a helpful workaround, which we appreciated. Overall, a very positive experience — we’d happily stay here again!

Raquel’s place was in a great location.
We had trouble getting the lockbox opened due to the rain and Raquel was very responsive on helping us, even offering to send someone over to open it. Anytime we had questions about anything in the apartment, she was always very helpful and we appreciated that so much.
There’s an amazing gelato place called Cloud nearby (walkable) and we loved going there. I think the location was great! It didn’t bother us too much but it was quite noisy outside. Again, you’re in a great and safe area so that could be why. Don’t let that stop you from staying here.
We found this smoothie place called Oak Berry, so good!!
Overall, I would definitely recommend Raquel’s place. Thank you so much for the stay!
19779318:
The apartment is in a great location and it was easy for us to check in. We spent most of our time on the terrace sitting on the couches and I feel like that’s mainly what we paid for as the apartment furniture is so old, outdated, mismatched, and uncomfortable. There are 3 mismatched & old couches inside the apartment & literally none matched (style wise nor visually) and it’s furnished in the weirdest way. It’s like they threw 3 random couches from 30 years ago that they just found to fill up the space. The bathroom feels moldy as well to be honest.
It’s in an absolutely great location & the terrace was worth it tbh. wouldn’t stay here long term due to the bad apartment layout (there’s another bedroom in the back & it’s depressing to go in that area beyond the kitchen) or living room.
Being in the front end of the apartment (terrace) was great and each time you take 1 step towards the back-end (kitchen & 2nd bedroom + bathroom area) , “great” takes a 30% cut until you reach “disgusted”.
Overall, terrace was our escape & placing a couch in front of the terrace. other than that, it’s alright.

On the first day when we arrived and went with the child to the apartment, it turned out that not one of the two elevators was working, and with two heavy suitcases and two heavy bags, a stroller, and a child had to walk up to the 7th floor. A representative from the company arrived and helped to lift 1 suitcase, but it was still a very big discomfort. The apartment is clean and bright. But the wifi was very bad. In the kitchen and in the second bedroom its did not work at all. The window was damaged and did not close, and they came to us for 2 days to fix it. After all this, when we asked one day before to make a check-out 2 hours later, since the child was sick and felt very ill, they said that its just impossible. We checked by airbnb and the day when we asked for 2 hours late checkout it was available, so they didnt had a guest for that day. We didn't ask them it for free, we wanted to pay for those 2 hours. But we were refused. And with a sick child in our arms, we had to leave the apartment. Everything was fine, if the owners of the apartment, would be a little humane.

Fantastic! Great location for this big two bedroom apartment.
Checking in, did not realize we had to go to the office to get keys first, but team was quick to respond via AirBnb message and met us at the location with keys.
Cute if tiny elevator (3 people max) and stairs. Apartments closed off from elevator/stairwell so no extraneous noise.
HUGE living/dining room with 3 sofas and dining table & chairs, connecting directly to large open bedroom (with sliding door for privacy), and to balcony with very good view. Good sized bathroom in main bedroom. Kitchen good with all the amenities one needs. (Cups and glasses in the unit in the living room.) Small bedroom is just that - small - but serviceable. Same for the small bath with washing machine. (Shower is a tight fit but works well.)
Lots of nearby restaurants and shopping options. Totally safe and walkable area for a major city.
Team responsive via message and let us store luggage at office on last day after check out.
HIGHLY recommend!
11004309: This is a great apartment in a wonderful location. We really enjoyed our stay here. It's a lovely walk from the apartment along Paseig de Gracia in to Plaça de Catalunya. Some buses run along the street itself to the beach area, but we didn't use them. The apartment is walking distance from Verdaguer Metro station on line 4 (yellow line - handy for Ciutadella / Vila Olimpica / Barceloneta area) and Diagonal on line 3 and line 5. Diagonal in our experience was a more accessible metro station and it's just 2 stops from Plaça de Catalunya, so you can get to the centre very easily. The apartment itself has a lift, which is great. There are two 24 hour mini supermarkets just opposite the apartment, numerous bars and restaurants along with other shops on the street itself. Bigger supermarkets are also within easy walking distance. The kitchen of the apartment is very well equipped and had basics for cooking as well as tea / coffee and water on our arrival. Lola was really helpful in facilitating our early check in and gave us some handy tips for our stay. The beds were really comfortable and all rooms are spacious. The apartment was spotlessly clean and has air conditioning, which was great with the heat. Thoroughly recommend this apartment and would absolutely request to book again if returning to Barcelona.

Check in and out very easy and smooth. Monica's friend was waiting for us in front of the apartment with the key.
The rooms are not very spacious but enough beds for us all (5). We didn't have to use the sofa bed.
I selected 4 stars because the shower pressure was weak, and it was not easy to stabilize the temperature. The bed rooms have windows, but one facing the street is too noisy, the other windows were facing the inside of the building, so no air circulation..but of course the room has one AC so during the night we opened all the doors and used the AC. Everything worked very well and we felt very at home, and relaxed in the room.
The location is very convenient, many 24h open convenient stores near by, nice bakeries and organic supermarkets, good restaurants, Sagrada Famillia walking distance. I recommend this apartment for a family and friends who wants to explore the city, at the same time relax and rest well with your family. Probably because it's located in front of the big street, the apartment is not so quiet . The sound of the cars is always there.

Overall the flat is OK, a bit noisy for our taste given its location and being on a main street, cannot imagine it in summer months with only one Air conditioner in the living room and cannot imagine being able to sleep with the windows open. Also there is a bar below next to the entrance that seems to keep some late night visitors until at least 2 a.m. every night. We could hear them with the windows shut, that is why in summer I would not imagine being able to bear the noise, besides it being a main street. The major water pressure problem we suffered from the day we arrived (was a Friday afternoon) until Monday morning when the plumber could finally show up devastated us being four of us on one bathroom and could hardly use the shower, hot water cut off constantly as there was not water pressure. Could not shave in sink and could not use kitchen sink simultaneously to any toilet activities including flushing of the toilet itself. Ok they reimbursed us 100 when we asked for compensation without discussing it. Would not stay there again and would not recommend.
17039209:
Pros: Location is ideal as right next to a square with restaurants, cafes, stores, etc. Space is decent although much smaller than the photos. Lots of natural light. I was brought a space heater after I told them the heater didn't work.
Cons: It's a serviced apt through a company so don't expect any cozy or personal touch. Furniture is extremely cheap (I almost fell off when I tried to sit on one of the chairs). Mattress is realllllyyyyyy soft and cheap, so be ready to have a back ache if you stay there long enough. Rug is extremely dirty in the living room and no action or response was provided after I told them about it (same went with the broken chair). I had to ask for extra toilet paper (they only gave me 2 rolls for 9 days) and told me I was expected to buy my own toilet paper which I have NEVER heard of in any of the Airbnbs I have stayed in globally (and I used to host in a number of countries). The dish soap was diluted with water, again, the company is trying to go as cheap as possible. I don't mind a walk up but be mindful there are 3 flights of stairs. All in all, it was good for a last minute option but if you can look with enough time, I'd search elsewhere.

The apartment itself is excellent. It is a beautifully designed apartment with two balconies. I love the sofa in the living room and the books provided.
Shampoo and shower gel are provided. The hairdryer is quite professional. It would be great if the soft pillows and beds can be replaced as it affected my sleep. It is on the third floor with no lift. If you have a back problem, you may need to reconsider.
Surrounded by a vibrant neighborhood, you can find supermarkets, bakeries, restaurants and different kinds of shops. It is still safe even at midnight as there are still some residents walking on the streets, going home or chatting with friends.
Speaking of the location, it is between 3 metro stations with appropriately 10 minutes walking distance. Garcia station is also around 6 minutes walking distance where you can take s1,s2, L6 and L7. If you want to walk to Passeig de Gràcia, it takes around 20 minutes.
The staff Joan and Quentin are very helpful. They will try their best to meet your needs.
Definitely worth the money.

What a wonderful place for us to experience Barcelona - with a walk-out balcony on either side of the apartment, it was easy to feel connected to the neighborhood, its cool breeze, and amazing light in the mornings/evenings. The area is full of shops for any cravings - edible or otherwise - and excellent for wandering. We unexpectedly turned the corner to find a Gaudi house, then another one the next day. This place is also just a few minutes walk, in any direction, from the stations of their incredible Metro system. After a full day of exploring, it was such a relief knowing Mauri was near and still open for a late-night sack of sweets. Also consider the short walk to the local branch of Barcelona's library system, Biblioteca Vila de Gràcia, to apply for a free card that offers benefits to many attractions.
I could go on - but that might spoil your chances of a truly unique experience and surprise discoveries - you have to live it and make your own priceless memories!
5411539:
Pros: Great location, walk to Park Guell, Passeig de Gràcia, Metro
Bathroom reasonably clean; washer & dryer
Cons: Somewhat neglected, not particularly clean; kitchen outdated & neglected and not clean, floor damaged, gloomy interior, poorly designed / decorated , needs a redo.
Check in: This is a bit of a long story, so be warned :)
As stated, you will have to visit the office to get the key, then go to the apartment a few blocks away.
A few days before our arrival, received an email from Sela with lots of details regarding check in. I followed up asking for a phone #, as none was included.
Sela asked when we would be arriving, we said 15:00, she said great, keys would be available 16:00 at the latest, but maybe earlier. She said would she would message us if they were available prior to 16:00. Never got that message.
Went to the building of the office shortly after 16:00, looked around for the actual office, eventually a gentleman who worked in the building asked who we were looking for. He came back with a young man who seemed rather put out that we were bothering him, who went on at length about why weren't we simply using the lockbox for the key; I tried to explain that we were instructed to go to the "office" first, and if no-one was there then to access the lockbox. I cannot over-emphasize how bothered this guy was by the fact that he had to deal with the inconvenience of walking down a short hallway to give us the key. He went on to tell us that Sela was never there at 16:00 - of course we weren't aware of that fact.
So sadly Sela's communications were sloppy and misleading at best. Small stuff, but it all adds up.
Later we received an email from Sela with a couple of recommendations for tapas and dining. If we could have afforded those places, we likely wouldn't have been staying at Sela's in the first place.

We loved staying in Sela's apartment!
First, the location was really great -- very close to the metro which made it really easy to get around Barcelona, including the Barca Chelsea match we attended at Camp Nou! It was also an easy walk to most places when we felt like exploring on foot. It's particularly close to Park Guell and other spots near the Gracia neighborhood. The apartment itself is in a much more quiet/less touristy neighborhood with convenient and reasonably priced grocery stores and cute restaurants all within a couple minutes walk. Our favorite restaurant was a cash-only spot called Gasterea that we went to three times during our one-week stay, we loved it so much.
Second, Sela was incredibly responsive! She was very accommodating with our travel schedules: on arrival, our plane landed a little earlier than the check-in time; on departure, our flight was canceled and the airline put us on another much later flight -- Sela helped us store our bags so we could explore the city for a few last hours rather than sit in the airport all day.
As others noted, the apartment itself is cozy, but perfect for two people who are visiting Barcelona and plan to explore the city all day. A huge plus is that there's an elevator in the building, so no need to haul luggage up and down flights of stairs. The apartment was very clean, bed was comfortable, the water pressure in the shower was great, wifi and cable worked perfectly, and there was a washer & dryer in the unit. We didn't try to cook anything in the kitchen (so many great restaurant options), but we did keep leftovers in the small refrigerator.
Everything we needed for our five days! Would definitely stay with Sela again.

I love Sela’s place! I’ve stayed three times and I would definitely stay again. It's a small place but it's not cramped.  I usually sleep on the fold out in the living room and my travel partner sleeps in the bedroom so we always feel like we have our own space.  There is a small bonus room which is great for storing suitcases.  There is lots of storage space in the bedroom and in the bonus room so you can completely unpack and make yourself at home.  The galley kitchen provides you with everything you need at your fingertips. Washer and dryer work well and there is a drying rack if you prefer to dry your clothes naturally.  The bathroom has great water pressure and we never ran out of hot water. There a shelf unit with plenty of space for your toiletries so you don't have to pile everything on the floor. The WC is extremely tiny and at first it’s difficult to figure out exactly how to get inside and close the door. Once you figure it out it’s not an issue. I absolutely adore the neighborhood! It’s quiet and non-touristy and has everything you need (bank, groceries, bars, restaurants, shopping) within a few minutes walk. Plus there are some great places to see live music only a few blocks away.  When you are ready to visit the tourist spots they are easily accessible via the metro and bus. There are two metro stations within a block or two so it's really easy to get anywhere.  I love this apartment and would recommend it to anyone who wants to live in Barcelona like a local.
685348664485116872:
Unfortunately, the experience at this hotel was not ideal. The keypad to enter the main and only entrance to the building was not functioning properly, leaving us locked outside on multiple occasions in a very busy location of Barcelona
We were also locked inside the terrace area inside the building, with no other ways of exit.
Due to the fact that this hotel was remotely managed, it was difficult to communicate issues and get assistance, especially when not able to get inside.
On the final night of our stay in Barcelona, we decided to stay in the hotel as to not risk getting stuck outside once more
The original listing, as well as their listing on other websites note that they have AC. Unfortunately it was not functioning appropriately. I was told that customer service would ask if a fan were available and get back to me, but never did
Overall the hotel was clean and in a walkable location to many attractions, however our experience could have been improved upon greatly

This human-less approach is fine if there are no problems, but breaks down quickly if there are problems.
All communications are thru an app, which results in long delays, no info, and overall poor service.
1) the power went out. It took hours to get an explanation that it was the result of a gas leak nearby. No communication about when to expect power back. No info because there is no one onsite and no one local to speak to.
2) the power eventually came back on but the hot water did not restart. After useless responses in the app, the hot water was finally restarted ~18 hrs later at about 11am the next day. Again, no info communicated for planning and unhelpful responses in the app. I just wanted any kind of info so I could plan my day.
3) there is nonstop drilling thru rock in the immediate vicinity from 9am-4pm every day except the weekend. It is impossible to work or sleep if you are jet lagged with the noise and vibration. No warning, and no reply in the app about this.

Great if it works.
We had trouble checking in as our code wouldn't work.
We then had no hot water for 24 hours. They originally offered 15% for the first night as we couldn't have a hot shower but eventually came up to 25%. Not enough if you ask me considering you need accomodation to shower and sleep.
This was made worse by the fact that even though it's an air bnb there is no host. It is a company out of Berlin that relies on automated messages so I think I went through about 8 different people trying to get assistance for the water with no-one giving any clear indications of how or when it would be fixed.
The bed was also not made when we arrived and items were broken such as the toilet roll which usually wouldn't bother me but with the other issues it just left a bad taste in our mouths.
Overall the facility and location is really nice it would just be nice to have an actual host like you usually get at an air bnb to help with these situations.
7652799:
Mònica’s apartment is the absolutely most perfect location you could ask for in Barcelona! It’s just such a breeze to walk anywhere from here!
To make things even better, this apartment has a delicious empanada grab and go place right up the street, it also has two restaurants right downstairs ! We tried the one to the right as you walk out of the building. That one was great! My child who can be picky eater , loved the chicken noodle dish and it was very tasty! I had the paella for one for about 12$ and it was tasty! It was a pretty inexpensive place , my husband and other child also liked their meals !
There is a really nice 24hr grocery across the street with the basics , like milk , cereal , yogurt and every thing you may need. There is another 24 hour grocery if you take a right outside the door , go up the street and cross to the left. They gave us a new sponge, for dishes as well as a dishea
While walking there , you’ll see a bakery which has the BEST chocolate croissants!! So many other things as well! YouI will never regret staying at this amazing apartment.
This place has every single thing set up perfectly for a family! The bed in the front that has access to the balcony is like the side of a Queen bed, but is two beds put together, however, I never woke up from my husband moving around and had perfectly great night sleeps! The kids rooms were two single beds one of them actually has a trundle bed underneath, the trundle bed under the couch can also fit another child .
So , basically , you could bring 4 kids and be just fine! We had two with us and they absolutely loved the apartment and slept so well!
I really cannot understand anyone thi
nking it’s noisy there, it is not at all! It was such a restful place with everything you need. !
