Monica was so incredibly kind! She accommodated our late flight and made sure to answer our texts super quickly and helped us get the kids into the place to rest after the long airport line for customs at the Barcelona airport ..
Last but not Least Shower had the best water pressure and never lost its warm water ! This place is perfect and you will have zero regrets and a wonderful time at her place!

Monica and her colleague were so fast at responding to our communication. When my mom showed up sick on the day of arrival (we had been traveling so much that she was so exhausted), Monica's colleague was very concerned and offered to help us as we needed to ensure our mother was okay. She even followed up the next day to make sure our mom was feeling better.
The apartment is in an amazing location. You can walk to all of the main sites to see in Barcelona (or atleast the most important ones) within 15-30 minutes. We mostly took taxi and bus as the weather was unfortunately cold and wet when we went. The place feels very cozy and homey. I liked having my own little room after sharing a room with my family on previous vacations. She provides you with enough linens if you get cold and the heating is good enough for the apartment.
She also provided us with coffee, tea and snacks on arrival which was a nice touch! She gave us a map and showed us areas to check out and recommended using the subway and hop on hop off bus tour.
Overall, our experience in Barcelona, despite the weather was made to perfection because of the comfortable place we had to come how to every evening.
My only complaint is that the owners above the apartment are rather noisy, you can hear heavy footsteps all day long. Monica was nice in trying to get them to be a bit more quiet and followed up with me the next day to ensure that they were a bit more quiet, and they were. :)
Thanks for the lovely comfortable apartment you provided to us during our stay! I would stay here again if I came back to Barcelona! <3

Lola was the perfect host & really easy to communicate with. The apartment is in a really great location, lots of coffee shops, little bars & a fantastic churro shop all on the door step!
The apartment was very clean and felt new, Lola met us as arranged and showed us around, loved the fact it had some basic things like coffee, tea, washing up liquid hairdryer & washing machine etc. It was very clean and tidy.
This is the best apartment and location we have been to (& we've been to Barcelona many times) it's not in the manic tourist area yet it's so close to the beautiful diagonal & passeig de gracia with all its designer shops. We found lots of great restaurants on Rossello which suited us and the kids (Nice people, margarita & vevotapas) we got the bus from right outside the apartment direct to Nou camp for the stadium tour & familia segrada was about a 15 min walk away. The Olympic port is about 10 mins drive (taxis are cheap and easy) Las Ramblas is a 30 min walk away but it's lovely to walk down too from the apartment. (We also hired bikes)
We saw comments about the noise from the road in the main bedroom, it didn't affect our stay at all, yes you can hear the cars at peak times but with such a great central location it's to be expected & it didn't stop us from sleeping! We can't wait to go back! Thank you Lola & Monica
3292049: Everything about Cristina's space was perfect. The location in Gracia is ideal. You are in the heart of the neighborhood that you will end up wanting to live in. There is everything you need within minutes including coffee, cafes restaurants, bodegas, grocery stores, bakeries, pharmacies, shops, barbers, tattoo shops and Mercat de l'Abaceria with its fruit, vegetable, meat, cheese and seafood stalls. The plazas are a treat to sit in, have a coffee/beer/wine and watch life swirl around you. It is a real neighborhood where people live and know each other. The neighborhood feels completely safe at all times. It is  convenient to the L3, L4 & L5 metro lines and the metro is very easy to utilize. The apartment is spacious, stylish, comfortable, well stocked and private. You enter a nondescript door into an inviting space with 2  bedrooms, each with full baths, separated by the living room and a courtyard. Ideal for two couples or families. The glass walls of the living room, hallway and one of the bedrooms open to let air circulate and create a large open space. The kitchen is large and well equipped with dishes, glasses, cutlery, cookware, good size oven, refrigerator, cooktop and even a dishwasher. The washing machine is located in one of the baths and works well with a quick cycle. The kitchen, dining and living areas form a large space with plenty of room for a dining table, 2 sofas, bookcases with board games and many books in several languages, large screen tv, dvd player and well stocked cd and dvd library. The large courtyard has a  table perfect for breakfast or relaxing with a glass of wine in the evening. The check in/out process was a breeze. Communication with Cristina was quick and always pleasant. She provides good local knowledge and tips for everything you will need. Getting to meet Cristina is reason enough to stay here. She is enthusiastic about her neighborhood and you will feel at ease and welcome as soon as she opens the door and says "Welcome home". If I could give everything 6 stars I wouldn't because I would give it 7. Cannot recommend Cristina's space enough. It was a joy to stay in and we feel privileged to have done so. Would not stay anywhere else when we return to Gracia and likely will plan our trip around availability.

Our host, Cristina, was peeking out the door as our cab drove up. She hugged us warmly and was as excited as we were as she showed as around the "casita". She was clearly very happy to show us her beautiful home and to share it with us, we felt great from the first moment. Wonderful way to begin a month. During our stay we contacted Cristina several times and she immediately got back to us with great advice. She also checked up on us a couple of times just to see if we needed anything and to make sure we were happy.
The home looks exactly as photographed and described; we had looked at the photos so many times that we felt like we knew the place inside and out once we were finally there. This is a special property. It is very interesting architecturally, has a beautiful mix of modern with original stone walls and slate floors, and the furnishings are simple and functional, well thought out and homey. A perfect balance of comfort and style.
The other thing is in addition to being beautiful, the home is so well-stocked. There is an abundance of cooking and cleaning supplies, fresh linens, paper goods; everything we needed. We unpacked our bags and were home. I also appreciated the organization and efficiency of the space. Everything was easy to find and easy to keep clean.
Gracia, we felt, was the perfect neighborhood to stay in. It is a small, authentic village within a huge city. During the day it is quiet, pretty streets with small cafes and pastry shops, trendy boutiques, and plazas to sit and read. At night it comes alive with families in the squares, people strolling, eating and drinking in outdoor spaces.
It is in a great location too, about a ten minute walk to the subway and from there about seven minutes to the busier areas. After visiting other neighborhoods we were always so happy to return to quiet Gracia. Really felt like coming home.

I cannot say enough about how perfect this place was for us.
First, I have to give a big acknowledgement to Cristina, our host. There was terrible weather in the United States which caused our flight to be cancelled and rescheduled multiple times. Our arrival time changed at least 4 different times. Cristina was very patient and understanding through the entire thing. She repeatedly called the taxi driver she had arranged for us to let him know of our problems. Despite getting in 6 hours later than expected the driver was there ready and waiting for us.
Now for the apartment. It is located in a the charming area of La Gracia. There are multiple fantastic restaurants only minutes away by foot. We always felt very safe and one of our favorite things to do was to walk through the streets in the evenings to discover the many plazas, shops, bars and restaurants. The Diagonal metro stop is only about a 10 minute walk away. We rented a car for two days to make day trips out of town and there is a parking garage just around the corner. The apartment itself is very nice and spacious. The bedrooms are on either end with the kitchen and living area in the middle. This was perfect as some in our family are early risers so those that wanted to sleep would not be disturbed by those that were awake. The living area is especially comfortable and has lots of space. The court yard was very nice to sit out in the late afternoon and sip some great Spanish wine we bought from a fantastic wine shop Cristina recommended only 5 minutes walk from our door. There were 4 of us on this trip and we had plenty of room.
This is really a great option.
17039207:
My husband and I stayed in Joan's apartment for our 3 weeks in Barcelona. It was exactly what we wanted. In my opinion, the Gracia area is the best part of Barcelona. Easy to get to all the tourist sites either by walking or via public transportation without being in the middle of many tourists. Everything we needed was very convenient…groceries, bakery, those famous markets, butchers. We also discover many excellent places to eat. At times we felt like the only tourists.
The apartment was well designed and comfortable for the two of us. The bed and pillows were great. The kitchen was nicely equipped for the minimal food preparations that we did. The terrace was a big plus especially because of our warm sunny days. It was quite large. The WiFi was fast and the cooling and heating system worked well. The TV had Netflix for times we needed to relax at home. Of course having a washer/dryer combo was very nice for our longer stay.
Our host Joan was very responsive. He got back to us very quickly and even contacted us when he thought of something we might need. He helped us navigate the European appliances.
The building was on a small street and felt very secure. There was a busy restaurant near us but with the windows and terrace door closed, it was quiet in the apartment. We slept very well. The church bells were lovely. There are 3 flights of stairs (42 in all) to get to the apartment, but with a bakery on every corner is that a bad thing?
Would definitely recommend Joan’s place!

There are two types of Airbnbs. There are the ones that are run by a local hosts, offer lots of charm, are thoughtfully decorated and feel like a home away from home. Then there are the ones that are run by an army of agents that provide you with a copy of the house rules, the day and night charge for calling them in case you lose your keys and a designated check-in and check-out time that doesn't allow for any flexibility. Joan's place falls into the second category, which for me contradicts the “shared economy” image projected by Airbnb. I did not appreciate the attitude of Joan and his agent when I had to wait 40min outside of the apartment and was blamed for having changed the check-in time by one hour earlier that day. I also don't think it is justified to charge £140 for cleaning and admin on top of the nightly fee. If you are looking for a place that does it's job with a nice terrace in a lovely area, I can recommend this apartment. It is certainly clean and the information provided is accurate. If you are looking for a charming place, flexibility and most importantly human interaction, this is not the place for you. Enjoy Gracia, it is a wonderful area to explore!

Joan's place was perfect for our 6 days in Barcelona. We arrived late in the evening and Joan had a friend who met us to let us in the apartment. Communication with Joan was good, anytime I needed a question answered, Joan was quick to respond. The apartment is located in Gracia, which is convenient to so many places of interest in Barcelona. Our neighborhood itself was quaint, lively, fun and not touristy. The Placa de la Vila de Gracia, the town square was a short block away. There are several restaurants, bars, gelato shops and more surrounding the square and in the evenings it is bustling with local families, young people having dinner, talking or the kids playing in the square. The apartment is very nice. It had a full kitchen, including dishwasher. There is a washer/dryer combo which was great to have. The bed was comfortable and separated from the living area by a glass block wall. the bathroom was spacious and the shower was a little small but worked great.
The part we loved the most was the terrace. It was perfect for relaxing in the evening after a full day of exploring Barcelona. We would definitely stay again on our next trip to Barcelona.

Ricard's flat is exactly as it was described. It was clean and spacious and stocked with everything we needed as well as lovely, high quality linens. The Gracia neighborhood was incredible-close to 5th Avenue style stores on Passeig de Gracia but filled with tons ofsmall local shops. Very "un-touristy". All of Barcelona is within walking distance from our flat, even the Mediterranean Sea!
Ricard could not have been a more wonderful host. He answered every email (filled with our questions!) within minutes. He made himself totally available as our translator/concierge when we needed him for that- including making contact with a doctor when that became necessary. We stayed at Ricard's place for 7 days and enjoyed having such a great Barcelona home-base for our family of five (three teenagers). The apartment was the perfect size for our needs, and having the added outdoor "patio" space was a helpful option. The apartment was clean, well-outfitted, the beds comfortable and all amenities as advertised. Ricard himself (who lives in the same building) was always very quick to respond to any question we had over the week, and provided clear and organized instructions and suggestions in a binder in the apartment. The Gracia neighborhood is truly ideal - still very central, but just outside of the main bustle and noise of the city center. It is just a short walk to a couple of main metro stations that can take you most places you want to go. We now wish we would have spent more time exploring Gracia itself! It's a very cool section of the city with small boutiques, cafes and restaurants, and we only really had a good look around near the end of the week. Having looked at most areas of the city during our stay, we are convinced that we chose the right area to stay in, and would definitely stay at Ricard's again if we come back to Barcelona!

This is a clean and comfortable place for a happy visit to Barcelona!

This apartment was in a very cool area of Barcelona with many bars, restaurants, and shopping nearby. Metro stations and bus stops were also close, and many main attractions were walking distance. The apartment was cute and clean, but also had some issues that people need to be aware of.
Be prepared to buy basic amenities, we stayed for 6 days and were only given 2 rolls of toilet paper. Some cleaning supplies were provided, but we did have to go buy laundry detergent to do our washing. There is a small market close by, which was convenient. Be prepared to hand wash your dishes.
It appears that other flats in this building were also AirBnBs, so expect a lot of noise from people with their suitcases in the stairwell, at all hours.
Another warning is that, the power will go out on you if you use too much at once. This was a consistent issue for us, almost daily. So be prepared to cook with the lights off, and if you’re doing laundry - good luck doing anything else.
Also, if you take a shower longer than 4-5 minutes, it will go cold on you because the heater is so small. And don’t even think about 2 showers in a row.
Most hosts provide a manual for their apartments, but this one was very sparse. I recommend including some information about what to do when the power goes out, and maybe a warning about the shower heat.

The location was good, close to shops, supermarkets and restaurants and 5-7 minutes walk either way to the Metro stations. We enjoyed an evening drink sitting outside at the lively Plaza de Gracia around the corner and had a pleasant meal at Godot cafe within metres.
If the host had spent just a few euros on the basics, eg. A non-slip shower mat, more rubbish bags and toilet paper, kitchen & bathroom basin plugs, a light blanket, decent chairs, etc. we would have had a far more comfortable and enjoyable stay.

Overall, the apartment was quiet. Just some noisy birds that seemed to make their home in between the apartment buildings. The windows were old, so they didn’t shut completely to help with the sound.
The terrace was lovely with all the plants and areas in which to relax. I didn’t use it as much as I’d like to because it was so warm when I was visiting the city. By the time I’d get back from exploring, I’d want to shower and stay cool in the AC.
I felt like some of the furniture could be updated and it felt a little cheap (table, chairs, armoire, bed, couch). However, there were a lot of warm decorative touches throughout the apartment.
The apartment had the smallest shower ever. I couldn’t even bend down to shave my legs without opening the door. It was very challenging and made me feel as if I was showering in a camper sized shower.
Also, the kitchen is more like a closet. If you plan to do a lot of food prepping and cooking, this isn’t the place for that.
The apartment was situated near a metro station, but I felt like it was challenge getting anywhere on the metro. It seemed to take a long time and I would always have to switch lines. The bus seemed to work out better for me. However, transportation isn’t the fault of the host. I just want future guests to be aware of that. Maybe it’s just because Barcelona is so spread out.
And, I loved having an elevator. Walking up and down about six flights would’ve been the worst with luggage and after a long day of explorations.
One more thing that I thought was special was the host had a couple of notebooks with handwritten notes that guest had written about their stay and some local recommendations.

Angeles was a considerate hostess. Communication prior to arrival was good and she arranged pickup service from the airport, which made things a lot easier on our end. Although she wasn't able to meet us at the apartment due to a work conflict, she made sure to explain everything via email and checked up on us during our stay. The apartment itself was okay. Located on the top floor, the space is as described on the site. The wraparound terrace is a nice bonus, with a lovely view of Tibidabo hill. The bathroom and kitchen are very small but functional. The shower left a lot to be desired --it was a very tight fit (I am a slim girl, about 5'6", but knocked my head on the knobs a few times because of the lack of space) and the water temperature wasn't as consistent as I like. The first night, I only had the hot water on and still had a lukewarm shower! Angeles left us wine, some goodies and tea/coffee, which was very sweet of her. Unfortunately we ended up not drinking any coffee/tea because we found the water boiler to be a bit dirty. To be fair, it probably was more old than dirty but we didn't feel right boiling water in it so we opted to get our hot beverages outside the apartment. That was a disappointment as I imagined myself having my morning tea on the spacious terrace. Oh well. The neighborhood is residential and people are friendly --it isn't close to the tourist sites so some people may find that inconvenience not worth the stay. TIP: We had a wonderful dinner at DID Platets, which is located just around the corner from the apartment. The owner is very very nice, the food was delicious and the house white wine was wonderful.
43235980: Location of this apartment was perfect, there are heaps of places to eat, little shops etc around. All the big attractions are about a 20-30 min walk or a quick cab ride away. The apartment itself was clean and tidy. We were supplied with a welcome pack of dish washing soap and cleaning cloths plus a couple of laundry pods and a couple of dish washer tablets. The Bathroom had soap, shampoo and conditioner all attached to the walls in pumps and there was just enough toilet paper to make it through our stay. The kitchen had basic cooking bits but no microwave. We stayed in a 2 bed apartment and the master bed was a generous size and very comfortable. The second bedroom was a single with a trundle and a desk. We had to move the desk out to access the second bed(this just gave us an extra bench top in the kitchen so it worked well). The host was great with heaps of communication and instruction before we arrived and there were a few issues that he responded to immediatly. Pablo also was accomodation so we could use the parking for a bit after we checked out. The parking is great very secure and right under the building, you do need to book this ahead and there is an additional cost. Overall a great stay in a crazy cool city, Thankyou

After staying in many European Airbnbs this summer, it was very refreshing to stay in such a modern apartment with central AC and other amenities such as a dish washer, elevator, and a dryer. The apartment was therefore well equipped and pristine upon arrival. The location was also excellent located in the heart of Gracia, which ended up being our favorite part of Barcelona because of its walkability, plethora of restaurants, and local feel. One word of advice for anyone staying here: DO NOT leave either pair of keys in the lockbox. We had become accustomed to doing this when we went out for security purposes, but the lockbox at this place is actually a shared space and is used for every guest's check in. We were told not to use the lockbox, but WHY we should not use it was not explained clearly to us. It's also
worth nothing that the only way for the two beds to fit in one of the bedrooms is to move the desk out of the room and even then, they're basically stacked on top of each othe

We were traveling as a family with our 4-year-old and 2-year-old. We absolutely loved the neighborhood and apartment location, and would go back to Gracia in a heartbeat! The apartment was nice, well maintained, and overall had a good setup for our family. We ran into a couple of challenges with things we'd confirmed in advance that weren't ready for us. We'd confirmed in advance that we need a travel crib for our 2-year-old but it wasn't dropped off until the 2nd day of our stay, and we'd confirmed onsite parking and agreed on the price in advance but parking instructions (which were very specific and not intuitive) weren't shared in advance. (The host said it was because we hadn't paid for parking yet, but when I asked how to pay they asked us to pay in cash, which I wouldn't have been able to do in advance.)
Overall we had a great stay, loved the neighborhood and liked the apartment. I'd just suggest double or triple confirming anything special you need to make sure it'll be ready.
1127467824016941933:
Piso bonito, limpio y bien equipado, con camas y sofá cama muy cómodos. Cocina con muchos detalles (cafetera, tostadora, hervidor) y un gesto amable al dejarnos café. Aire acondicionado, wifi y TV.
Está en la segunda planta sin ascensor, con escaleras estrechas e incómodas; por ello, subir las maletas por ahí se te hace un poco pesado e incómodo. La entrada del edificio no refleja lo bien que está por dentro. Ubicación excelente, en pleno centro, con todo cerca, aunque es imposible aparcar en la zona a menos que sea pagando en un parking. Las tasas turísticas no están incluidas en el precio, lo que me tomó por sorpresa.
En general, una estancia muy buena y con un anfitrión atento. Gracias!

Alojarnos en el departamento fue una hermosa experiencia! Creemos que la relación y comunicación con el host es muy importante y aquí fue brillante. En el medio del Apagón que le tocó atravesar a España Toni estuvo atento y preguntando todo el momento.  El departamento está ubicado en una zona muy cómoda y fácil de acceder a diferentes lugares y para combinar transporte. Apartamento cómodo y funcional, escaleras empinadas pero nada que no se pueda sobrellevar. Recomendamos mucho alojarse aquí. Gracias Toni por hacer de nuestra estadía en Barcelona un hermoso recuerdo ❤️ Repetiríamos sin dudar.

Thank you Toni and the Art House Team for a great stay. The apartment was fabulous, pristine, very comfortable and had everything we needed. Something as simple as the olive oil and vinegar was a great touch and very much appreciated. We loved the location -  great restaurants, shops and supermarkets but a quieter neighbourhood. We love walking and found it very easy to walk everywhere we needed (40 mins to La Rambla - 25 min to Sagrada Familia) but it is also well serviced with metro and bus services too. Many thanks again.
959089:
WOULD I RECOMMEND? YES, YES, YES!
Right from the moment you walk in, the Carbonells make you feel right at home. I would highly recommend staying here if you've never been to Barcelona or if you're a returning visitor. I couldn't speak more highly of Sean, he's definitely made my first experience in Barcelona memorable and beyond anything I could have ever expected :) I wish I could've stayed at this flat my entire stay. Such a sincere, warm, welcoming family. Next time I visit Barcelona, I will definitely stay here again! Sean is reliable and generous with his time. I couldn't have been better taken care of during my stay!

FIRST IMPRESSIONS
After a 6-7 hour flight, on 3 hours of sleep, there's nothing better than having someone greet you at the door, help you with your luggage, offer you espresso and fresh fruit while the apartment is finishing being cleaned. I was able to take a shower, nap and acclimatize to a new time zone and surroundings with ease, and got to know the Carbonells better.

Once I awoke, Sean showed gave me a tour of the apartment, showed me where everything was and answered any questions I had. There is also more than enough information made available on transit, tours, museums, restaurants, maps, etc. for those new to Barcelona.

THE APARTMENT
The apartment and building has a rich architectural history and stunning design. I had everything I needed during my stay: a fully stocked kitchen (with fresh produce, refreshments, pots/pans, spices, utensils, etc.), all the essentials (fresh towels, soap, shampoo, hair dryer, clothing iron, laundry (which I didn't really need to use)) and more than enough space for my belongings (storage for my clothes, an office area for my laptop and electronics, etc.), etc. While there's no A/C (like most of the older buildings) with fans and the cool breeze that came in from the windows, you wouldn't even notice! I was more than comfortable and cool at night. There are also double doors for all the windows to minimize the sound of traffic from the street - I slept well!

From the apartment terrace you can see also see Park Guell in the distance. It's a lovely nook to have breakfast in the mornings. I also enjoyed starting my morning with a swim and being able to enjoy the gardens.Having access to the pool and backyard was wonderful!

While I'm here for another 4 days, Sean has been generous with his time and I've really been able to learn about the various neighbourhoods, each with their own architecture, histories and communities. I've been able to delve into the food / cocktail culture as well. It's great to learn and experience a city from someone who loves and appreciates it.

All in all, if you're looking for a unique experience and a great "home" during your stay, I'd highly recommend the Carbonell's flat. You will not be disappointed!

When I first saw this listing whilst surfing the airbnb apartments for let in Barcelona during our six nights in the city I figured that it was too good to be true. A two bedroom modernisma flat at the foot of Park Guell? Steps away from a metro stop? Not to mention the reasonable price? Could it be?

My husband and I didn't need that much room, but as I poured over the pictures, I couldn't resist the idea of staying in a privately owned part of Barcelona's famous architectural history, owned by actual Catalan architects.

We placed the reservation, Sean replied promptly, and we anxiously awaited our time in Barcelona. We climbed the metro steps and recognized the building right away. It was more beautiful than even the pictures could capture, with beautiful stucco, and lovely ironwork.

Sean met us and led us into the apartment via a private marble staircase that led up to the flat. I won't describe more about the flat, only to say that the pictures are more than accurate with their reveal of high ceilings, pristine original modernisma style features, and thoughtfully chosen furniture. I would love for every person who invests time and money into renting this flat to have the same moments of amazement and delight as they receive the detailed tour from Sean, complete with the building and flat's history.

If I had never seen Sean, or visited with his dear family, and even if he had not kindly stocked our kitchen with bread, fruit, jam, eggs, juice, milk, butter, and bottled water, not to mention coffee and every spice and oil known to man, I would implore you to rent this flat. The flat alone is that amazing. It sits at the upper end of Gracia, and you can walk and train it everywhere. We felt completely safe in the neighborhood, and while you can hear the traffic from the street below, it is quiet for being in the city. The beds were soft and the sheets were so comfortable. The bathroom is huge. The kitchen is petite, but as I mentioned, it has everything. We took our breakfast every morning in the gallery (an enclosed balcony with beautiful windows that open); we often cooked at night. We found it hard to leave the flat.

Sean and his family stay in the flat opposite to this one across the hall, and they made our stay very special. They went out of their way to make sure we were comfortable, and it is their touch and love of the building that gives it an incredible glow and beautiful energy.

I would say that the flat is ideal for everyone, but I might advise that if you have very rambunctious or destructive children, maybe this is not the flat for you. The flat is historic inside and out, and any damage to it would be tragic. However, if your children are well behaved, by all means.

We'll be back, and can't wait.

Wow, where to start?!? This flat was gorgeous beyond words! It kind of feels like you're staying in living artwork.

The Carbonells make you feel instantly at home and it was really more like staying with dear, old friends than anything else. Sean met me at the door and helped me with my bags (which was quite the endeavor as I was making a 3 1/2 week tour of Europe and there were quite a few rather heavy bags). He gave me a full tour of the flat and gardens and told me about the history of the building and the flat (did you know that the adjoining apartment where the Carbonells live is the Mother's flat in the film "All About My Mother" http://2.bp.blogspot.com/_WNLxW9X3P1o/TUbyQPMJ8nI/AAAAAAAABUY/8zF4N5noCZY/s1600/6766073_gal.jpg). Sean even had some delicious snacks for me in the kitchen in case I was hungry!

The bedrooms are spacious and comfortable. There's a lovely balcony overlooking the main road that allows for great people watching while enjoying some delicious Spanish wine and tapas. The living area is huge. The kitchen and bathroom are perfect.

I was spending a weekend in Barcelona by myself after having been there for work during the week. The space was rather large for just one person but would be perfect for larger group. I'm a bit of an extrovert so I was worried about being bored and lonely but the first night I was invited by Sean and his cousins to go see some Flamenco and enjoy traditional Spanish tapas. We had a blast and I felt perfectly at home!

On the last day of my stay, Sean even drove me to the airport and helped me get my massive amount of luggage situated. Such above and beyond service all around.

I'll be staying here on any future stays to Barcelona as well :).
51386019:
I stayed at Anna’s place with my husband and my mom, who is an elderly lady, but for us, it was not an issue to get to the address or the apartment. The steep streets and staircase should be considered, though.
Anna is the most caring and considerate host I’ve ever met. Upon our arrival, she gave us comprehensive directions on how to get to the nearest metro, nearby places, metro card options, and more. During our stay, we came across Anna casually on the street, and it was lovely to have a chance to chat and exchange impressions.
It’s easy to catch the metro to the city centre, and the neighbourhood itself is a beautiful, quiet area to spend time in, like a breath of fresh air in a noisy city.
The apartment is very comfortable and has everything you need for cooking at home, washing and air-drying your clothes. The living room has a large, welcoming table where we spent our evenings cooking and dining while looking out at the park and watching people walk or jog with their dogs.

The perfect location for views and a quiet night. Barcelona is a very hilly place so expect sore calf’s if you’re not a walker. With park Guell across the road, it’s the perfect place to take a walk to for some good photos. We found that it was about 35 minutes to walk to the sagrada Família. There’s 2 shops round the corner from the apartment which is perfect as one of them doesn’t close until 11pm. The apartment was very clean and was easy to keep on top off. The only thing I could really knock it for was that there was no air con in the room. As we stayed there for the f1 weekend, we found we were in need of the aircon after being in 30°c heat all day. There was also no oven but not a big deal when there’s lovely places in the city to go eat.
Without a doubt, this apartment is top of the list of places to stay at when we come back to this amazing city.
Thank you Anna for the amazing accommodation

We had a wonderful stay in Anna's apartment; it was clean, well presented and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
We arrived late at night, and were met as we got out of the taxi by Anna's husband, which was so reassuring in a new place. He spent time showing us the apartment and explaining transport links and location of shops, as well as assisting us with booking a taxi for our journey home. Nothing was too much trouble, they were fantastic hosts.
Be prepared for hills, but it was worth it to be away from the bustle of the city after a busy day and to overlook Park Guell, it was a peaceful and safe feeling area.
The metro was great and saved our aching legs as the apartment has 2 stations close by.
We couldn't recommend Anna's apartment enough and thoroughly enjoyed our time in Barcelona.
773886: We were surprised by our experience here because we have never felt the need to point out more glaring issues on the part of a host (we've stayed regularly with Air BnB) and because Phil and Fiona get good reviews. Our first issue was that we communicated to our hosts that we were traveling with a one year old baby and baby gear and asked for transportation advice. Phil suggested we take the train and metro to their location--our instinct was to take a taxi but we figured we should trust the local (and we had just navigated our previous stay in Munich very successfully on metro even to the airport). We arrived at a station where Phil told us to transfer and were unable because there were no elevators or escalators. Friendly locals told us the metro was unreliable in this way and helped us carry our baby gear and baby in stroller out of the metro to find a taxi (lovely Barcelona community spirit). This delayed our arrival and when we arrived, Phil was gone. We called and he said he waited but had to leave. The issue is that he had not informed us that he had a window of time after which he would leave (we would have immediately taken a taxi if time was an issue and yet he suggested train and metro with transfers). He said he'd return in 30-45 minutes but we waited over two hours first on the sidewalk and then in a local restaurant with our bags and toddler. He did apologize profusely and helped us carry our bags up the 100 stairs or so to the place. This is the only major drawback to the location by the way--the apartment is perfectly located in Gracia (our favorite Barcelona neighborhood) about a 20 minute walk to Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia and a stone's throw from the great restaurants, bakeries, and vibrant scene of Gracia (check out Mama's for breakfast favorites as well as late night chilling out and La Bicicleta for great local tapas scene and Chok for amazing chocolate truffles, cronuts, etc.--I was surprised, though no big deal, that Phil had no favorite spots to recommend when we asked). We also found local produce markets and stalls with organic choices and nice street market scene as well. Back to our stay--when we called to ask about the non-functioning TV (Phil had explained it but we couldn't get the power on) and a dining table light that was out, Fiona responded that the lights and the TV do work and we should simply look harder for the plug/switch and that Phil had demonstrated how the TV works though he had not and she had not been there. The no nonsense tone was a bit disappointing (Phil and Fiona are property managers of a number of spots by the way--nothing wrong with that but we like when we can find a real local with hospitality). Then one day we left...

We arrived with great hopes, given the positive reviews to date and the price we paid. We were told we were paying a premium price as it was a busy weekend in Barcelona but the facilities remained equivalent to a lower price. We had a pretty poor experience of this apartment and its hosts. We had numerous maintenance issues that impacted on our stay: air conditioning not working for the first three days, the washing machine not working for the last three, and small electric shocks off both the washing machine and dishwasher, particularly concerning as we were there with kids. We also raised some further feedback to the hosts that was rapidly dismissed, line by line, with the hosts quoting back more favourable guest comments to invalidate ours. It was a remarkably inhospitable way to respond to a negative guest experience, barely an apology nor any recompense. 
So bring your own cassettes and cds for the 'vintage' Bang & Olufsen stereo - or you can listen to the pirated cds from the early 2000s. Bring your own devices - or you can watch pirated movies via an old media player attached to the TV screen but the TV won't operate for any other purpose. We needed to purchase a range of basic supplies such as tablets for dishwasher/washing machine/olive oil etc and throw out the herbs and spices that dated back to 2013. The listing includes 'TV', washing machine, air conditioning, cooking basics etc, but unfortunately not so for us. I had to spend a large portion of our week in Barcelona reporting maintenance issues and dealing with the consequences, including the host arriving at the apartment to tell me how upset he was by the feedback. The apartment is well located, lovely tiles and features, the Internet connection is good, but it really feels like this apartment has likely generated a lot of income, without much investment back into the guest experience. The hosts' repeated assertions that everyone else had been happy in the past with their stays did not make us feel any better, nor did it address the inconvenience or impact on our holiday. I hope that if you chose to stay here, you find all the advertised features in actual operation.

This was an ideal place to make our home while exploring Barcelona. The apartment itself is wonderful -- it's large, light, and airy, and feels very homey. The high ceilings really make the place feel so spacious, and the tile floors are gorgeous. The apartment is fitted with modern french doors and windows throughout, and these do a freakishly good job of blocking street noise. It's very quiet with the windows closed, and there are AC units in the main living area and the master bedroom which can prevent the apartment from getting hot and stuffy when it's closed up. Phil and Fiona were very responsive, and typically answered e-mail queries within a couple of hours. They were also kind enough to arrange a 5:00 a.m. taxi to the airport for us on our departure day.

The location is great. Gracia is a wonderful area, and the apartment is a very short walk (4 blocks) from a number of pleasant plazas and the Carre Verde area, home to wonderful shops and tapas bars. At the same time, the Joanic metro stop two blocks away makes the whole town readily accessible. It's three stops from there to Passeig de Gracia, from where you can pretty much go anywhere on the Metro or Renfe trains. We did get a little over-familiar with the infinite pedestrian tunnel under Passeig de Gracia... but it's better than making the same crossing above ground!

All in all, highly recommended. I would book this apartment on a return trip to Barcelona.
17039203:
Overall, we enjoyed our stay at Joan's place. Here are some pros and cons to consider when planning a trip to this great city!
Pros:
- Communication was easy and pretty smooth. Our flight into Barcelona was delayed, and Joan was understanding and responded promptly to my messages. Keep in mind that this is a company with many airbnb/rental units, so you'll be checking in with a different person. Check-in was smooth but it definitely felt like a business transaction. I didn't mind this but don't expect it to feel too personal.
- Location is ideal for everything. We walked to most sights and activities, and it's also close to the metro. The area is more touristy than I imagined, but it was still quiet at night and residential, which I appreciated.
- Great outdoor space to lounge in and hang out in the mornings and evenings.
- Blockout shade in the bedroom worked well. Bed was pretty comfortable.
- Generally clean and spacious.
- Did I mention the location?
Cons:
- I stayed for 5 nights and expected to get an extra towel or two, but this place is pretty minimal in terms of amenities. Each person had exactly one bath towel and one hand towel. That was it. No bath mat/towel, no extra rolls of toilet paper, no shampoo/conditioner, no body soap. This was ok for the first few nights, but we ended up having to buy a 6-roll pack of toilet paper on the last day, and it was annoying. We wanted to spend every minute enjoying the great city rather than going to buy toilet paper!! But perhaps this was actually the "locals" experience. :)
- There's a tourist tax that needs to be paid in cash at check-in. Maybe I missed this, but I'm pretty sure I didn't see it in the English description. It was a slight inconvenience to have to run to the ATM when we finally reached our destination at night.
- The place is generally clean, but there was an odd white bed sheet covering the sofa and we weren't sure if that was covering a stain or was meant to prevent guests from dirtying the sofa. In any case I didn't pull it off to look underneath. There was also mold growing in the dishwasher door hinge.
- Yes, you have to climb up a lot of steps. I didn't mind this too much because I knew what to expect.
Would I stay here again? I probably will try another place in Gracia, if I'm lucky enough to visit Barcelona again!

Overall this is a great rental, with only one negative. We would certainly consider staying here again if we ever return to Barcelona.
The apartment itself is exactly as pictured, very spacious, modern and spotlessly clean. The place was well equipped with glasses, cutlery, crockery, a hairdryer, etc. The location is ideal, a five minute walk from two metro stations to get about if required. Gràcia itself is a beautiful area with lots of great restaurants, cafes and shops. There was an information booklet left with comments about the local area which was very helpful. As previously mentioned there are a lot of stairs as this apartment is on the top floor and no elevator, however this was not an issue for us but is something to take into consideration when booking.
The only negative is that this rental is quite impersonal when compared to other Airbnb's I have stayed in. The apartment is clearly one of a few owned by Joan and so is managed by an agency who we mainly dealt with on arrival details and at check-in. The agent was 30 minutes late to meet us, despite the fact we arrived at the apartment at the time predicted by the agency and kept them up to date as to our progress from the airport to the city. Moreover, when checking in we were met by an agent who seemed much more interested in completing the paperwork and getting the city tax fee, than welcoming us into the apartment. Maybe I have been spoiled by my previous experiences but this rental was missing the personal touch I have come to enjoy when staying at an Airbnb. I missed being greeted by an enthusiastic owner who explains the best things about the area based on my preferences, or being left a little care package with a few local products to get us started. That this rental was lacking these things was by no means a deal-breaker, it is again just something to consider when booking.

The apartment is really nice! It is very true to the photos, except that when we stayed a large sheet had been put over the couch (which presumably we were meant to sit on, instead of directly on the couch???) and a plastic cover had been put over the table. Both had the effect of feeling to "cheapen" the apartment and make it less homely. It was a shame as the furniture underneath was very nice.
The terrace is lovely, with a nice deck chair and table setting. The bed was very comfortable and the bathroom was nice too.
We enjoyed the location in Gracia. A fun area to stay in.
As other reviews mention, there are a lot of stairs, so you should consider whether you can get your luggage up there! The person who did our check in kindly carried one of our suitcases up the stairs.
It is unfortunate Joan doesn't provide much in the way of amenities. No toiletries were included. We had to go buy more toilet paper during our stay. There was also only 3 coffee capsules provided (we booked 3 nights, but surely for 2 guests you could provide at least 6 capsules) and only 2 dishwasher tablets. It seemed like unnecessary cost cutting...the apartment is comparable to the price of a nice hotel and it would not cost much more for enough of these things to be included. It's a small gripe though - just be prepared that you may need to make a visit to a supermarket during your stay for these items.
1951405:
While the Gracia neighborhood is one of the nicest in Barcelona, this apartment needs many improvements to make it a pleasant place to stay. We arrived, the apartment was hot, the AC not functioning properly and leaking water and no fan or other equipment to cool the apartment.
Monica was only reachable after a period of time because she was driving.
When we could reach her by telephone, we did not get a lot of remedies but a focus that so many people had liked this apartment. Not being able to get any remedies and with the apartment still hot, we left after 30 minutes and found alternate accommodation.
In our opinion, the apartment needs repairs and improvements, some equipment needs to be provided such as fan, TV/flatscreen, outdoor furniture, and some equipment needs to be improved such as kitchenware and coffee maker, and better furniture throughout including couch, bed, and a place to hang and put clothes.
In our opinion it is only fair to say that, the apartment needs equipment, furniture, some painting and a lot of TLC. The cost to make the apartment pleasant is really not that much considering the cost of this AirBNB rental.
We are not sorry that we left the property after less than 30 minutes, not being able to get some remedies to the situation and realizing that some remedies would take time. In our opinion, although it is a great neighborhood, the condition of the apartment and the lack of good locks made it not a reasonable place for our five night stay and we spent money to stay in a reliable hotel.

Had a great week staying at Monica's apartment in Gracia. The location is great - outside of the main tourist areas but the vast majority of things we wanted to do were reachable in less than an hour's walking time and the apartment is in an excellent area for using the metro - with a stop just a few minutes walk up the road from the apartment and another slightly further in the opposite direction. These provided quick routes to everywhere we wanted to go and the metro itself was very easy to use. Monica was helpful in explaining where the nearest stops were and which tickets to buy. Gracia itself is a great area with a very laid-back feel and plenty of shops, bars, cafes and restaurants. As a vegetarian I was pleased with how many veggie restaurants there were in the area and we were very glad we chose to stay in this neighborhood. The apartment was perfect - it was clean, modern and well decorated and the perfect size for two people. The outside terrace is absolutely huge, bigger than the apartment itself and provided great views of the city. All the furniture and utilities were clean, stylish and well kept and absolutely everything we needed was provided. If I had to make any suggestions I would say that more could be done to utilize the terrace space though overall we were very happy with the apartment and would definitely return, and Monica was a great host, very helpful and friendly!

Monica's apartment is located in the very heart of Gracia. Gracia is a very lively and old area of Barcelona, where you can experience authentic Barcelonian living, with plenty of small fruit shops, bakeries, dairy shops, as well as supermarkets and trendy boutiques. There are bus stops and metro stops within walking distance, and taxis are very easy to catch on the street. It is a very central and busy location, but you can barely hear the street noise in the apartment, which is located on the sixth floor. There is a lift to the fifth floor and stairs from there to the apartment.

The apartment is cosy and perfectly sized for a couple. The 100 square meter rooftop terrace off the living room with chaise long chairs and a clothes line is a great plus. We had people over for dinner on the terrace a couple of times, and the evening views are fantastic (including La Sagrada Familia and Tibidabo). There is another balcony off the bedroom, facing north east.

Monica was very helpful and responsive. Whenever we had any concerns, Monica addressed them personally and immediately. The check in and check out were very easy and straightforward.

The apartment is modern and well-equipped. It's filled with sun all day long, and makes for a very enjoyable and comfortable stay.
1229996:
We had a great stay in Barcelona at Sandro’s wonderful apartment.

First off, Sandro was great about communicating: he provided guidance on getting to the apartment and getting around Barcelona before we arrived. He had a helpful guide to apartment and the Gracia neighborhood where the apartment is located. Sandro also did a good job giving a tour of the apartment on our arrival. Make sure to pay attention to the explanation of the front door and keys. We didn’t have any problems with them, but they were different from the keys and locks we’re used to in the U.S.

The apartment is very well situated. The Joanic Metro is less than a 5-minute walk, and La Sagrada Familia was a 15-20 minute walk. We took a short cab ride to and from Park Guell, but if you wanted to get in a good workout up a steep hill, it would have been walkable also (and certainly would be on the return trip). The neighborhood near the apartment is filled with small markets and wonderful little restaurants and bakeries. If you have kids who are used to eating dinner early, it’s worth noting that some of the tapas restaurants in the neighborhood don’t serve dinner until later in the evening.

We were amazed at the attention to detail in the apartment. The décor is warm and made us feel like we were at home. In a city known for its great architecture, the apartment fit right in. Even the television stand in the living room reflected what appeared to be a custom, hand-crafted design. We stayed in the master bedroom on the main level, and our two children stayed in the bedroom one level below. The stairs are a bit narrow and steep, but we had no issues with them. The bedroom on the lowest level also nice was very useable, as long as you don’t have a problem negotiating stairs. There are two patios, and provide great places for enjoying a relaxing evening with a glass of wine.

Sandro was a gracious host, and we would most definitely stay at the apartment again if we visit Barcelona.

Sandro's apartment was a great base for my family of four to explore Barcelona. It's located right near the Joanic metro stop in Gracia, close to a few different grocery stores, and there are lots of small streets, shops and restaurants to explore northwest of the apartment. (We had a great lunch at the Cuban restaurant directly across the street.)

Things to know about the apartment: All of the windows are light/air shafts, which means no view, but also insures very little street noise. We slept well and the beds and linens were comfortable.

The apartment is on the ground floor, so the second bedroom and bathroom are one flight of steps down to the first basement level, and the third bedroom is down another very steep flight of steps to the sub-basement. Again, there is adequate light and air from a light shaft (and a patio in the basement with both a washer and a dryer that we made use of) but I wouldn't reccomend those rooms for the very young or the very old. Basement construction also inevitably comes with a bit of musty dampness -- worth knowing if you're sensitive to allergies. (We had no problems and would stay here again.)

The living room was a comfortable place to hang out after long days seeing the sights.

The kitchen was well equipped (four burner stove top, oven, dish washer) and we cooked a few meals. My only complaint would be the mildew smell from under the sink, likely due to water getting into the cabinet from the sink above.

The shower was great (once we figured out how to use the handles...) and the heating units kept us warm on chilly nights.

Sandro was extremely helpful, not only arranging for us to be picked up at the airport at 7 am (for a reasonable cost) but also mailing us a jacket that we had left in the apartment. He was responsive to emails during our stay as well.

All in all a solid apartment and we would be happy to return.

We booked this apartment based on the glowing, 5 star reviews; what we got was the complete opposite. We stayed in many vacation rentals in the past and this was the first time we encountered a listing that was misleading. We found the following issues:
* Major issue with humidity in the two lower level bedrooms. Dehumidifiers needed to be run 24/7 to combat the humidity and smell (not disclosed in listing). They are extremely loud units (two on third floor and one on second floor). The worst part was the stench from the humidity. I felt like gauging every time I went down to the third floor to do laundry. My son refused to sleep in the third floor bedroom due to the awful smell and the loudness of the dehumidifiers. The humidity and associated mold spores in the air is definitely a health issue and anyone with allergies should steer clear of this apartment. There was some sort of leak with water dripping from the third floor ceiling our first night which made the air quality even worse. There was also a puddle of water on the floor in this bedroom when we checked-in and toured the apartment with the Lorena.
* This is a 3 story apartment with two subterranean bedrooms (this is hard to discern from the description and pictures). You have to go down steep steps to access them (not recommended if you have children or someone not agile or has mobility issues). We felt they were dangerous when we went down them.
* Be aware that there isn't A/C throughout the apartment. There is only one in dining area and one in master bedroom. The two lower levels that need it the most do not have A/C units. It was extremely hot in the lower floors even in the evenings and no way to cool them down except for fans which were not very helpful.
4618852:
This is a small but cozy studio-apartment with a in a great location!!
As noted, the neighborhood is surprisingly quiet taking in consideration Grácia is a lively area. Marta was very responsive and communicative through the app but entrance to the place was coordinated with a different person.
Kitchen is equipped with appliances but not with essentials so we went to a nearby grocery. Adding some essentials will be a nice hospitality move -salt, oil, tea, sugar, coffee, water.
This place served our remote working needs.
Our only inconvenient was that it was hard to sleep on the first night because the AC faces the living room area not the bed- which is separated by a long wall-.
It is a small unit and it took hours to cool the entire place - on a hot Summer in BCN. If you turn the AC on and never turn it off you will be ok, but if you like natural ventilation it may be a bit difficult to keep yourself cool. After our stay, I suggested the owner to get a ceiling fan that allows air flow. It will really be a good addition!!

Marta and Paul's apartment is fantastic. I could go on and on-- the place was absolutely spotless, the kitchen was thoughtfully outfitted with the things you need to actually cook, the wifi is speedy, and the apartment was well-laid out and beautiful. I'm a light sleeper and found the apartment extremely quiet-- there was barely any street noise and we didn't hear the neighbors at all. Most importantly, this apartment is in a fantastic location on a quiet street, but close to the wonderful eateries and shops of Gracia, and 4 minutes to the Metro. You are just far enough removed from the tourist hustle and bustle but can easily access it in no time. There is a great coffee shop on the corner, great bars and restaurants within a block, and everything you'd need is within 5 minutes.  From the start, Marta and Paul communicated proactively and made sure we had arrival instructions and someone was there to give us keys the minute we arrived.  Would book with them again in a heartbeat.

1. Overall: Extremely cosy and comfortable. A home-away-from-home. The bed faces the window/patio which I am a big fan of. We enjoyed glimpses of the sunrise and sunset from the window/patio.
2. Description: Accurate. The space actually looks even better maintained than in the photos provided. We were pleasantly surprised.
3. Location: Tucked away in a peaceful, safe neighbourhood but walking distance to fabulous restaurants/bars and shops. We took the metro daily as it was very nearby and it is only a few stops from popular sights.
4. Cleanliness and amenities: Very clean and well-maintained. We made use of the hair dryer, washer, and oven - they all worked well. The heater works better than those we encountered in other airbnbs in Spain (we travelled in Winter and are not used to the cold).
Will highly recommend for an authentic homestay experience that you can't wait to tell your friends and family about.
52121562:
This is a fabulous Airbnb with everything you will need for a lovely stay in Barcelona. Sofia was so helpful and friendly and on site most days to help with anything you might need. Communication was great.
The area is safe and the apartment is off the main road so manages to stay very quiet considering how loud the city can be. Plus the sliding glass balcony doors are doubled so that helps.
The place was super clean and everything felt brand new. The AC worked like a dream and the kitchen had everything we needed. The washer/dryer was a huge bonus traveling with kids and made it so we didn’t have to pack as much because I could do laundry mid way through the trip.
The shower was great and having one sink and mirror inside the shower and toilet room and one right outside that was super helpful with four people getting ready at the same time in the morning.
Things to note: 1) It is best for a family or very close friends because it is a studio, so not a lot of places to have your own space or privacy in the bathroom. That said, my family of 4 with two kids ages 8 and 11 never felt it was too small.
2) The curtains are quite sheer, so bring an eye mask if you need darkness to sleep.
3) The top bunk doesn’t have a guard rail. So keep in mind if you are bringing small children. Although, maybe that is something they could provide if you ask..we did not ask.
Other than that I couldn’t recommend this place more! It’s in a lovely area surrounded by shops, restaurants, cafes, markets, etc and a one minute walk to the main road to catch taxis that can get you to all major sites in 10-15 mins. I highly recommend!

Our experience was all around 5 stars. Our check in process was easy. Ezequiel was so incredibly kind and helpful, a wonderful host. We feel very fortunate to have met him, and had some great conversations. The place was designed brilliantly, with fantastic use of space. The kitchen had everything we needed to make several meals. The view from our room was beautiful (quintessential Barcelona), and the blackout shades were super awesome. They helped us get much needed sleep to acclimate to the time change. The bathroom was very nice, shower pressure and heat was perfect, with high quality toiletries provided. The neighborhood was exactly what we were looking for – everything very close by – just minutes to walk to restaurants, squares, shops, grocery, cafes– as well as many of Barcelona’s sites.  The Gracia neighborhood has such an incredible energy. We also loved the rooftop patio views – had drinks while watching the sunset on the city on several nights. Could not recommend more!

The neighborhood was great with lots of commodities around.  It was very easy to take the metro which was at 6-minutes walk distance only.  We could get almost everywhere within 20-25 minutes.  During our trip, the Gracia Festival was ongoing so it was lots of fun.  Sofia was always very helpful and responsive and we got everything we needed.  The week we were there, it was extremely hot outside and since we were at the last floor, the AC had a hard time catching up.  It was not that bad and  definitely better than outside but we were not able to get the temperature below 24.5 degrees.  We really enjoyed the terrace on the roof.  It was always very quiet and we were often alone or just with another group.  In terms of comfort, the beds were comfortable, the kitchen was big enough, everything was great.  We definitely recommend :)
5178129: The contact per Email and whatsapp with Ariel was positive from the very beginning, so we had a good feeling going in. He was waiting for us at the apartment at the agreed time, even though we were running late due to lost luggage! The apartment is just as it appears in the pictures, charming, super clean and with state of the art appliances. Ariel had prepared a personalized map of the neighborhood that made exploring easy. There are mini-markets left and right and a supermarket just around the corner. So fantastic to have the metro practically at your doorstep, too. A real luxury to ride back home after dealing with the crowds in the town center. We felt safe on the metro and in the neighborhood even after dark. I enjoyed the feeling of being practically the only tourist when we walked around Gracia: People of all ages just minding their own business, but always friendly when asked for help. You hear the usual urban sounds from the apartment, but we always slept well. The air-conditioner is also practically silent and yet efficient. It was such a treat to come back to the beautiful apartment and relax after sightseeing. There's even a little balcony overlooking the street. I'm a people-watcher, so that was enjoyable for me. Ariel not only answered my texts promptly during our stay, but also went as far as to arrange a taxi pick-up after my Spanish (not to mention lack of Catalan) did not cut it. And our special request for an exercise mat was met without hesitation. I wouldn't think twice about booking this apartment again, and I'm a person who likes a little luxury. This is luxury at half the price!!! So glad I didn't choose some noisy 4 or 5 star hotel!!! Thanks Ariel, for creating the perfect home base for our trip!!!

[ENGLISH] The floor is extraordinary! It has everything that you need, internally and externally, to enjoy a memorable stay in Barcelona. Despite being in an old building, the apartment is super clean, stylishly decorated and has all the necessary equipment (and more) to enjoy it. The location is very good to visit the most important tourist places of the city, both walking (if you are an active person) and by subway (two or three minutes from the floor is a subway station that connects very well with other lines). The neighborhood, besides being iconic in Barcelona, is very quiet and safe. As for the communication with Ariel and his team (Paloma and Liz) it was very effective, respectful and professional. At all times they were pending my arrival and needs, until my departure. Great hosts! ...... [ESPAÑOL] ¡El piso es extraordinario! Cuenta con todo lo que se necesita, interna y externamente, para disfrutar de una estancia memorable en Barcelona. Pese a estar en un edificio viejo, el apartamento está súper limpio, decorado con mucho estilo y tiene todo el equipamiento necesario (y más) para disfrutar del mismo. La ubicación es muy buena para visitar los lugares turísticos más importantes de la ciudad, tanto caminando (si eres una persona activa) como en metro (a dos o tres minutos del piso está una estación de metro que se conecta muy bien con otras líneas). El barrio, además de ser icónico en Barcelona, es muy tranquilo y seguro. En cuanto a la comunicación con Ariel y su equipo (Paloma y Liz) fue muy efectiva, respetuosa y profesional. En todo momento estuvieron pendientes de mi llegada y necesidades, hasta mi partida. ¡Grandes anfitriones!

What can I say, if there were a sixth star for all little unexpected extras...this place would deserve it!!! There was a basket of fresh fruits on the table, milk and a couple of beers in the fridge and noodles, spices and condiments in the cupboard. They even had electrical adaptors for anywhere you come from. We stayed 3 nights and they supplied us with a local intelligent phone including both wifi and 4G. The apartment is spectacularly located at 2 minutes walking distance from the subway station and 15 minutes walking to almost anywhere downtown. The furnishing is modern and of very good taste...We already miss the plush master bedroom mattress (queen size but soooo comfortable). There is a TV in every room with cable. The communication was better than excellent. All and all a very excellent stay!!!!
And just to tell you how nice these people were... they did things that were completely outside their mandate
Of supplying us with a decent place to stay. We arrived a little upset as we were victims of pickpockets between the airport and the apartment and our passports had vanished. Both Liza, who was an angel from check in and Ariel who was was a somewhat of a saviour (on a Sunday afternoon waiting for his brother) helped us in our quest to find some sense of the whole thing, communicate with the authorities, helped us make a report and printed documents so we could get our documents in order.
Thanks a million Liza and Ariel...see you in September 2019
1329067:
Apartamento en ubicación privilegiada, en el barrio de Gracia y muy cerca de la zona de Passeig de Gracia y Plaza Catalunya.
Cerca de todos los servicios necesarios (supermercados, farmacias, ...) y de gran cantidad de restaurantes/bares/cafeterías así como tiendas. No es necesario salir del barrio ya que hay de todo.
A destacar el buen aislamiento de la vivienda, ni el ruido exterior ni el calor se notan con las ventanas cerradas, de hecho no era necesario tener el aire acondicionado siempre encendido y eso que durante nuestra estancia hizo mucho calor en la ciudad.
Apartamento pequeño pero suficiente para las tres personas que nos alojamos. Muy bien equipado, con todo lo necesario (útiles de cocina, baño y ropa de cama).
Totalmente recomendable. También tienen opción de parking en el edificio, aunque nosotros no lo usamos.
Hubo un problema eléctrico en el portal que nos impedía la entrada, pero después de contactar con el teléfono que nos facilitaron se solucionó en 10 minutos, aún siendo domingo. La persona que nos atendió, se desplazó en ese tiempo al edificio y fue muy amable.

First time visit to Barcelona and the apt location was perfect for us. We were a couple and it was in an area where all amenities were at our fingertips or within walking distance - food, taxi, convenience store, bars, tourist attractions, and shopping. I enjoyed the dryer with the washing machine, helped us dry our clothes faster.  However, having just one washing pod for 5+ days of stay is unrealistic. We bought our own pods and carried on. It’s a commercially run property and their office staff are downstairs during work hours, in case you need anything. We had an issue with the alarm of the fridge beeping every night, they tried to fix it but it was still beeping the next day. We didn’t use kitchen amenities much so can’t comment on that but while doing Uber Eats, we realized they didn’t have any salt and pepper in the kitchen. I think a set of that would be helpful. Overall, we were happy and the bed and pillows were good and comfortable. I would stay here again if we came back.

Great and spacious apartment in one of Barcelona’s most vibrant neighbourhoods. It is just 3 mins walk from Diagonal metro station, and there are other metro stops just round the corner. Plaza Cataluña is just 2 stops by metro. There you can get the bus to the airport (it takes just 35 mins). The street where the apartment is located is quite nice full of delicatessen shops, small wine bars and restaurants. It is super close to so many nice spots in Gracia neighbourhood: squares (plazas), shops, cafes, restaurants and independent fashion designers. The apartment is super clean and has everything you need for a short, and a long stay. The bed and pillows are quite comfortable - I really appreciated that as I have back and neck problems. I did a bit of cooking in the apartment during my stay, and all worked perfectly fine. They have a locker where you can leave your luggage after the check out. That was a plus. I highly recommend this place!
53323226:
Raul and his property is everything previous reviews have stated. The property is exactly how it is pictured and described.
This property has everything you will need for a stay. All the touches are personal and so very thoughtful. The location is fantastic - 10 minute walk to Sagrada Familia - and lots of great restaurants close by.
Despite the proximity to all the action this property is very quiet and peaceful.
Everything is super clean and in excellent condition.
Now, to the host Raul....He went out of his way to be a helpful and caring host. We had a 3 night stay and each day he would send local recommendations for things to do, restaurants to try out, markets, supermarkets, Barcelona highlights etc. His local knowledge is invaluable and my husband and I would not have found some of these hidden gems, without Raul's direction.
Thank you for hosting us, Raul. You and your home made our stay in Barcelona unforgettable and we are truly grateful. Keep up the great work.

My wife and I stayed at Raul's for five days. It was the perfect base camp from which to launch our daily expeditions. Further, we enjoyed coming “home” after a long day of exploring and relaxing in the cozy, comfortable environment that Raul has created. The meticulously clean apartment exceeded every expectation we had. The attention to detail was singular. From Raul's warm greeting and orientation to the fantastic bottle of wine these weary travelers needed upon arrival, Raul is the consummate host.
The apartment is ideally located just a brief stroll to Sagrada Familia but on a quiet pedestrian street away from the noise of traffic. Around the corner we found everything we needed or wanted nearby - great restaurants, markets for provisioning, etc.
The pictures of the apartment are not deceptive. If anything, they don’t convey the meticulous care with which Raul has provided for an extended stay in comfort, style and practicality. Thank you, Raul!

The apartment is a gem in the middle of Barcelona!  It is a lovely one bedroom apartment that included everything that you would need for a comfortable stay.  It is close to public transportation if you want to ride the metro and extremely walkable to restaurants, local boulevards for a stroll, and many of the famous sites that you will want to see such as Sagrada Familia, Park Guell, or the gothic area of the city.  Raul was extremely helpful with recommendations for sites, restaurants, and local walking areas.  He also gave suggestions for the Costa Brava outside the city.  He was extremely attentive during check-in and made sure that we were well on our way to an interesting and fun vacation and addressed any questions that we had.  Lovely area, lovely city, lovely people, delicious food...if you are going to Barcelona, rest assured that this apartment is wonderful and Raul will guide you every step of the way to ensure that you have a wonderful vacation!
52121349:
We are a family of 4 ( myself, my husband and our 13 and 10 year old sons) from the uk.
We had the most wonderful stay in Barcelona and can’t sing the praises of this apartment enough. It completely exceeded our expectations. The apartment itself was so big and spacious and had everything we could have wanted for our stay. Spotlessly clean, with really comfortable beds, great showers and big tv with netflix etc on and good Wi-Fi, (which was great for kids after busy day exploring the city). We loved the location, as felt away from the really touristy areas, while being close enough to to walk to everything and the area felt very safe and had everything we needed right on our doorstep in terms of shops, bakery etc.
One of the best bit of this Airbnb is the newly completely roof top terrace, which we loved taking our morning coffee/ pastry up to and sitting in the sunshine. Like wise it was a great place to sit and stargaze with our boys in the evening at the end of the day.
Sergi, the host, was so welcoming and happy to help with all our questions and always extremely quick to respond to anything we ask or advice we needed, such a fantastic host.
Value for money for the Airbnb was amazing to and we will 100% recommend this to any friends we have who want to stay in Barcelona.

Excelente lugar para quedarse en Barcelona, primero fuimos recibidos bien amablemente por el host el cual esperaba por nosotros en el apartamento, el cual nos regalo una botella de buen vino como cortesía. El lugar esta en una excelente ubicación cerca de estaciones de metro las cuales nos llevaban a lugares como La Sagrada Familia, Casa Batlló, Casa Milà y Park Güel. La comunicación con el host fue excelente y lo mejor fue que nos guardaron las maletas LIBRE DE COSTO, luego de entregar el apartamento ya que necesitábamos un poco de tiempo debido a la hora de salida de nuestro tren. El precio esta excelente para tan bonito apartamento, lo recomiendo para grupos de 5-6 personas. Para finalizar el complejo cuenta con una terraza en el techo perfecta para tomarnos el vino de cortesía y compartir entre nosotros luego de un largo día de paseo por Barcelona. Gracias Sergi por tu excelente servicio y tu amabilidad.

This Airbnb was perfect for our needs! There is a lot of space and we appreciated the huge 8-person table. The beds are very firm, but still comfortable. Washer/dryer works well. Shower pressure and temp were great. Kitchen was a bit sparse so we ended up not cooking. No dishwasher and no microwave. One bedroom facing the Main Street was very noisy late into the night. Note this area of Barcelona is not particularly friendly to tourists. We also could not find a taxi company nor Uber to take us to the train station upon departure. They told me they don’t have taxis in this area. The Metro is a 10-15 minute walk. Despite these negatives, we still had a great stay and would highly recommend the Airbnb. The guys working in the downstairs “reception” were super nice and helpful.
2327444: This place is really really nice and Jordi is one of the best hosts I've ever experienced in my (many) Airbnb stays! We were warmly welcomed personally upon arrival, feeling very welcome from the start. Apartment is in a great neighborhood , in Gracia, in a nice pedestrian street with loads of small local shops, bars, restaurants etc. Supermarket next door, fresh bakery on the corner, vibrant squares around the corner and 500 meter (5 min) walk to the Fontana metro station. Really an ideal place in the city to go to all the famous places. We walked to Park Guell and Casa Mila / La Pedrera. We walked to Sagrada Familia (25 mins, or take L3 metro in only 15 mins). We watched FC Barcelona play against Villarreal in Camp Nou, which is only 30 mins by metro. And we went to the Barceloneta beach in only 25 mins by metro, so traveling from Jordi's place was very convenient! The apartment itself is very spacious, with two different sides connected through a 10 meter hallway (good for steps tracking, haha). The double beds are quite small in width, so in case you are used to a 1.80m or 2.00m bed at home you will face a challenge with your partner :) There are also 2 single beds up high, with steep stairs. So max 6 spots but 4 if you want to sleep really comfortable. Kitchen, bathrooms (there are 2!) and living room are all nice and well equipped. There's a TV with Netflix so you can watch anything you like in case you have the time for it. WiFi connection was super steady and strong. Small patio if you like to sit outside, however very small surface and totally enclosed between the buildings. Still nice because the complete apartment is quite long and narrow, so to see some light and air is appreciated. Jordi arranged for some small provisions in the fridge upon arrival (juice, milk, butter, coffee) which is such a nice, friendly gesture! Much appreciated. He also has tons of recommendations for restaurants, bars and everything you ask for. His communications are always with lightning speed, replying to everything you ask him. And he took the extra mile with providing us extra sheets that appeared lacking, bringing them personally on the same evening we arrived. That's what I call a "super host", gràcies Jordi! I
