Jordi is an exceptional host. His communication was prompt, he gave great advice with truly local expertise. He also showed great concern for our welfare during our stay, making occasional contact without be the least bit intrusive.
We quickly felt completely at home in his lovely apartment which is in a vibrant area in Gracia with plenty of bars, cafes, bakeries and restaurants in the immediate vicinity. The best coffee we have had so far in Europe was just around the corner which we had every morning before setting off to take in the sights of Barcelona. We like to walk and did walk to all the major attractions like the absolutely amazing Sagrada Familia. We also walked to Park Guell, Casa Batllo and also as far as the Marina. I realise that some people might not like to, or be able to walk this far so they can take the Metro which is a couple of hundred metres at the end of the street.
The bed was comfortable, there were two bathrooms and a washing machine which was much needed by this stage of our holiday. The apartment is at street level and we found it thorough relaxing to open the shutters and enjoy watching and listening to the buzz of the activities in the street both in the day and night (when we were at home). Notice how easily I called it home!
Our only concern about giving Jordi’s a place the highest possible rating is that it might encourage more people to book it and that it might not be available when we come back!

Fantastic location in a fantastic city
Not in the most touristy location, it is in more of a real neighborhood called Gràcia. 5 minute walk to a metro station (Fontana - L3) that is the best line for easy access to all the major sites. Also 6 minute walk to another metro station with more access (Joanic - L4)
Lots of restaurant options in the area too, we tried several and they were great including Gatamala and Taverna el Glop.
Host has great communication and met us to let us in and get us settled. He also helped arrange a big taxi to take us and our bags to the airport after our stay. Some minor inconveniences like the washing machine not working but the owner was very responsive and easy to contact. Temperature very comfortable with AC throughout even on hot days. Kitchen well stocked and there is a good large convenience store literally next door with anything you need. Located on a quiet car-free street and on the first floor, very easy access with lots of bags.
Bunk bed might be difficult for adult to use but just fine for our teens.
982915:
The apartment location was extremely convenient - walking distance to most attractions and close to the metro and buses, with many grocery stores and cafes in the area. Cesc was a wonderful host. He was friendly and very responsive to messages. He gave us lots of good advice and travel guides, maps, etc. The apartment was tidy with a good layout. The kitchen had all the necessary equipment to make meals and the Nespresso machine was a nice bonus. I especially liked the indoor terrace and balcony which provided a lot of natural light and airflow. The wi-fi was very fast and reliable. The beds were comfy and it was nice that the individual rooms each had heaters.
I was traveling with my father who is eighty, so I feel like I should mention some things to know depending on your accessibility needs. First, there are a few flights of stairs. It took him a little while to make it up up and down, but for us it wasn't too much trouble since we spent most of our time out and about. On the up side, the buses and metro stop nearby were all very accessible, so that balanced out. Also, he said he found getting in and out of the shower stall a little challenging without grab bars. I didn't feel this way because my accessibility needs are different.

Thank you Cesc and family for this great space! It was easy to find with the provided pics.
You have to keep turning the key when locking or unlocking the door, it has levels to lock and unlock.
The staircase is narrow, I struggled a bit with a bag on my shoulder and a suitcase in one hand. That is something to keep in mind depending on your body type. I just had to go slow and I was fine.
The shower is narrow, so if you’re someone that needs more space, it might not work out for you. Don’t shower for a long time, the hot water will run out.
We visited during the winter and there are heaters in the rooms. If you visit during winter, it will get chilly inside and some nights are pretty cold outside.
It is a peaceful neighborhood with so much within walking distance. There is a market around the corner if you need water or snacks. The balcony is so peaceful at night. Everything was clean and it felt homey. You can close the sliding door so the morning light doesn’t wake you up.

Cesc's house was wonderful for our stay in Barcelona. From the second he opened the door, with a "Welcome home!" you knew that this place you could call a home away from home. Clean and comfortable, with a full well stocked kitchen. He even provided toiletries and a blow dryer! Having just come off a cruise, those items came in handy! He quickly responds to any questions...he even went so far as to order a taxi for our very early morning departure!
He provides a wealth of resources for your stay. Start with the folder than answers just about any question you may have. It is full of recommendations for activities and dining and each one comes with directions via walking or public transportation!
The house is with in walking distance to Sagrada Familia's, great dining and bakeries, the metro. And, Bus 47 (our go to for most places we wanted to visit!) is only steps away. The folder explains how to get the tickets for all transportation. Glad we stayed here!
17039211: We were very pleased with our 5 nite stay here.  The neighborhood is great, you’re just around the corner from a square with a bell tower and many food options.  Evenings come alive here. Cafe Godot our favorite. There is another square a couple of blocks north, north-east that younger folks throng and great people watching and food options here as well.  A prior review stated that one could just come and hang in this part of town and we totally agree.  We easily walked to both Parc Güell and Sagrada Familia. Took metro from the Fontana station to the more touristed area of Las Ramblas. So glad we did not stay in that mess down there.  We parked our car, literally, across the street in the Gràcia Principal garage.  I would suggest making a reservation.  Two excellent bakeries are but two minutes walk away off of Traverse Gràcia.  The apartment is up a small but easily navigated stairwell.  Inside it is as pictured and good size for two folks.  Has a small balcony with double doors that can open up for nighttime air and/or neighborhood ambience. Shutting the doors makes it very quiet inside and after a hectic day that’s a treat.  AC works well, small but adequate kitchen, washer works well.  The only con is the shower.  I’m a big fellow and it was all I could do to get in, there was no bending over to get the shampoo and turning was awkward cuz I’d bump off the water!  I developed a routine and it worked but it’s tight.  My wife is much smaller and she had issues as well. All in all a great location, comfy apt., and a good value.  Joan very responsive and helpful.

it is located in a great residential area. there are lots of shops and restaurants near this home. I love Tiramisu and Onna coffee near the house. Also there is a market in 5 min distance. it is not as big as Boqueria market. But you can buy various fruits, Jamon, and etc there.I went there every morning and had breakfast in Panet. it is a bit far from the tourist area -Rambles street though. by walk, it will take about 30 mins. but there are several Metro stations within 10 mins distance. only 2 or 3 stops away. I love to walk to Rambles because I can enjoy Casa Mila and Casa Batllo in the middle of the way. You can find easily benches near the buildings. I used to order coffees and breads, and sit in a benches. and enjoyed Gaudi's masterpieces as long as I wanted.
a couple of things I want to note are, the shower booth. it is small as mentioned in other review. I and my wife are not big size, my wife wears XS size, and I do M-L size. However, we felt hard to enter to and exit from the shower booth. IMO, it is aboi]ut 1 ~2 sqft. the second thing is that you may need to bring own shampoo, soaps and etc, or buy them before you need. There is a good size of grocery store, Sorli Discau, just in a min distance.

El lugar corresponde exactamente con las imágenes. Está muy bien distribuido, bien decorado, iluminado y perfectamente equipado. La ducha es muy pequeña. El edificio no tiene elevador, así que hay que subir el equipaje por las escaleras.
Aunque Gracia es un buen lugar para hospedarse, nuestro viaje coincidió con las "Fiestas de Gracia" lo cual hizo que el barrio estuviera completamente lleno de turistas, grupos musicales, comparsas y juegos artificiales que duraban hasta la madrugada. Era imposible dormir por el ruido. Cerca del hospedaje hay supermercados, panaderías, mercados, farmacias, etc.
Joan responde muy rápido los mensajes, está pendiente de tu llegada y te da las indicaciones necesarias para llegar al lugar. En el apartamento hay una guía muy detallada de Barcelona con recomendaciones generales de transporte público, restaurantes, principales atracciones, etc. Es realmente útil.
Gracias a Joan por su hospitalidad, sin duda consideraría hospedarme en este lugar de nuevo.
1204147520650203611:
La ubicación del alojamiento es excelente: muy cerca del metro, del centro comercial El Corte Inglés, y rodeado de tiendecitas y bares. Lo que más me gustó fue la tranquilidad por la noche: realmente se puede descansar, ya que no hay ningún ruido, ni de la calle ni de los vecinos.
El apartamento es muy pequeño, pero está bien aprovechado y tiene todo lo necesario para una estancia cómoda. La televisión no permite ver canales españoles, así que si alguien quisiera ver las noticias, no podrá hacerlo. Sin embargo, esto no fue un gran inconveniente, ya que funciona perfectamente YouTube, Netflix, etc. Recomendable.

Very good communication from the owner. We arrived very late and we could let ourselves in - very useful! They left complementary wine and water in the fridge. The place was in general nice and clean.
Only bad thing was that the walls are very thin, we could hear everything the neighbours were doing. And I guess the apartment is located next to a school, because a ringing bell woke us up every morning.
Small grocery stores all around, bakeries, good restaurant (KAT). Metro, bus and taxies were couple of minutes away.

We had a great stay with Jordi and Aina in Barcelona! Aina is super responsive and friendly, willing to help with whatever is needed. The apartment is right down the street from the metro and a bunch of grocery stores. The only downside to the apartment is the neighbors are super loud/the walls are thin so you can hear everything the neighbors do. The apartment also is a bit far from city center, but the metro makes it easy to get to and from. Besides that, we had an amazing time and definitely recommend.
24109664: If you enjoy sleeping this is not the place for you - you will be shaken by the noise at night! We live in New York City and were appalled at the level of noise from this place due to its location. The apartment is on the ground floor and the noise and lights from the street - which happen throughout the night and don't stop - are ridiculous to the point where you will not be able to sleep at all! The apartments windows are paper thin so you hear everything (cars, scooters, garbage collectors, conversations from pedestrians)! Be ready for the noise from (1) scooters (there's a scooter parking spot with 10+ scooters directly outside the window), (2) cars from the adjacent parking lot directly next to the front door, (3) more cars, trucks, and garbage collectors from the street directly outside the living room and are 10 ft from the apartment and go throughout the night because the street is a busy cut through in Gracia, (4) bar patrons across the street and less than 25ft away, (5) the random people who buzz the delivery buzzer throughout the night for fun (someone has it out for this apartment). Now, these weren't one off occurrences but happened all 7 nights we stayed with no empathy or accommodation from the host (she'll reference the one line in the description about 'possible noise')! On a positive note, if you don't plan on sleeping, this place is in a great area of Gracia and is nice on the inside.

Johanna’s place is fantastic. I was here on vacation and one of the most important things was that most of the key tourist spots were a 10-30 minute walk, including the Sagrada Familia, Casa Mila and Casa Battlo. There are numerous cafes, restaurants and shops within a 1-5 minute walk which makes it convenient to buy groceries or eat out. And the Plaça del Sol which is hopping with activity in the evening is a 1-minute walk.
The house is very clean, extremely well appointed and very comfortable. The bathrooms are really nice and spotless, modern fittings. I think the house is newly built or renovated. The washing machine makes it convenient if you are here longer than a couple of days.
Johanna was there to greet me and show the house, recommend restaurants, sights to see and made it very easy to settle in to the place and start exploring Barcelona. I had a few questions later and she is very responsive via messaging.
The only thing to know of is because the house is so well located there is a bit of street noise. This wasn’t a bother for me at all but if you are a very light sleeper, something to be aware of. Bring your ear-plugs and eye-mask. Other than that, the place is fantastic.
I would highly recommend it and look forward to returning here myself :)

This apartment is in an amazing location. Around the corner from cute courtyards where you can get food and drinks, and just down the road from a small grocery store. Numerous vegan takeout/butchers in the neighbourhood, as well as some great patisseries. We walked from here to Sagrada Famillia as well as to the old city.  We booked this place on short notice. In the end it wasn’t great for our 11 year old who slept on the couch downstairs. The large blind didn’t seem to go all the way down which meant a fair bit of light came in at night. It was also loud, but we knew that when we booked, given previous reviews. It would have been helpful if there were basics in the kitchen such as oil, vinegar, and a few basic spices. Check-in was great. The host and manager were very accommodating and let us drop off our luggage when the cleaner was in the unit. The bed upstairs was very comfortable. The place is clean and well decorated. If you’re travelling without kids and not planning on using the kitchen much I would highly recommend.
9602351:
The neighborhood and location of this apartment is wonderful. It was very clean.
It’s about an eight minute walk to one metro train stop and 15 minutes to another. You are right in the heart of Barcelona in an interesting neighborhood.
I really enjoyed the balcony.
Communicating with the team of people went very well, and they were always very responsive and accommodating to my requests.
The only reason I gave it 4 stars was comfort. The AC is locked at 73 F. That’s not bad but there’s only one AC unit in the place. It’s in the kitchen/living room. One bedroom has a ceiling fan so they were comfortable. The other bedroom has a portal window, which needs to be open along with the door if you’re going to get any AC airflow at all, which I did. That room has no fan. The AC unit also turns off without movement in the apartment for one hour. After feedback, they were able to remotely disarm each feature. 3 sweaty disruptive sleeps knocked the score. Too restrictive, otherwise ❤️?

Alejandro's apartment is as charming and cozy as shown in the photos. The only downside is the small, poorly ventilated bathroom with a storage water heater, which may require waiting for hot water if there are more than two guests. The shower curtain has some mould, which might bother those concerned about cleanliness. The apartment is well-equipped with utensils, though tea and coffee aren't provided, plenty of great coffee shops are nearby. Toilet paper was insufficient due to its low quantity and thinness, so we had to buy more during our 5-day stay. Fortunately, there's a small supermarket just across the street.
The city's cleaning workers were diligent. During our stay, the streets were cleaned at 1 AM, and garbage was collected at 7 AM, which inevitably caused some noise. If you’re looking for a good night’s sleep, bringing earplugs is highly recommended. The neighbourhood is delightful, with many independent shops and restaurants, and it's conveniently

I want to stay subjective and only lay out facts we observed.
The host is very very helpful in communication and check in/out instructions, very polite and professional.
But we observer several things that result in this review:
1. The room is not sound proof at all, we can hear everything the neighbors say at night. It is an old building though, not necessarily anyone's fault, just a fact.
2. The water heater system needs inspection. The host says it has 80 liters of hot water. But for the first day it was only enough for my wife to bath my 5 years old kid and we are not person who waste water at all. The second day we preserve water very carefully but when it was my turn to shower the water turns fairly cold again at the end.
3. My kid has two bug bits on her face (two large red bumps which took a week to recover) after the first night, we do not observe and notice any mosquitoes so we think it could be bed bugs.
9701861:
I would highly recommend this beautiful apartment. When we were searching for an apartment we were looking for somewhere light, bright and airy and we were certainly not disappointed. The central living area is lovely, with amazing air conditioning.
The three bedrooms were all of a decent size, even the single room, and all had ample storage. The 2 bathroom were very clean and had powerful showers. As there are 2 bathrooms, due to the location of the bedrooms within the apartment, the twin room seemed to have an en suite - which was great. The kitchen was well stocked and had everything we needed. It was useful having a dishwasher and washing machine - and having powder and dishwasher tabs available, rather than having to buy a whole box.
The outdoor space was lovely to have, for drying towels and washing, though it wasn't a space we sat out in.
The location of the apartment is brilliant. We have stayed in Gracia many times and this is the best location so far. You must visit Placa Del Sol and Ruis i Taulet if you stay! There is a bus stop outside the door, which takes you down to El Born or the Port - very handy (if like us you have walked for miles and needed a more restful day!) The metro Fontana is also only a short walk.
All in all, it was a brilliant apartment, perfect location, with a fabulous host and we would definitely visit again! Thank you, Alessandro.

We had a brilliant stay at Alessandro's place! We came to Barcelona for Primavera Sound festival, and were lucky to find this apartment in the wonderful area of Gracia at an unbelievably reasonable price. The apartment is very spacious, clean and well located. I've been to Barcelona several times and have never stayed in Gracia, but I'd make this the place to return to in the future, with lots of great bars and places to eat. El Glop is a must (located 5 mins away on foot) if you want good paella, and they even cater to vegans.
The apartment is pretty basic but it's functional and has everything you need for a good stay, particularly if you're not planning to spend a lot of time there.
Communication was great and check-in with Alina was really easy.
I'd have given 5 stars - the only downfall is that we were only given one set of keys because the previous guests had lost a set. We were told they couldn't be replaced because one of the keys had to be specially recut. This was pretty inconvenient with 5 people wanting to return from a music festival at different times, which meant we had to keep waking each other up to get in. Perhaps having a few spare sets to avoid this in the future would be a good idea.
Otherwise we had a brilliant time, thanks so much for hosting us!

From the moment of airport pick up (Sandro had aranged for a taxi, the driver was waiting at arrivals with our name board) to meeting us at the apartment upon our arrival, Sandro was the best host! We loved our apartment in this not so touristy part of BCN with its amazing bakeries, fruit and vegetable shops and even a small lab perfumierie!. We could walk everywhere or take cabify (we are a family of 4, made more sense than the metro, which is very close: we took it one day). We warked to Park Guell and other close by attractions. The apartment itself was very clean, functional and the kitchen well stocked (maybe could use 1 new fry pan). There was coffee and a wonderful percolator. There were some basic spices as well. Being vegeterian, it was important for us to dish up a few meals at home. Sandro had a thorough list of FAQs on the counter (although he did go through everything in person, upon our arrival). His English is great and he was welcoming. Will definitley go back some time. BCN is wonderful, history intertwined with Mid-century modernism. A short train ride to Montserrat and Girona. We loved spending time at the Miro Foundation and the Picasso museum. La Rambla was  crowded and touristy. But BCN offers something for everyone. Cheers to Sandro and his apartment
698593: Amazing place. Thats just enough to describe Eduard's apartment. We booked this for 4, but ended up only 3 of us came for this trip so the apartment feel just nice for all of us, even if its four of us came it did still feel spacious. Location is perfect, for us everything we want to see is pretty much walkable - however if you want to go to the shopping heaven like Passeig Gracia and doesn't want to walk so much you can always take the bus which the stop just a 5 mins walk from the apartment and be there in 3 stops. Last but not least, what we like about this apartment is the cleanliness!Especially i'm very allergic to dust so I need clean a place, and I can feel that this apartment was just so spotless. Hands down for that! So to end this review, I would like to say thank you to Eduard for being a fantastic host and after I kept changing the check in times etc yet he's still being so nice and so patient. Thanks again for understand. Will definitely recommend Eduard's place for anyone visiting Barcelona. It looks exactly like the picture!

Great option, right in the heart of the Gracia neighborhood!
Eduard was very helpful and responsive before and during our stay. Alessandra was wonderful, checking in on us, making sure we got settled in, providing great food recommendations, and even helping us reserve a taxi for a early morning airport trip!
the location is perfect for exploring Barcelona, whether on foot or by Metro, bus, etc. the Gracia neighborhood still feels quiet, quaint with great restaurants, grocery, shopping, but close to the major sites like Sagrada Familia, the Gothic, etc.
the space has everything you need for a great home base, was very clean and spacious (we had three adults in the group and it never felt cramped). Both bedrooms has space for luggage/clothes, the beds comfy. The living areas had plenty of seating between two tables and the couch, and the kiitchen and laundry were well equipped too.
We loved our stay at Eduard's and would definitely stay again when back in Barcelona!

Definitely reccomend!
The flat was exactly as described and pictured, it is cosy and the shower cubicle is quite small as others have mentioned but by no means a fault for me.
We wanted to spend our time out and about and this was perfect for us. It is in a great location - a stones throw from Passieg de Gracia and only 15mins from most key tourist sites - Casa Mila, Casa Batllo, Sagrada Familia. We found it the perfect place and for a reasonable price in this area. Lots of cafes, restaurants and supermercats within a few minutes walk for us to get whatever we needed. (Highly reccomend the Punjabi restaurant, Baby Jalebi around the corner).
Check-in, lockbox key collection and check-out was all easy and seamless - and Alessandra was on the other side of the phone for any queries we did have.
Eduard and Alessandra were so friendly and helpful. Alessandra checked in on us a few times throughout our stay and helped us book a taxi for our return to airport.
36291359:
A wonderful stay! The place is just a couple of blocks from the Sagrada Familia - not just the cathedral, but also the metro station, so you can get practically anywhere on Barcelona's great metro system. The area felt safe, there were plenty of food options, and it was outside the Sagrada Familia's "tourist main street."
The apartment is great too. You can see that it has heritage, but it's been updated well enough that you don't need to worry about weird "quirks." For instance - the elevator is tiny, but it's safe and reliable. And the overall feeling of high ceilings and a beautiful balcony is impossible to beat!
Finally, I want to call out our amazing host. There was one tiny glitch with the A/C, which seemed to resolve itself after a bit. Still, we reached out, and he was super responsive and helpful in making sure we were taken care of. It was obvious he cared about us as guests, not just as another line item in a spreadsheet. I'd book here again in a heartbeat!

Great host and great location. Alessio was very responsive and very accommodating. We were allowed to leave our luggage earlier then check-in time since I have to check out from our hotel (from a business trip). Alessio was able to arrange to leave our luggage while the apartment was being cleaned and we were able to get lunch and get a preview of Sagrada Familia which was only several blocks away. The apartment was clean and spaceful for 2 people. There is a kitchen but we did not cook anything. We used the refrigerator to keep our fruits and drinks cold. There is Mercadona close by which you could get grocery if needed. Like other reviews mentioned, be prepare to have 5Euro cash/gues/night for the tourist tax. Alessio also mention this during the check-in. Overall, we are very happy with the stay. Thanks Alessio for hosting us.

Loved this place! On the 5th floor, it has a lift. Roomy rooftop terrace with comfortable furniture where we ate breakfast amidst the swirling swallows, view of top of the Sagrada Familia. The kitchen had what we needed cook eggs and tomato toast (there is an immersion blender) in the morning. MOST IMPORTANTLY, there’s a drip coffee maker!! The sofa is comfortable. The shower water pressure is really good. There is a washing machine; we hung clothes on a rack in the morning and they were dry when we got back.
It’s in a real neighborhood, and was quiet at night. Great bed. A very convenient location—close to the metro, buses, taxis. Several coffee / pastry shops close. We bought good fruit and tomatoes at a frutería a block away.
We’d stay here again next time. Alessio is a kind and responsive host. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
889929441198615174: The appartment is clean, sunny and located in an area full of restaurants and pubs. The host provided us clear instructions and a lot of advices related to the surroundings. We stayed during winter and were worried about the temperature, but the appartment had a private heating system and it was no problem for us. The only downside is that during weekend you can hear some noise from the pubs around, but in the end this is common for all the central locations. In our case we spend holiday and enjoyed a lot the neighborhood. For beer lovers, at 8 minutes walk you can find La Rovira, a pub with craft beers. Several traditional spanish restaurants are also in the area but some of them are crowded and require prior reservation. We recommend to read carefully all the instructions, there is an additional late check-in fee for arriving after 9PM and also a tourist tax, everything related to these is clearly described on the location instructions. We will gladly return again here.

The place looks exactly like on the pictures, it's very spacious, has everything you'd need, and is just a 5-minute walk from the Joanic metro station.
We were travelling with a 7-month old baby, and a foldable cot was provided with mattress, pillow and blanket, and there was a high chair to eat. Also in the kitchen there was a hand blender which was super useful to make purée for the baby! And plenty of space to crawl around! We also really appreciated the blackout blinds so it's completely dark at night! And the host was always super quick to respond to us, and when we arrived, showed us all the places that may be of interest to us on a map, based on our lenght of stay and type of travel.
Few things to note that could have been better... There is a swing door to access the partly open kitchen, which is super loud if you are not careful with it, and there wasn't enough hot water to take a bath, which is a bit sad because the bath was huge!

We had a great stay at Alex's place. To start with, I had a late arrival which was further delayed due to one of my flights being delayed. However, his team member, Irina, graciously waited for me. I really liked having a person there for check in, especially when it's a night time arrival. That way, hopefully any problems with gaining access to the property are mitigated. In this case, entry was smooth and easy.
Once I arrived Irina was very friendly and easy to talk to. Even though it was late, she still took time to explain everything to me and give me some tips about places to visit, etc. We actually had a nice chat which made me feel even more welcome.
Irina was also very responsive to any questions I had during the stay, which, of course, made things even easier.
All of that aside, the apartment was spotlessly clean and comfortable.
I highly recommend Alex's Airbnb and would stay there again if I get back to Barcelona
11295154: We are extremely happy with our stay at Monica's apartment.  The location is perfect and centrally located.  We were there for a long weekend to visit our daughter, who is studying in Barcelona this semester.  We arrived at the airport on a Thursday morning, and took a taxi directly to the apartment, where we were met promptly by Lola (spelling?).  She was so kind and very helpful-she helped us "navigate" the building, the apartment, even had a map for us and marked up where we were located, and the location of the nearest public transportation.  She even arranged for our taxi to pick us up on Monday morning, for our ride back to airport!   The apartment is SO CLEAN and well thought out!  We appreciated the generous closets in each of the THREE bedrooms!  I, personally, loved the electric tea kettle, and the tea bags...which I enjoyed each morning!  Conveniently, there is a market directly across the street for water, milk, anything you might need.    We dined out for all our meals, as the food in Barcelona is AMAZING!  The first night, as we were jet lagged,  at Monica's recommendation, we walked to La Pepita, which is a short walk down the street!  RECOMMEND!!!  Great tapas!  Very cool!  We would absolutely stay here again!  THANK YOU!!!!!!!!!!!

The apartment is well-situated, in a grand old building with high ceilings. The aircon worked well. The unit itself needs a lot of maintenance and TLC. It doesn't seem like the owners have even been there recently to see how many finishes are hanging on by a thread. The shower is old and easily floods. The water also cycles between hot and cold unexpectedly. The bathroom sink drains slowly. The coffee machine is abysmal, an ancient, cheap filter coffee machine that's practically unusable. The apartment is bare and lacks personality. The beds are hard. The door handles don't all close well and need to be replaced. The curtains are tacky and let in a lot of light making a sleep-in impossible. The kitchen is only basically equipped, without a chopping board for example. Overall, this apartment is incredibly overpriced for what you get. The owners can get away with it because of Barcelona's demand, but considering what we offer in our own Airbnb units, this place was a disappointment.

Monica's place is strategically located near Diagonal Station which is an interchange for L5 and L3. We could walk or take the metro to many of the landmarks we had planned to visit.
Monica's apartment has 3 bedrooms, just nice for each of us, but there are enough beds and sofabed to accommodate many more guests. Love her living room with the big sofa/sofa bed. Each room has its own heater and wardrobe and full length mirror.
There is a washing machine in the kitchen but no laundry rack. However, we found that the clothes dried faster in our bedrooms when the heater is on.
There is also a portable heater in the bathroom but be careful not to wet it because it will cause a short circuit. It is better to move this heater away from the wash basin.
There are many eateries around the building and supermarkets are plentiful. Loved my stay at Monica's place.
1738660:
We just stayed 9 days at Lluis's apartment. My husband and I were visiting our daughter who is studying in Barcelona. The minute we arrived in the charming plaza I was so excited. The apartment sits in a vibrant, clean, and locally populated neighborhood square where kids play soccer and people sit for morning cappuccinos and relaxing evening drinks.
I could not have asked for a more perfect experience. Check in was wonderful. We were greeted by friendly smiles and an opportunity to practice our Spanish:) There are lots of stairs via a cool spiral staircase to get up to the 3rd floor. But was not at all a drawback for us.
The apartment is clean, modern, and cozy. Very comfortable bed, great closet storage, basic equipped kitchen, roomy bathroom for euro standards, laundry (no dryer of course but a great drying rack), air conditioning, a large back terrace where we had our daughters friends over to eat dinner, and a sweet little balcony off the living room to watch the bustle of the plaza. Very conveniently located with about a 8-10 minute walk to the metro. We used metro and cabs the whole week and loved getting to know the area.
I highly recommend Lluis's place. We are missing our daily cappuccino and croissant routine at Nabucco and the adorable apartment! Will surely stay again. Thanks, Lluis!

We lucked out with Lluis' place as we booked another Airbnb and it wasn't what we expected at all. In a panic on our first night in Barca- we found Lluis' place. We didn't have high hopes, we just wanted something clean and it seemed like a good fit. We booked the place at 12:00 am, and at 9:00 am we headed over to meet Lluis.

We absolutely LOVED our stay at Lluis' place. It's so gorgeously decorated and renovated. It's also super clean!

Lluis is a really nice person as well and super helpful. He made sure to show us everything in the apartment prior to leaving us with the keys. Fresh towels, fresh pillow cases and sheets, cute espresso machine, handy washer.

Now, the location is unreal! The little square that the place is located in is soo chic and wonderful. It's close to so many shops and transportation methods, but it's hidden away down a couple of adorable streets. It's literally the perfect location. So many wonderful restaurants, markets, cafes, and bars in the area. Not overcrowded with tourists at all. It was lovely.

All in all, this will be our go-to place to go back to in Barcelona with every visit! Thank you so much for the wonderful stay, Lluis! Can't wait to come back!!

Barcelona is always a place to visit. We have been fortunate to stay at the Lluis apartment at Placa de la Vila de Gracia, a beautiful local square with many authentic restaurants. For breakfast, we tried Cadaques and the Nabucco Tiramisu, and it was good! For lunch, we did Nou Candanchu ( once the staff will know you, they are super lovely and accommodating). You have to go to Anita Gelato, just 10m away from the apartment- the best ice cream in town! There is also a unique Galician artisan grocery shop; their products are of the best quality with fantastic staff. More food recommendations you can find in my google reviews: https://goo.gl/maps/69Wrd45VqNVDwJTo7
Lluise's apartment was spotless, with one bedroom with the possibility to separate king-size beds into two singles - this is what we did as I was travelling with my best friend. The flat has all the needed appliances and a lovely back terrace where we spend quality time, quiet and comfortable. AirCon is working well; this helped immensely as the heatwave hit the city. The host is very understanding and went the extra mile with small snacks, fruits and drinks delivered to the apartment at our check-in, a lovely touch! I highly recommend it!
17039212:
We loved the location. Great bars and restaurants close by. Lots of Gaudi’s work is an easy walk away. Metro stops close by.
The few things that really frustrated me about the stay were:
1) the host requested our arrival time several times and I always replied saying we were driving from Valencia and expected to be in at a certain time after check in and I will message from the road as the day unfolds.
2) I messaged from the road and they wanted me to call when I was thirty minutes out. I asked if I could call when we got to the train station where we were dropping the rental car and they said no problem. I called on arrival and the person who answered - who wasn’t the main person we were suppose to call because they didn’t answer - was upset that we called from the train station and not before. I think 3 people manage this Airbnb account?
3) we get to the place and the person who hands us the keys was nice but the place was still being cleaned. That annoyed me since it was around 4pm, check-in started at 3pm. I was tired from the day of traveling and we had to wait for the place to get cleaned.
What was the point of asking me when we were getting in so many times?

This is the first real negative review I have written but I had several complaints in regards to this place.
The bed was very uncomfortable and every time you move it would also squeak very loudly. (I was disappointed as getting a good night sleep is very important to me.)
The hot water would only last for about 2-3 minutes and then it would get cold. When I showered at night, my wife had to wait until the morning to shower because it took so long for the hot water to come back. The day before we left, the host came to check it and the water was hot at the time, because neither of us had showered or used the water that morning. He was rude to us and raising his voice stating that the water was fine.
The bathroom light wasn't working.
The shower head fixture would not stay in place and would fall off, so I had to hold the shower-head the entire time I was showering.
When we arrived, the person that checked us in to represent Joan manages multiple airbnbs in the area and was very impersonal. We asked for any restaurant recommendations, and he said he couldn't name any for us. We asked where the closest ATM was and he said he didn't know.

Some issues.
My friend didn’t make the trip due to a Covid infection and host refused to refund tourist tax claiming it was a policy by Airbnb and other arguments. Once Airbnb got involved it all of a sudden was no issue and instant refund.
Place was clean but after some rain there was a bad foul stench in the place which seems to be connected to the plumbing. Host organised some pipe cleaning which temporarily resolved the issue (came back on day of departure but didn’t bother as was leaving)
Place is rather noisy from both the neighbourhood and other apartments. The entire house is Airbnb and there was a lot of coming and going with talking in the hallway and a lot of door slamming.
Doors are locked by a virtual system you have to unlock in your browser or via a card they have in the place. Feels a bit strange also that host could remotely lock you out if needed.
Locking not super convenient if you want to see other things than Gracia as public transport is a bit of a walk away.
473459:
The apartment is dark as the sun barely reaches through the windows.
Although the sunlight is beyond the owners control, putting good illumination is not and still it wasn’t done.
The apartment must have some sort of electrical problem because 70% of the lamps do not work.
This means in addition to not having sunlight, there is also no artificial illumination.
The kitchen for example, doesn’t have any windows - it has 3 ceiling lights and only two are working.
The lighting in the entrance hall, the dining room, the living room and the laundry space are all not functioning meaning the entrance of the apartment is always dark, dining has to be done with a bedside lamp on the table, the living room is mostly enlightened through the windows and at night through the tv (the strongest light on the living room is the tv) and laundry has to be done with the bathroom door open or the cellphone lantern.
The double bed on the suite is extremely uncomfortable and noisy. We believe the mattress is either old or of poor quality. The pillows are the same. I had never seen lumpy pillows before. I don’t know if these are poor quality pillows, if they are very old or if there are lumpy pillows available in the market but they were hard and uncomfortable and we ended up buying our own.
The suite’s bathroom doesn’t have any furniture in so your things have to be either outside the bathroom or on the floor (the second bathroom has a small furniture piece where you can leave your things). The shower had to be cleaned with an overnight soak of chlorine to remove mole and dirt from the corners.
The drain is often clogged after quick showers.
The cable tv in the bedroom does not work.
The apartment is advertised to have a sofa bed which it doesn’t.
We tried to use the vacuum but it was making weird noises. We decided to open and see what was happening. We had never before seen a more disgusting vacuum filter - it most probably has many years of use and was never changed - probably the reason why the vacuum doesn’t work properly. We cleaned as much as we could so we could use it but we were very shocked.
The apartment is advertised to accept dogs but the keys were not given to us until we gave out a 900 euros extra guarantee because of the dog (12 yrs old, 8kg dog).

Rosa's home was wonderful! We were in Barcelona for business and it suited us perfectly for that purpose. It is a well laid out apartment and had a work station in the main living dining area and very fast wifi. As well, we were able to use our Apple TV with ease on the large flat screen TV. You can open the french doors on the street side and the same in the back bedroom and get a lovely breeze throughout if you do not want to have the air conditioning on. We left the door open in the back bedroom at night and it is very quiet for sleeping and we felt completely safe. The beds, pillows and linens were very comfortable and there is a safe to lock up any valuables. It is also very centrally located and so easy to get around by walking, transit or taxi. We spent 5 nights and just walked from the apartment to several great restaurants within a short distance. There are also several small grocery stores and a pharmacy within a 5 min walk as well a larger grocery store within a 10 min walk. I should also mention that there is a cafe on the corner where you can get wonderful fresh baguettes and croissants daily and if you are looking for some retail therapy, look out, as there are many great shops within that area.
Thank you Rosa for your hospitality, it was very much appreciated :)

Siendo yo mismo un host en Miami Beach siempre que viajo busco donde mi familia esta a gusto tal como trato yo de hacerlo para mis clientes, y esta vez fue tal como lo esperabamos
Rosa no solo ayudo a mi hija que llegaba a las 7am y nos ayudo con el early checkin, sino que no hizo todo lo posible para que nuestra estancia fuera agradable, con recomendaciones y hasta reservando un taxi a las 6am para nuestra salida.
El apartamento es espacioso, 2 dormitorios amplios y perfectos para una estancia larga, los baños son pequenos pero suficientes para todo lo que traiamos. El mercado a una cuadra es perfecto para las necesidades basicas.
Habitaciones con AC individual fue primordial para nosotros viniendo de Miami y necesitando aire SI-o-SI.
La locacion es perfecta para alguien que desea estar cerca pero no muy cerca del movimento, a solo unas cuadras de Diagonal y muy cerca del Paseo de la Gracia, se puede caminar hasta la Plaza Cataluyna y de ahi por las Rablas y es un paseo agradable
1889121:
The experience in this Appartment and Barcelona was truly amazing. The appartment is located in the heart of barcelona, where you can find many restaurants, Brunchplaces, clubs (Sutton, Blingbling...), Cocktailbars and also shops if you want to go on a shopping spree. Psg. de Gracia is just a 10 min walk away, so the location is truly the best you can find in barcelona. The appartment itself: the decoration is amazing and beautiful, the appartment very clean and you have 6 bedrooms- 4 with their own bathroom and 2 seperate bathrooms, where one of them has a shower and one has a bathtub. We had towels, soap, shampoo prepared for us and also the fridge was prepared with a bottle of water, orange juice, butter, milk for the coffee... Also there was a coffee machine and capsules, so we could have coffee in the morning. The host Darney was very friendly and answered our questions very fast and also gave us the oppurtunity to check- in early, as we arrived early in the morning and had prepared a cooled bottle of Cava for us.
We were 9 persons in the appartment, which made being quiet a little hard. The rules are no noise in the appartment after 10pm,which is pretty understandable, because there are families living there with little kids and persons who are in homeoffice. The first night we were a little too loud (as we were waiting for all our friends to arrive) and got a call from the host that we need to be a little more quiet- which we respected. The other nights we tried to get out of the appartment before 10pm- not very hard, because Barcelona has a lot of cool places to visit. Also we were not at home the whole day, because of sightseeing.
All in all our experience at this place was perfect and we can a 100% recommend the hosts Eva & Darney and the appartment (but not with a big group, if you want to stay in the appartment and enjoy a night in)

Fabulous property in excellent location. Everything you need and more for exploring Barcelona on foot or with easy access to metro. On arrival we were greeted by Darney and provided with the clear information on everything we needed, and Eva checked with us a few times during the stay to make sure all is well.  The place itself is comfortable and spacious, our group of 7 people had room to spare. Interior design, furnishing and decorations are creative, tasteful and inviting. There are multiple books throughout the apartment from Fodor's and Rick Stevens tour-guides to large albums explaining the history and modernism art of Barcelona, so you know what to see, and learn about what you saw. Appliances, TV's, internet, bathrooms are all in great working order, and instructions for use were  very clear. There is a large supermarket within 2 blocks, and numerous small groceries and bakeries around. We cooked our own breakfast, but there are multiple choices for breakfast, lunch or dinner within a couple of blocks. We were not disappointed in any restaurants recommended by Darney. If I were compelled to find a flaw in this apartment, being a suburbanite, I would probably mention some street noise, however this is a function of being in the center of this vibrant and beautiful city, and that is where you want to be to explore it. Based on our previous experience of renting vacation properties all over the world, this must have been one of our very best picks.

Loved staying at Eva's apartment. Eight of my friends and I came to celebrate my birthday and it was a fabulous place to stay. We each had our privacy and bathrooms but could all convene together. The rooms and place really live up to the photos posted so that was really nice. There are bathrobes and shoes for each guest which was great and welcome champagne and fruits.

We loved the location as well as there was a fabulous bakery we had breakfast every morning. There were several fabulous restaurants in the area too: Bar Mut, La Pepita, etc. and on my birthday we went to a fun club that was right around the corner.

The only item to consider is the noise restriction. You cannot make any noise after 10pm. The first night we stayed, we played a card game in the main living room and the neighbor below complained. So we made it a point to only come back and sleep. Although the 2nd night we had a neighbor who had a party, so the noise traveled back up to us and I had to sleep with my noise cancelling headphones.

Final note, you need to take out your own trash so just remember to do that!
2762205:
Thanks to our friendly and welcoming hosts for a memorable and romantic stay in this comfortable, clean, and quiet apartment in an excellent location.

We arrived at the apartment late and were greeted by Barbara and her husband, Adri. It was easy to follow their directions to get from airport barcelona to their apartment, using aerobus and a short subway ride. The hosts welcomed us with hospitality, providing coffee, milk, orange juice, eggs, bread, and jamón serrano (ham) for our breakfast the next morning. Very helpful and nice hosts who were easy to communicate with.

The listing description and pictures were accurate .

The clean, airy space had an excellent flow, and was very quiet during the night with the master bedroom near the back of the apartment away from the tree-lined street.​​ The efficiently organised kitchen came well equipped with everything you might need, including spices and a toaster. The spacious and elegant bathroom is equipped with a laundry machine for your clothes. A drying rack is provided in the back covered porch as well. Wifi is excellent. The hosts left detailed descriptions of how to use the clothes washer, dish washer, and stove in a handbook translated in multiple languages and laminated. Everything was clean and worked well.

Located on Passeig Sant Joan, when you exit the apartment on a weekend morning you will be greeted by families on a stroll, elderly Spaniards sitting on park benches with canes, and joggers. Head NW for nightlife in the neighborhood of Gràcia. Within easy walking distance is the subway, restaurants, supermarket, and local, covered markets with butcher and cheese stands. It's easy to get to the beach from this location, a relaxing and picturesque walk on tree-lined streets with a bike lane. We walked to all attractions in Barcelona during our stay.

We fully recommend this apartment and the Gracia area. We would definitely stay here again!

I will try to this short and simple. Stay at this apartment. Stayed for a week with my wife and teenage son and cannot think of way our stay could have been improved.
The apartment is spacious, clean and very comfortable. All amenities that you need for a longterm stay are there and in good working order. There is a large living area with two windows looking onto a park where the locals gather to chat and play petanque. The kitchen is modern though if you are like us you will only use the refridgerator to keep drinks and a few snack as you won't want to miss out on an opportunity to eat at one of the local bars and restaurants. The beds are comfortable and the bathroom has a wonderful rainfall shower and a huge counter to lay out all your toiletries.
A previous review mentioned that there is separate room where the toilet is located. There is also a sink in that room which made it convenient for my wife to use for makeup, drying her hair while my son and I took our showers, allowing us to get out of the apartment faster to explore Barcelona.
And the location was just as great. It's a few minutes to the metro station that will take you straight to the heart of the city. All around are amazing eating opportunities and wonderful squares where you can act like a local and hang out for a drink and a snack. Barbara provided us with lots of suggestions for great meals and she was waiting for us at the apartment when we arrived. Like I sad at the beginning, stay at this apartment.

We arrived at the apartment late and were greeted by Barbara and her lovely husband. They were the friendliest and nicest hosts we have encountered on Airbnb. They took the time to show us around the apartment and explain to us tips on how to get around Barcelona, places to go and good places to eat! (They even prepared a little booklet with all this information!) The food suggestions were particularly great (some must tries include Origens and Pepe Tomate).

The apartment was impeccable! It was so lovely and clean and cosy. It was also very spacious. The kitchen was well stocked (THANK YOU!!) with cereal, juice, eggs, milk and more provided by our kind hosts. Everything about the house was great!

There were many great places to eat within walking distance to the apartment. The metro station was also closeby making transporting to and from the apartment very easy. The apartment is in a nice, quiet suburb. It is far enough to give you privacy at night, but also close enough to the city centre and many attractions (such as the Sagrada Familia and Parc Guell) to make it very convenient. We walked to many of the main attractions in Barcelona during our short stay.

I cannot stress how wonderful Barbara is. We needed to extend our stay by 2 days, and Barbara was very considerate and allowed us to do so with little hassle. The apartment was PERFECT and I would recommend this apartment to anyone planning a trip to Barcelona.
2451930:
Me and my boyfriend came to Barcelona for a week and chose to stay here after being drawn in by the beautiful photos of the flat, particularly the terrace!
The place looked exactly as it does in the photos and was so homely and cosy with very arty, quirky trinkets everywhere. Paz was away when we arrived but her son Pablo did the check in and he was kind enough to wait at the flat for us when we were an hour late because our flight was delayed. He was very helpful showing us places we could go and the flat had loads of maps and guidebooks already there for us.
The flat was also equipped with kitchenware such as pans, plates, glasses, cutlery etc which was handy as we cooked dinner at home on several nights. It was also a nice touch that there was a chess board for us to play!
The private terrace was quiet and serene and the perfect place to sit out in the mornings to have breakfast, during the day where the sun was on it and in the evenings when it was cooler. Overall, it was definitely the part of the apartment we enjoyed the most because it was just so relaxing and chilled and beautifully decorated with plants and more trinkets.
The apartment was in a great location, about 3 minutes walk from Lesseps station which made it very easy for us to get to other parts of Barcelona, it was also within walking distance to Park Guell and the neighbourhood of Gracia where we went on the Festival of Sant Joan and was lucky enough to see a bonfire, fireworks and a free concert in Placa del Sol. It was also conveniently near many supermarkets so we could just pop down to get some things if we wanted to.
Overall, we had a very pleasant time in Barcelona and would really recommend this flat, particularly if you prefer to stay in a slightly quieter neighbourhood away from the loud hustle and bustle of the city centre. Thank you for having us Paz!

Paz was there to meet us when we arrived. We had just experienced a huge stress as a result of my daughter leaving a bag with her passport in it in the taxi. Immediately, Paz was very helpful and compassionate about our situation. She offered to write a message to post outside in case the taxi should return (didn’t happen, unfortunately) & made suggestions regarding what steps we should take to deal with the situation. Throughout our stay there, she was very responsive and helpful. She let us stay a little past checkout as we dealt with getting a new passport and allowed us to leave our backpacks there for a few hours on the last day. Very kind!
This artsy apartment felt very much like home to us. The kitchen had everything we needed to prepare simple meals. The bed was quite firm but we slept great. Bedding was very clean. Shower water pressure was good and hot water plentiful, much appreciated after a day in the rain. WiFi worked great. One of the best features of the apartment is the terrace! So nice to relax in a lounge chair in the sun and a big table for outdoor dining. There is a gorgeous jacaranda tree across the street that was in bloom ~ so pretty.
Location is great. We walked to Park Güell (15 - 20 minutes) & La Sagrada Familia (~45 minutes). The L7 metro line is only about a 5-10 minute walk & that will take you to Plaza Catalunya (Las Ramblas) & from there you can connect to other lines to Montjuic, etc. There are nearby grocery stores just a few minutes away.
If you are looking for a homey, local neighborhood experience like we were, we highly recommend this lovely apartment.

Paz was the most welcoming host we could have hoped for and more! She welcomed us on our arrival with a thorough talk through not only the apartment but places she recommended we visit along with a map to show us exactly how to get there.  The apartment is amazing - extremely creative and full of vibrant, impressive art work that Paz herself has created. Not only was the apartment littered with artistic genius, the terrace was amazing - one of the best parts of the apartment. I was concerned at first that it may not get the sun all day long but I was wrong! From about 10am until past 5pm, the sun's rays glistened nicely onto the picturesque terrace area where we spent many an hour sunbathing! The location of the apartment was perfect for us. It was far enough away from the hustle and bustle of 'touristy' Barcelona and so was quiet, but close enough to be able to get to pretty much everything within a half an hour walk. The tube station is conveniently placed a short 3 minute walk away though on the odd occasion that we didn't feel like walking! There is an array of bars and restaurants on the doorstep so we didn't feel like we had to go into the centre of Barcelona for some fun! All in all a perfect location, amazing apartment and wonderful host!
2555964:
We were Alex and Audrey guests in June.
The location is great to discover the city, near one of the main streets. The appartment is located at small street - approved for vehicles, so you can hear them, but it is not a big problem. Area is very safe, you can freely come back home even late at night. The neighbourhood looks also very nice - with several shops, tapas bars, restaurants, interesting architecture and some green squares.
The appartment is in the central part of the city. Thanks to the good comunication, you can visit the whole city. The main attractions are not far away from here. This is also perfect location for people who prefer explore the city by foot (possibility to discover small streets, not always full of tourists, but rather Spanish). You should ask the hosts about interesting places where you can eat regional food and feel the local atmosphere - we did it and spent wonderful time in several tapas bars.
The room is just like in the pictures.
Is very spacious, what is important, when you want sometimes to rest at home. You enter by the main door to apartment (second floor - stairs), on the right is door to the room, on the left is private bathroom. Opposite the main door is also the second to the rest of the apartment (kitchen, living room).
Generally, Alex and Audrey are very good hosts, helpful (even in "critical" situations :))) and joyful. They really help us finding best places for us. We highly recommed them as hosts and their proposal to stay in Barcelona.

We were welcomed by Alex and Audrey in the middle of the summer. They are really nice and helpful people. They were willing to answer all our questions and spoke really well English.

The room was very clean and spacious. Comfortable beds, there's a big closet for all your clothes and a coffee maker to start your day with. Alex and Audrey were very happy to share their fridge where we could store our food and drinks. But we rarely needed it, because there were lots of cosy coffee places around the corner.

There was a computer in the room wich was very handy to make our plans for the day, together with the tours leaflets in the room. The bathroom was very cosy and clean, although the bathtub was a bit on the small side. But after a long and nice day, the shower is all you need really. Along the towels, shampoo and soap it was quite luxurious.

Another plus was the balcony of which you can take a glimpse outside. The room was nicely decorated, after a long day in Barcelona it had a relaxing atmosphere to come home to. Alex and Audrey's place is situated right in the middle of Barcelona, from which you can easily reach all the beautiful and famous spots in the city.

We really liked the fact that this was a private room and bathroom, but you also stayed at a real home and got some sense of Barcelonese life.

We had a great stay and would recommend this place if you are looking for a wonderful trip to Barcelona! Thank you Alex and Audrey!

Alex and Audrey were very helpful and polite during our stay. They did not charge extra for a late check in and talked us through recommendations whenever we requested their assistance on them. The room is spacious and easily sleeps four adults on four separate beds. There is a balcony as well which looks out onto the street below. There is a computer in the room which is helpful to research and plan your days on what to do in Barcelona and a map of the city on one of the walls. The toilet is also very clean and has a bathtub and a shower.
All in all our stay at this listing was very pleasant and trouble free. The location is perfect, it is just far enough to central Barcelona to avoid the hustle and bustle and near enough to make travelling by the metro across the city a breeze (Diagonal is the closest station).
I would recommend this listing to anyone looking to visit Barcelona on a budget. The only potential trouble we had was that the wifi signal in the room was not very strong and this made it difficult sometimes to connect to it. This was not a major issue for us as we all had access to 3G so used that instead.
Also would like to add they were very helpful in letting us keep our luggage in the apartment and then pick it up in the evening (after check out) as we had a late flight!
Thanks for your hospitality Alex and Audrey!
35925229:
Ana is a great host, and this whole experience reminds me of the "good ol' days" of Airbnb when not everything was an average hostel-ish, cookie-cutter (aka boring) experience, when there were more actual hosts with extra space and properties compared to this boom of cheap, massively manufactured and bought real estate with zero personality.
So Ana's place, situated in the heart of Gracia, was so refreshing. She greeted us when we arrived and toured us around, and was so warm and accommodating. We also tried her paella recommendation and can confirm that it was indeed delicious.
The place itself was just as described. It probably looks better in real life to be honest. I was a bit wary of the noise outside (the loft is situated right in front) especially because we were there on a weekend, but it was not that bad! We had a portable white noise machine so we did not hear anything, though even with it unplugged the noise was manageable enough.
I would definitely consider booking this again next time I'm in Barcelona! Thanks again Ana :)

We loved our stay at Ana's house in Gràcia!
Pros:
- Ana is a true gem. She seems like she genuinely enjoys hosting and it shows in her smile and actions. She was also VERY accommodating with a late check-out request and even helped us order a taxi to the airport
- The location was SO great for us. Extremely close to, what felt like, hundreds of shops and restaurants. Try AMMA gelato!
- The apartment is modern and has an interesting layout with a beautiful little atrium in the middle
Cons:
- The smell of backed up sewage is pretty noticeable. I'm guessing that it's a problem with the neighborhood's infrastructure and not specific to the apartment itself. We were able to mask it somewhat with some reed diffusers and candles, but it persisted throughout our stay. If that smell is a deal breaker for you, this isn't the place for you.
- Like others mentioned, the front loft area can get loud on busy nights. The main bedroom is very quiet and peaceful though.
Stay here!

Ana’s apartment was the perfect home base for me and my family for a short stay in Barcelona. It was a comfortable walking distance to everything we wanted to get to during our trip, public transportation was near, and it was just a block or two to bigger streets to catch cabs. We loved that there were good restaurants and cafes all around the neighborhood (especially on nights when we were exhausted from sight seeing — special shout-out to the cafe across the street to the left of the apartment on the corner). The apartment itself was spotless and comfortable for the three of us. The AC was fabulous, it was so convenient to have a washing machine available (with detergent), and the linens were soft snd comfy. Ana was responsive and great at coordinating our arrival an departure, and she was SO KIND to my mother — thank you for that, Ana. Ana even helped book a really early morning cab ride, which took a burden off my plate. Go ahead and book this place!
7066477:
The photos on the website looked great, and sometimes when you arrive you realise that the photos looked better than the actual place.this wasn't the case with our stay here.the place was spotless, nice bed, bathroom and living area, with all the cooking and cleaning facilities you need. Was great having the washing machine to reduce the amount of washing needing to be done when we got home.
On our arrival we were greeted by Brian who couldn't have been more helpful, I felt he showed a genuine interest in our stay, helping with travel, sightseeing and restaurants etc. He was very friendly and down to earth and nothing was too much trouble, all his advice was 100% accurate.
The location itself was great, close to Vila de Gracia square that had a few lovely restaurants.local supermarkets, with bakery's etc were only a short 3-4 minute walk away. It was a nice quiet area of Barcelona as its not on a main street.
We did spend a lot of time around the beach, port and las ramblas area which was about a 25-30 minute walk away, which we didn't mind too much as it was a better chance to see the city.
The only negatives ( nothing to do with the actual flat we stayed in )would have been the timing of our stay as it caused a few problems because of the voting referendum. The Barcelona fc match was played behind closed doors, so we didn't get to go to the match. The following day all public transport wasn't usable due to the street protests, taxis were also unable to get to their location as they couldn't reach certain areas.think we walked a round trip of about 15 miles that day.
We had also booked a taxi with Brian to take us home early in the morning at 6am.the taxi didn't come by 6:15 so we had to walk a short distance to get a taxi. I did text the number given by Brian to call with any problems the night before to check if our taxi the following morning was booked, but I received no reply.i think this was possibly due to The company that owns the flat being on strike the day before, so maybe the taxi wasn't booked.it wasn't a huge problem as we got a taxi easy enough and we're fine for time.
All in all a great stay, and with my first ever trip to the nou camp being delayed it gives me another chance to go back.i wouldn't mind staying in the same flat again as it was perfect. Although I think next time I would stay in one of their other flats closer to las ramblas to save mileage we clocked up on walking

Location, location, location. After beginning in El Born/Gothic Quarter, we stayed at Maria's place during the second half of our trip to Barcelona, when we wanted to be closer to the Gaudi attractions in Eixample and Gracia and spend some time taking in the more local vibe of Gracia. We're so glad we did! Maria's apartment is on a pretty quiet residential block, but is just a few blocks away from the main shopping strip of Passeig de Gracia and a very central metro stop where you can catch short train rides to Las Ramblas/Gothic Quarter and to Sagrada Familia and Park Guell. Also within comfortable walking distances (20-30 mins or much less in some cases) are Casa Batllo and Casa Pedrera, and perhaps most importantly, several of the less hectic and less touristy neighborhood plazas Gracia is known for, where you can just sit and people watch with a nice glass of wine or coffee. As for the apartment itself, it is simply but stylishly decorated and well-appointed for a comfortable visit, including coffee maker, standard kitchen equipment, hair dryer, plenty of towels and blankets/pillows, washer/dryer, TV, a code-operated safe. The apartment is on the top floor and the terrace is a great perk to spend some time out in the fresh air relaxing between your trips out and looking out at some of the neighboring rooftops, but don't expect breathtaking views of the city or anything as it is only 4 floors up. María was very prompt in her communications and was even kind enough to offer to let us check-in about an hour early, which comes in very handy when there's about a 3 hour gap between checking out at one place and being able to check in to the next one. All in all, if you don't feel the need to stay in the midst of where all the main Barcelona sightseeing takes place down by the water neighborhoods of El Born/Barceloneta/Gothic Quarter, or would just like to make sure you work in some more time in the very charming residential area of Gracia, you can't go wrong staying at Maria's.

Wanted to like this place, but it failed to meet my expectations. Booked it based on the nice reviews, but seems that things are different now.
The place attempts a modern-stylish look, but maintenance has not been a priority. As soon as one walks-in, you are greeted by a huge, ugly, stained, old discolored looking sofa/bed. White walls are great if they are kept clean, these had too many dings, stains, scratches, etc. which make the apartment look dirty. Other annoying things:
- no fitted sheets on the bed and the flat ones provided are too small
- WiFi is weak, spotty and unreliable
- part of bdrm closet is falling apart
- one of the bdrm windows don't open due to poor blind placement
- no instructions for washer (look for them in the internet)
- the kitchen is impractical with limited counter space
- glass table top was wonky and noisy, needed a little shimmy.
- bags full of dirty linens are typically left on the stairs
- noise (and smells) from other units creep in
- bathroom ceiling looks disreputable and dirty
On the positive side, the bed was very comfortable, water pressure was great and plenty hot. There was no sign of smell (typical of old Barcelona). It also has a nice patio with an umbrella. The manager for the properties responds promptly and attempts to resolve any issue.
For the disturbing part: the last day of our stay, at 2:05 pm, the cleaning crew was on the apartment opposite to ours. There were 2 guys, one seem to be going in/out of the unit. Then I hear our door being unlocked and this dude with a motorcycle helmet opens our door. I was having lunch and immediately jumped towards the door. The guy apologetically closed the door, I just don't see how this could have been a "mistake" (different apt number, different key-cards). Anyway, always keep your valuables in the safe. Never assume a locked door is good enough.
I cannot recommend this place for a stay in Barcelona.
17039201:
The apartment was almost the same as the photos listed, except for some of the decor. Once I reviewed the description in Spanish, it does state that there is an extra $2.50 fee/person/night because this is a company run apartment rental.
Location: the location was convenient for us (most attractions were approximately 1-3 miles away by foot), but towards the end of the trip, walking became a chore. The closest metro entrance was about 10 minutes away by foot.
It is also quite a noisy neighborhood, but I feel that all of Barcelona may be like this. If you are a light sleeper, then I highly suggest bringing ear plugs because it’s loud until about 1-2 AM and starts again around 7 AM. I felt safe in this neighborhood even when walking back at 1 AM. I was also walking alone during the morning and had no problems. Shops and eateries are right outside, which makes it super convenient.

Another thing worth mentioning is that the apartment is on the second floor. There is no elevator and the stairs are a bit narrow.
Note: Due to the size of the apartment, I would definitely not suggest any more than two people for this location. The apartment also has a limited amount of hot water as they utilize a hot water tank. It takes about 2 -4 hours for the water to boil again, so I’d advise not to take long showers - I learned this the hard way.
Communication with Joan was wonderful. He was very accommodating because our flight was cancelled and we came a day later. He answered promptly and was able to send someone out to meet us earlier so that we could start our day.

Very cozy and beautiful appartment located only two stops with metro, from the city center. You can even walk there in no time!
Friendly and calm neighbourhood with plenty small grocery-stores located within a convenient distance from the appartment.
Joan as a host has been amazing and we felt very welcomed during our whole communication with him. However, the agency that was involved handing us the key, and were supposed to be the support regarding any questions that would occur during our stay were, sadly, not very agile. It was a challenge to reach them upon arrival to the apt., luckily they called in the last minute, but it was after we tried to get in touch with the person in charge of handing over the key- Quentin. They were also some issues regarding a blanket that was promised us but we never recieved. In our opinion it wasn't Joan's fault- simply the agency. However, we hope that this bureau's future involvement will now be questioned.
THANK YOU Joan for your lovely apartment though! :)

Great little apartment in Gracia! Clean and good A/C, which was very important on a couple of hot days in June (I imagine July/Aug are hotter, and it would be very important to have A/C, in my opinion). Perfect location -- Gracia is a very cool neighborhood with interesting restaurants, bars, and public squares, and wonderful boutiques to shop in. About a mile from Sagrada Familia and Gaudi park, but out of super touristy area. There is a good mix of young and old in the neighborhood. I would definitely stay in this neighborhood again, and stay in Joan's place.  A couple things to be aware of, as others have mentioned--there are a few flights of stairs, which can be tough with luggage (Maximiliano was kind enough to help me!) or with mobility challenges, and a property management company will check you in, get a picture of your passport, have you sign a contract, and have you pay the tax on the spot. A bit different from other experiences through Airbnb, but it was fine.  Great experience overall.
439057:
What a fantastic apartment in a lively square! Javier was kind enough to let us drop off our bags while we returned our rental car. While we didn't share a common language with Javier, he explained the essentials of the apartment.

The balconies over the living room gave us a great view of the bustling square...at night, we watched a vibrant night scene with kids playing ball, riding their scooters and adults hanging out at the numerous restaurants and cafes. Amelie was one restaurant we enjoyed a couple of nights, ourselves. On Saturday night, the partying continued until early in the am but the air conditioning made it possible to close the doors and get some sleep. In the mornings, we were able to check out various bakeries, and then again, from our 2nd floor perch, watch kids going to school and folks traveling to work across the square. A children's chess tournament was arranged one afternoon, and in the evening we alternately heard a brass band, duo guitars, sax player, and watched a body percussion group.

The master bedroom is spacious, the room with the single bed is smaller, but the closets and drawers are ample, the beds are comfy, and it was great having two bathrooms. The washer is a plus especially when we figured out how it worked!

The kitchen is large but for those who enjoy cooking or assembling it isn't as well equipped as I've found in other kitchens but very passable. Googling tips on how to use the Espresso Maker was helpful and the result - great coffee!

The location is convenient for getting to the metro, buses, and the Hop On/Hop Off bus on Passeig de Gracia. We enjoyed walking to the Sagrada Familia, Parc Guell, the Rambla and various other sites. We found it easy to shop for food at the local shops, supermarkets and eateries where you could get take away including the Empanada shop right on the corner.

As mentioned, it is a two floor walk up a narrow staircase, though Javier was kind enough to carry our bags up for us. He was also kind enough to arrange a taxi, but because we needed to change the time at the last minute, and couldn't understand what the taxi driver who called to confirm said due to our language barrier, we waited then ended up walking a couple of blocks and hailing a cab. It was fine in the end and based on what we've read elsewhere about prearranging cabs, if you're not trying to leave at rush hour or an unreasonable hour, walking a few blocks to a main street might be the way to go. It ended up being less expensive than quoted on an online service.

All in all, Javier's apartment is terrific and he is a very helpful host!

Javier was the perfect host! He sent me a letter to give to the taxi driver so we could get to the apartment from the airport. Since I speak very little Spanish, and would never try to give directions (I would certainly get lost!) The taxi driver (who spoke no English) was able to deliver us to the front door of the apartment with no trouble. The stairs are steep and narrow, as Javier warns in the description of the apartment. My 75 year old mom was able to get up and down with no problem!! They add to the charm of the apartment!
