The apartment was clean and spacious. Perfect for our trip. The neighborhood was wonderful. A great area to spend time in. Although we decided to eat at the many cafes in the square where the apartment is located, the kitchen would have been wonderful to cook in. We spent time around the big table in the kitchen eating local pastries (a short walk) and drinking local coffee (same short walk!). It was a wonderful meeting place for the four of us. The bathrooms were clean and it was nice there were two! The two bedrooms were plenty large and all of the beds were comfortable. The front salon, which overlooks the public square, was beautiful! Many local guide books to help you find your way around. The couch made into a very comfortable bed. The salon is a little noisy late into the night, but only because we kept the windows and french doors open. We wanted to experience Barcelona. All of it, including the noise! We loved watching the families gather, with their children and dogs, in the square to visit and play. You would never need to leave the neighborhood if you didn't want to!

Javier was easily reachable by phone and was very welcoming. He arranged a taxi for us to get to our next destination. This was my first experience with airbnb. I could not be happier! I will go back to Barcelona with my husband to explore this beautiful city further.

There are many people who have trouble in Barcelona with crime. We were careful and did not carry a lot of stuff with us. We traveled over the entire city. We ate at many of the local eateries. We sampled local food, wine and beer. (I recommend the olives, mussels, wine, well, pretty much everything we had was wonderful!!) Just be smart and cautious! Barcelona is a city that has a lot to show you. Don't hesitate to stay at Javier's apartment and explore his city! I can't wait to go back!

Thank you, Javier! You made our vacation wonderful!

Plaza de la Vila de Gracia, 3, 2º,2ª is a fantastic apartment situated in a traditional part of Barcelona far enough away from the bustle and tourist concentrated districts yet close enough to walk to. There are a number of metro stations within 10 minutes leisurely stroll that serve all destinations as well as numerous bus stops.

The apartment is situated above a square that is always busy, but far from intrusive, where locals meet for a drink and tapas throughout the day. Small supermarkets, as well as a variety of bakeries and charcuteries, are spread around the periphery – an ideal location.

The apartment itself is situated on the second floor up a narrow staircase. We had 2 small children and a double pram that we could fit easily up the stairs (you will enjoy the front door!). The apartment is bigger than it appears in the photos and was more than large enough for a family of 4. The apartment has a wonderfully charming feel about it with a sitting room, including balcony, which looks out over the square. The bedrooms are large, with the main bedroom incorporating a study and large bathroom; a smaller bathroom is situated off the good sized kitchen. All of the equipment you would wish for is present and modern (washing machine, dryer, Wi-Fi, television, speakers, heating, aircon etc). A friend of Javier’s who showed us around the apartment, which was clean and tidy, met us on arrival and Javier phoned us shortly afterwards to make sure we were happy. He was fantastic for helping out even calling us at 0450 on the day of our departure to make sure the taxi he had booked for us had arrived (it is under 30 mins to the airport from the flat).

We won’t go into detail about what we did whilst we were in Barcelona (what we did with 2 children under 5 and what anybody else may do might be dramatically different!) as you will already have decided on what you wish to experience. Suffice to say that we had an excellent time and Barcelona caters for everybody.

In summary – the apartment is well priced, is larger than anything comparable further south in Barcelona, is in a wonderful location and managed extremely well, both prior to and during the stay, by Javier.
14164414: This place is super wonderful! It may not seem so at first, but as you come home to it everyday. You will discover that it may as well be the sunniest apartment in all of Barcelona. The sunshine that fills the apartment is heavenly. I stayed here for 6 weeks and loved coming home to it. The apartment is only enhanced by its host - Carlota who is the best part of the accommodation. She filled the place with all the little mindful details that make you feel so special. It is stocked with everything you will need. I arrived with the most delightful bottle of wine and gourmet snacks. She also greeted me warmly and oriented me to the place. Booking this place you will be assured that you can always get a hold of the host. I felt that Carlota was always there to help. I was travelling alone and felt that if push comes to shove, Carlota will be there to help solve problems I may have with the apartment. There were some minor issues and were resolved immediately. Without delay!! The bed is comfortable and  décor very well selected. It is located in a very quiet street that spills out to a charming plaza where the locals spend time with family. There is however the church bells that toll endlessly every hour by the half hour beginning 8 am till 10 pm but it is very charming. I prefer it to the hustle and bustle of trucks and traffic. This is mostly a pedestrian town, so no traffic that will distract from people watching at lively cafes which are just outside your doorstep. This place is also just 5 min walk to the metro which will connect you to everything . Downtown Barcelona is approximately 6 short stops away. I was very happy to retreat from the hustle and bustle of the city. The neighborhood of Les Corts is the second most posh outskirts neighborhood in Barcelona. There are 2 unobtrusive shopping malls which I discovered too late in my stay that feature local fashion designers. I loved my stay here. It will be a big part of my fuzzy memories of Barcelona. Specially those quiet tea drinking moments overlooking the terrace. Do not compromise on where you live here. Enjoy.

This was a lovely spot for a couple looking for a place in a classic, cute, residential neighborhood with easy walk to nice places to eat and extensive shopping.  Was very easy to get on transit all over the city and nice to NOT be next to La Rambla (which, however, is walkable if you like to walk!).  Apt itself was spotlessly clean, nicely furnished including kitchen equipment, coffee supplies, and linens.  Perfect for couple or very friendly friends, as just has large bed.  We did however fit our adult son on the floor on an inflatable mattress in the kitchen area for a few days, but no separate bedroom.  Balcony was lovely for afternoon drinks.  There's a church close by with starts chiming every quarter hour after 8, and I didn't believe Carlota when she told us we'd get used to it, but we totally did - slept right thru it after the 1st morning.  Square had several wonderful spots for morning coffee, dinner, evening and late night drinks and tapas - if you go to Maravillas say hi to Montse from Susan and David!  Carlota was wonderful, easily available and provided lots of helpful advice.

El piso es precioso!! Es pequeño pero ideal para 1 o 2 personas. Quedamos enamorados del piso, todo muy limpio, contaba con todo lo necesario: toallas, shampoo, papel, vajilla, nevera, lavadora con jabón y suavizante. La cama es muy cómoda y además el aire acondicionado nos fue muy útil ya que aun hacia calor. El piso está muy iluminado, la terraza es mucho más grande de lo que parece y la zona es preciosa, para nosotros la mejor zona de Barcelona... Justo debajo del ático esta una pequeña plaza con muchos bares bonitos para tomar una cerveza por la tarde, a menos de tres calles esta el centro comercial L'illa donde puedes hacer compras y a dos calles hay un súper mercado muy bien surtido. La diagonal esta a dos calles donde pasan autobuses que conectan con toda la ciudad.
Sinceramente, volveremos sin duda a este piso en nuestra próxima estancia. Carlota es muy amable, nos explicó como funcionaba todo, todo lo que había cerca y algunas recomendaciones de bares y restaurantes. También nos dejó un grato regalo de bienvenida y algunos mapas muy útiles para conocer Barcelona.
19779316:
great stay and great host.
the check in process was a little different - you have to go to the office to pick up keys, this worked out for us because they allowed us to store our luggage until we checked in. this was very convenient. the hosts were very communicative throughout our stay. the check out process was very simple as well (leave keys in apartment). it is about 15-20 minutes from the "lively" part of Barcelona but this is exactly what we were looking for. the train station is a 6 minute walk so it was easy to get around. would recommend

The flat was just as depicted. Everything was immaculately clean and tasteful. The self check in process was very clear (we were given very clear instructions on picking up the keys from a safe in a building 5 mins away) which was particularly handy since we arrived at midnight. The people managing the property were very friendly when we left our luggage with them for a few hours after check out. I loved the little balcony. Particularly appreciated the clarity and accuracy of instructions and descriptions. Location is quite central.

The flat is as shown on the photo BUT The balcony is quite small and just 3 m away from large aircons from the very next building, with no view.
Not stated in the announce you have to sign another additional contract.
You have to get the key from a locker 500m away, not very convenient with lugages.
When we ask for an extra hour to checkout (I check on Airbnb the flat was not booked), they said no and sent us the cleaning team to ring at the door at 11am sharp.
Flat is OK but we miss the airbnb spirit
3778832:
It's easy to see why Diego is a Superhost and gets such great ratings on AirBnB. He greeted us immediately upon arrival as we stepped out the taxi! Diego is super friendly, very knowledgable about Barcelona and it's obvious he loves this city. He's an excellent communicator and his response time when we requested information was always remarkably fast.
The apartment is in a vibrant & safe neighborhood, full of Spanish families that seem to all congregate every evening in the nearby plaza. It's the kind of place that feels genuine and local, with everything you need within a few blocks, yet is only a mile walk to La Rambla and the Gothic quarter. Two blocks away is a pedestrian street with lots of shops and eateries called Carrer de Blai, and also a restaurant in walking distance that Diego recommended that has the most tender Galicia style Octopus or "Pulpo" I've ever had. If your into that kind of cuisine you simply must try it. For transport to things further afield in Barcelona you only need to walk a few blocks to catch the Purple L2 and Green L3 metro lines. In addition, it's conveniently only a short 2 mile taxi ride to the Barcelona Sants train station. For the 2 of us It was truly a perfect location that suited our purposes during our 3 night stay.
Upon entering the apartment, Diego gave us a full rundown of all the features which included an amazing noise blocking window/door system, and a remote controlled blind system that blocked all outside light which was great for sleeping. I must say that the front door is one of the most secure I've ever seen yet easy to manage.
We were traveling as a couple and it was just the right amount of space for us. Many of the interior features and details were built by Diego himself and you can see the personal care and interesting creative flair that he's applied to the space. After our unit introduction Diego gave us many excellent recommendations on what to do in Barcelona. Unfortunately we didn't have time to get to all of the spots and we left wishing we could stay longer.
Diego is the kind of person that crosses your path that you hope to stay in touch with and reconnect with one day. The world is big and easy to feel foreign but Diego made it feel like home, if only for a little while. As you can tell Barcelona got under our skin, and in large part due to Diego and his marvelous place. By all means stay here if you get the chance.

I was urgently looking for a new place to stay for 1 night as I was staying in a hotel room, I only gave him less than 24 hours notice and requested an earlier check in. Diego was very accommodating and quick in responses. (I only started messaging him around 9pm and was requesting to check in by 1pm the following day. it all was so quick I was able to book, and have all necessary instructions within the hour.)
I arrived around 12:30 and was waiting at the restaurant next door to find out he was already in the apartment waiting to greet us.
Diego’s place is exactly as described, and is even better than what you would expect from the pictures and description. Barcelona is very touristy but Diego’s place is in a more discreet area in comparison, so it offers you a peace of mind away from the craziness.
There were so many wonderful and personal touches that made our stay fantastic. He gives many food recommendations and his flat has a lot to offer. He really tried to make us feel at home. The flat was very clean and well lit. My boyfriend and I either walked everywhere or took the train and it’s easy to navigate from the flat(just a straight line down a few blocks).
He is a great host and his flat is probably one of the top Airbnb flats I’ve stayed in, (and I travel frequently domestically & internationally) I highly recommend anyone to stay here if they’re looking to visit Barcelona. I only wish I had found his place sooner so I could stay longer and try his other recommendations!
Thanks for the great memory Diego!

I highly endorse staying at this AirBandB. Diego is a friendly, enthusiastic, helpful and gracious host who is invested in the success and quality of your stay.
The location of the apartment is excellent if you are interested in having a more authentic experience of Barcelona away from the main, overcrowded touristic neighborhoods. Whilst it is extremely convenient and easy to reach the more central quarter of the city, the benefits of being in the El Poble Sec area are distinctly apparent. For instance you are close to the Montjuic area as well as everything of interest around the Avenue de Paral-lel including Carrer de Blai and Carrer Del Parlament.
The location itself is in a lovely Placa where you will experience a mix of young, old and very young people. There are many restaurants, bars and a pharmacy in the square. The apartment is in a gorgeous ancient building and Diego has made wonderful and unique updates to modernize the space. The architectural and design details he has added and highlighted increase the enjoyment of the apartment. The kitchen is well stocked and the bathroom is pleasant, the bedroom is comfortable and the electronically activated blinds he has installed allow for complete quiet and darkness in the night.
The best touch for me was the substantial printed information he provides about local recommendations complete with maps and personal notes. I also enjoyed meeting Diego in person and his enthusiasm is contagious.
I hope to be able to return soon!!
1235805:
First the good: My husband and I found that Mireia's flat was in the best location for us. It's a few blocks from a transfer metro stop that has access to just about everything. Easy to get to the Ramblas or even Camp Nou. The flat also has great restaurants and cocktail bars just around the corner. The flat itself was a good size and had a lot of natural light. The building does have an elevator which is great since the flat is on an upper floor.
The not so good: When we arrived to the flat in the evening, we found that there was just a half roll of toilet paper in the bathroom. We searched the entire apartment, but to no avail. I messaged Mireia on the Airbnb app about where we could find some (maybe we weren't looking in the right place?) and by the next morning had to buy our own since we never received a response. This was concerning since if anything else were to go wrong, we weren't sure if we'd get a response about that either. Additionally, there is a kitchen for use, but it is missing many kitchen basics like oil, salt, pepper, etc. We also had to do some searching for dish soap and extra paper towels. We also found the apartment to be "lived-in," with many things being a little dingy.
Overall, a decent stay if you aren't looking for a place to do a lot of cooking or hotel quality living.

This apartment is authentic and in the heart of traditional Barcelona! It's a perfect location for exploring the city and is in the heart of the old town surrounded by lovely bakeries, cafes and pizzerias. Very pretty Streets surrounding the apartment and it's extremely quiet and private in the apartment. It is exactly as seen in the pictures a really quirky and fabulous flat with a lift so no need to take the huge amount of stairs. Also the air conditioning is a God send!
My only gripe with the flat is the bed it was terrible and definitely needs the mattress to be changed.
The flat is a perfect location and has great amenities close by and all you could need in the flat (no shampoos etc provided so make sure you bring your own) other than that there was everything you could need.
Also easy to reach from the airport by train or taxi (train cheaper) but we opted just for a taxi as we arrived late which was €30.
If you do stay the cafe "Panet" just around the corner served the most amazing chocolate croissant, fresh orange juice and coffee for breakfast!!
We grabbed some drinks and bought take away pizza slices from "muccis" to eat in one of the squares and that pizza was incredible!!!!
100% recommended this apartment and location!

Gracia is a great place to stay in Barcelona. It is a residential area with a smattering of design studios and other small businesses. It has a lovely square/placa which a great place to have a drink in the evening and many from the local community do just that. There is also some excellent eating options in the local area.
Mireia's place is in an old building but has a lift to the 4th floor where the apartment is located. It is a comfortable quiet retreat from the city. It is showing signs of wear and tear but is very clean and comfortable. For those like us who are stopping in Barcelona as part of a long holiday be warned that there is no washing machine in the apartment although Mireia told us there was a laundry in the nearby placa. We were also surprised that there is no soap provided in the bathroom. These extras would be expected with the price of this apartment.
Mireia was an excellent communicator and when we had issues getting into the apartment on our arrival when the lock broke she quickly sorted getting it repaired and communicated with us throughout so that we knew how long it would be until we could access the apartment. She was also very helpful in arranging our taxi on departure. We enjoyed our stay very much.
6118153:
Ático correcto, buena relación calidad precio. Ubicación no tanto. Agua caliente de la ducha dura 4 minutos
Lo único la comunicación difícil y sensación de que le estábamos haciendo un favor al rentarle el piso. Perdí mi vuelo y en vez de llegar a las 15:00 que era el check in, le avisé que iba a llegar manejando a las 17:00. Me dijo que no me tarde porque tiene cosas personales para hacer. Para no incomodarla le dije que si no llegaba a la 17:00 que nos encontrábamos más tarde. Pensé que vivía lejos y era complicado para que me venga a abrir. Para mi sorpresa vive en el mismo edificio en el ático de enfrente. Llegué 17:00 en punto. Se quejó de que le cambié los planes varias veces.
Todo medio incómodo hasta ahí pero nada grave. El viernes a las 22:10 de la noche, dos días antes de mi salida me escribe para recordarme que el domingo debo dejar el piso a ls 10 am. De muy mal gusto teniendo en cuenta que uno está de vacaciones y que sabemos leer cuándo es el check out, que dos días antes de la salida te están invitando a irte.
En resumen, el ático está correcto, pero te dan la sensación de que no eres bienvenido. Aclaro que nunca tuve ningún problema con nadie en airbnb, soy respetuoso y cuido los departamentos en los que me alojo, siempre cumplo con lo que nos piden, pueden verificarlo en mis calificaciones. Le recomiendo a Mirella que si le es muy complicado recibir a los viajeros que a veces tienen complicaciones en la llegada que ponga una caja para llaves o contrate a alguien que de un poco de margen para el check in y check out.

Mirella helped make our trip to Barcelona such a lovely experience! My family of four stayed in Barcelona over the New Year's holiday, and this was our first time renting an Airbnb. Mirella made it a wonderful! She was very responsive to all of our little questions both beforehand and during our visit, which made things a breeze. Our flight arrived in Barcelona a few hours earlier than the check-in time, and she was kind enough to let us drop off our bags so we could start exploring the city right away. The apartment is clean, equipped with plenty of amenities (the Nespresso machine was a favorite with us!), and in a great location--just a short walk away from the Alfons X station on the metro L4. We had no issues with the place. To top it off, she was kind enough to offer to make the call herself when I asked for advice on reserving a cab to take us to the airport for our departure early in the morning. If you're looking for a welcoming place to stay in Barcelona, I would highly recommend this place both for the space and for the hospitality :)

The appartment of Mirella was better than what we expected. We stayed a whole week there.
It was very cozy, there was no noise and it's fully equiped. You will find everything you need in it (towels, shampoo, clothes pin...)
Mirella was very nice (she prepared a file with a lot of informations concerning Barcelona, a map of the subway...) and conveniant, plus she lives next door so it's very practical if there is any problems.

For those who fear that the appartment is not well situated, they shouldn't worry about this.
The subway (L4 Alfons X, 10 minutes to Barceloneta where the beach is situated, 10 minutes from the famous Bogatelle Mercat, 10 miniutes to Place Catalunya where you can do shopping) is less than 5 minutes of walk from the appartment. You have a little conveniance store in front of the housing and a supermarket at the end of the road.

I fortely recommand Mirella's house for a stay in Barcelona.

Thank you Mirella :)
26883321:
Ventajas: buena ubicación. camas cómodas.
Desventajas: El departamento está en un 4 piso de un edificio viejo (muchos escalones) Tiene un pequeño elevador para dos personas lento y ruidoso.
Falta limpieza en las escaleras y ascensor.
En cuanto al proceso de llegada fuimos recibidos por la anfitriona. Sin embargo hubo un inconveniente que me gustaría comentar. Al pagarle los impuestos le pregunte si podíamos recibir algún recibo sobre el pago de los mismos. A lo que reacciono muy grosera y molesta, diciéndonos que ese dinero no se lo iba a quedar ella que no se lo iba a robar!!!! Qué??? Solo era una pregunta. En ningún momento quise molestarla. Eso nos hizo sentir muy incómodos sobre todo después de un viaje tan largo y a 5 minutos de estar en su departamento.
Aún así nos quedamos en silencio. Cuando revisó los pasaportes, le comenté que estábamos celebrando el cumpleaños de mi hijo. A lo que no contesto nada!!! En fin que tuvimos una Recepción incómoda, grosera, nada empática. Para que no le pregunten por favor!!!
Sugerencia pueden evitarse cobrar los impuestos si en el precio de la estancia ya los incluyen.

The location of this flat is simply unparalleled for those eager to explore the vibrant pulse of this remarkable city. Just a mere five-minute walk from the bus stop at Plaza España, where you’ll find a bustling shopping complex complete with groceries and other essentials.
Anna and Rafa, our gracious hosts, thoughtfully recommended a variety of nearby places to take care of the necessities—whether it be shopping, laundry, or anything in between. After immersing ourselves in the wonders of Barcelona, returning to the flat felt like a welcomed reprieve.
Montjuïc, is a short stroll away, as are numerous exceptional restaurants that offer a taste of local cuisine. No matter where our journey took us, we found ourselves conveniently within 15 to 45 minutes of our destination.. The place offers comfort and convenience but also serves as a gateway to the city. It is a place where one can truly experience the city’s charm and warmth.

Mi pareja y yo fuimos por dos días al alojamiento de Ana & Rafa. La localización es perfecta para moverse fácilmente desde allí y conocer Barcelona.
Tuvimos un contratiempo donde influyó la mala casualidad, y es que, en una semana de mucho frío, la calefacción de nuestro apartamento se había estropeado en pleno fin de semana, sin arreglo hasta el lunes. No obstante, Ana & Rafa no tardaron en ofrecernos varias soluciones, e incluso intentaron compensar lo ocurrido con una gran flexibilidad sobre el uso y horarios contratados para nuestra estancia.
El apartamento estaba surtido con todo lo necesario. Ropa de cama, toallas, papel higiénico, jabones, utensilios de cocina, sartenes, tostadora, cafetera, aceite, sal, azúcar, café, infusiones, servilletas, agua…
He sentido una estancia en casa de personas confiables. Repetiría. 100% recomendable.
3144104:
We had a fabulous holiday here. The apartment itself was lovely – spacious, light, clean and comfortable. We didn’t meet Flor, but Raul was there to meet us when we arrived and was very friendly, helpful and patient – despite us getting lost and arriving at the apartment much later than planned! The hosts communicated with us through Airbnb at first, which was a problem as I hadn’t uploaded the ap to my phone so couldn’t access the site properly. This was easily resolved though, by using WhatsApp instead.
As we were on a budget, we decided to get public transport from the airport, and metro seemed the sensible option as there is a station just outside the apartment. But it took a while to figure out how to get there from our terminal and which ticket to buy, and then we got off at Paral-lel instead of Poble Sec (totally my fault, as I got mixed up at the last minute, didn’t have the Airbnb ap on my phone and typed in the address to Google Maps, which took us to somewhere much further down the street at the Paral-lel end!). So a suggestion for Flor and Raul is that it would be really helpful to provide idiot-proof instructions on how to get from the airport to the apartment by metro, as it is so easy once you know how! The metro stops at both airport terminals, 1 and 2. We landed at Terminal 2C and the metro goes from Terminal 2A. It is a walk of 600m between the two, but there is a bus every 5 minutes which goes in a loop around the terminals. For journeys to and from the airport a special ticket called a 'bitllet aeroport' must be purchased, which costs €4.60 (this enables you to travel to/from the airport to/from anywhere on the metro system). Then just get the L9 (orange line) to Zona Universitaria and change to the L3 (green line) towards Trinitat Nova, getting off at Poble Sec, and the apartment is only a few steps from the metro entrance.
The apartment is very central - great for the metro and great for getting around on foot. It is only a ten-minute walk to Montjuïc (go left down Avinguda del Paral·lel after leaving the apartment) and around 20 minutes walk in the opposite direction to the port and Las Ramblas. A trip up to Montjuïc Castle in the cable car (as recommended by Raul) is a must, as the views over the city are spectacular! There are lots of places to eat very close to the apartment, which are open until late. For groceries, there are small supermarkets nearby and a larger organic supermarket inside the Arenas de Barcelona, a former bullring which stands in Plaça d'Espanya (after leaving the apartment turn left and follow Avinguda del Paral·lel to the end).
The apartment was not too noisy, despite being on such a busy road, and the beds were all very comfortable. The only problem we had was on the Friday night when my Mum (who slept in the room next to the bathroom), was kept awake by a TV on very loud in the next door apartment. All in all, we had a peaceful and relaxing stay and would definitely stay in this apartment again.

We have just returned after a fantastic week in Barcelona staying in this lovely spacious apartment. It is is exactly as described and the photos give a very accurate impression. It is situated in a traditional block of apartments on the chamfered corner of the building which gives all the main rooms a great outlook. It was spotlessly clean and very well equipped with everything we could have needed during our stay.

The location is fantastic, in a lovely block on Avenguda del Paral-lel. The metro station (Poble Sec) is literally twenty steps from the door, giving rapid access to the centre of the city and beyond. There are plenty of other modes of transport right on the doorstep also and for those who prefer to walk - La Rambla, Placa de Catalunya, Placa Espanya, the Gothic quarter and many other places of interest are a short interesting walk away. There are numerous lovely cafes and eating places close by, which are also much less expensive than those in the centre of the city.

Flor and Raoul are both extremely pleasant, accommodating and helpful - they answered any queries almost immediately and were a great source of information. They also offered to arrange a taxi to the airport for us on our last morning, which we were glad to accept.

One thing to be aware of, is that when the balcony doors are open it can be noisy - but then it is a busy vibrant city with lots going on in the area. It did not bother us and we enjoyed sitting watching the world go by with a glass of rioja or cava! However, when the balcony doors are closed the sound almost disappears and when the shutters and also discreet sliding patio doors on the outside of the bedroom balcony doors are used, the rooms are completely silent. We couldn't hear a thing and slept very well indeed.
I am very happy to recommend this apartment to anyone looking for somewhere to base themselves while visiting Barcelona! We will certainly stay there again :-)

Although our experience was hopefully unusual, it wasn't what we were hoping for.
Pros:
Flor's communication was also very prompt and helpful, from prior to booking, checking in, and during the stay.
The place was large, spacious, clean, and pretty well stocked (we did run out of toilet paper but fortunately there is a quick mart on the ground floor next to the entrance).
Flor and her husband met us on check-in. They were extremely polite and helpful.
Cons:
When we arrived at the apartment, we found that there was work being done on the facade of the building. This was very disappointing because we specifically chose the unit due to the large windows and little balcony looking over the city. Because of the work being done, scaffolding and nets covered the windows. Also, due to the work, the AC had been cut off. We intentionally chose a place that had AC, because we often sleep hot and wanted to make sure we'd be comfortable.
I realize the work being done was out of control of Flor and her husband, however common courtesy would have been to contact me to let us know of the disruption and give us an option to change the booking that we thought we were getting.
Although Flor and her husband were extremely kind and hospitable, I did a lot of research and traveled a long way for a specific type of experience, that ended up being very different than what I'd booked.
As long as the construction is construction is completed or you've managed your expectations of the unit, I would recommend staying with Flor. But do keep in mind that there is a significant amount of noise from the streets through the night.
I would recommend ear plugs and/or a white noise machine if you're a light sleeper.
472062:
Great location, nice apartment, but disappointing experience.
Pros: Quiet location that’s still close to the main shopping street that leads to the downtown area; Walking distance to the main attractions (Parc Guell, Sagrada Família, Old Town); Plenty of nice cafes and restaurants nearby; Modern loft-style decor; Roller shutters to block out the light in both bedrooms; Rosa was very gracious when she greeted us, despite an unfortunate delay in our arrival time.
Cons: Despite being included in the listing, shampoo was not provided (which we informed Rosa about and received a bottle of body wash, not shampoo, the following day); We were only provided with 1 full and 1 partial roll of toilet paper for 3 people on a 6-night stay (when we asked Rosa for more, we were told that was the “standard amount for our length of stay”); The hand soap in the bathroom was nearly empty from the moment we arrived (we asked Rosa to refill this, but the request was ignored); While perhaps not an issue for others, no basic condiments (oil, salt, pepper, etc) were provided in the kitchen; Upon arrival, Rosa asked us to pay a 45euro municipal tax which was not mentioned in the listing prior to booking (I believe the tax has now been mentioned in the listing for future guests, but we had to ask AirBnB to step in to resolve the discrepancy and they advised we were right not to pay).
Overall, we liked the apartment and location, but, unfortunately, the experience left a bad taste in our mouths.

I can’t say enough wonderful things about this Airbnb and the host, Rosa. The apartment itself was a 5/5 - clean, quiet, well appointed and very well situated between tourist areas and quieter streets in Gràcia with fun boutiques. But Rosa herself deserves a 10/5 for being so accommodating and thoughtful. She met us much later than planned after our flight was canceled and also took the time to get us settled and answer any Qs we had. She had a great digital guidebook we referred to many times. We also used her lovely daughter as a babysitter - my 7 year old raved about her and she came prepared with activities to do.
That’s just the beginning. The night before we left, I got food poisoning. Rosa not only let me stay later than planned in her apartment but also offered to take me to the hospital herself and checked in on me many times to make sure I was OK. It was far above and beyond what would be expected and so appreciated. A wonderful experience despite the circumstances!

Cannot recommend Rosa’s place enough! It was the perfect location and setup for our family of 4. The apartment was very clean and quiet. Beds were quite comfortable. It’s a cozy European-style apartment with all the amenities you need, including central AC, black-out shades, and even a washing machine. Checking-in and out was a breeze. Rosa was very responsive; and when she couldn’t be there herself, she made sure she had people that took care of our needs. We absolutely loved the location. We were walking distance (20-30 min) to most of the places on our list and only 2-3 short blocks from Passeig de Gràcia. And although the apartment was at a central location, it felt absolutely safe and quiet. The tapas place at the corner, La Pepita, is a hidden gem that anyone should try at least once. We loved visiting Barcelona! We still miss the wonderful people, the delicious tapas, and the eclectic architecture. Thank you Rosa for sharing your home with us!
3501634: We were absolutely thrilled with our host's immediate and thorough communication in very good English before and on our arrival in Barcelona. Xavi gave us accurate directions to the metro stop, met us there and carried our bags up to his apartment (narrow stairs but he carries bags up and back down). The apartment was as described : very quiet (with just a bit of morning street noise), with a private, comfy, sunny and quiet terrace. The place was very clean and modern, and the kitchen was stocked well with cooking basics, including wine and milk in the fridge. There are a few 'steps' or levels in the apartment and leading to the loft with no handrail, so we found that a bit tricky. The person using the loft said that it was hot with not too much airflow (an overhead fan would be useful for the summer up in the loft and in the apartment) and was maybe more suited to and a shorter person since the ceiling slopes and it was hard to stand up, and move freely to organize things. It could be tricky for a child as well due to no barrier or rail on stairs or from the loft down to the main bedroom over which the loft look (thus privacy is an issue). Xavi is putting in a handrail soon, he told me. The bathroom is also attached to this lower bedroom with cloth separators (no doors). However, Xavi went to great lengths before we arrived to provide some privacy between the bathroom and bedroom, and bathroom and hallway, which was the first indication of what a wonderful and attentive host he is. Xavi promised us a wonderful experience of his neighbourhood with easy walks to the Pedrera and Sagrada and short subway rides to the rest of town. Xavi's place is really near a variety of lively, fun squares, full of restaurants, terrasses with very few tourists. A large indoor market is not far and true Catalan culture abounds on the walking streets and squares full of people just chatting and enjoying themselves. Xavi even invited us to the small bar across the street, bought us Sangria as we watched Barcelona's football team play. We even saw Sunday afternoon Catalan dancing in the square as we stepped onto the street from the Metro stop. I fully recommend this apartment aside from the small issues indicated above. Compared to another place and host we encountered, Xavi and his apartment are exceptional with fully functioning WIFI. Gracias, Xavi!

Xavi and Luna have the most amazing loft and photos almost don't do this space the justice as it deserves. We are so glad we chose this home to stay in and prepare for our Barcelona wedding. There was more than enough space here for a hair and makeup team and hosting friends for dinner. I was easily able to get ready and navigate the space and stairs in a wedding dress. Gorgeous and made for wonderful photos while getting ready.
With the most charming terrace it is the perfect space for enjoying the perfect weather of Barcelona and the quiet of the neighborhood. Private but spacious, intimate, and modern. The entire loft carries this feel. Wide sliding doors join the terrace with a large seating area and kitchen. With the front terrace door open in the main bedroom fresh air flows through the whole space. There are beautiful exposed beams and hardwood throughout the space making the modern amenities feel like a classic home. There are a multitude of amenities to make travel easy like lots of outlets, air conditioning, laundry, dishwasher, wifi, and more ! A huge shower, closet, and bathroom! The main bedroom was so quiet even being towards the front of the building and along the road; air conditioned and comfortable.
The location couldn't have been better. Easy walks to main attractions like Sagrada Familia and Parc Guell that allowed us to take our time and really feel Barcelona. It's also a very quick walk to the Metro and if need be, easy to hail a taxi.
Xavi was so accommodating and his recommendations were invaluable. His love for this neighborhood is contagious and I'd highly recommend anyone who stay here take the time to appreciate Gracia, it's history, culture, and many plazas. Xavi went above and beyond. We were welcomed with a lovely bottle of wine, greeted at the door, assisted with bags, and he even had a car service arranged to pick us up from the airport! We had the entire building to ourselves when the kind women downstairs were not working in their seamstress shops. Less than 500m away, it was a great feeling knowing Xavi was there if we needed him.
This is a place we know we will stay again and treat as our home whenever visiting Barcelona. It will always be remembered as part of making our wedding so perfect.

My stay at Xavi & Luna's was by far the best air bnb experience I have ever had! The apartment is truly stunning - it is even more beautiful than the photos suggest. As well as this, Xavi & Luna have paid great attention to detail - so there are the most luxurious sheets and bedding and the best pillows and mattresses I have ever slept on! There is a huge shower and, of course, the softest, fluffiest towels imaginable. The large sunny terrace is amazing and includes a super comfy bed! The kitchen is fantastically well equipped and has everything you could ever need to cook a great meal. It also has a nespresso machine which was a treat. The apartment was beautifully quiet at night so a good rest is assured and it was immaculately clean - quite frankly I wish I lived there!

On top of all of this Xavi & Luna were great hosts...offering to meet me at the metro station to give me a guided tour of the neighbourhood. Xavi carried my bag up to the apartment and spent time welcoming me and explaining all I needed to know about the apartment and the neighbourhood. They also checked that everything was ok once I had been there for one night and whether I needed anything. They had left some orange juice, milk and water for me in the fridge which was very welcoming too.

I think the location of the apartment is perfect - the Gracia district is friendly, buzzing (but not noisy), interesting and in the perfect place to sight see. I walked to Sagrada Familia which took approx. 15 mins and got a taxi to Parc Guell from the apartment which cost me just 5 euros. La Pedrera is within walking distance too! I also made great use of the metro system - Joanic station (Yellow line) is literally a 3 minute walk away and will take you to Passeig de Gracia, Jaume 1 ( for the old town ) and Barcelonetta (for the beach) very quickly indeed. It is also an easy 10 minute walk to Fontana station (green line) which will take you to Placa de Catalunya in about 5 mins for a walk down Las Ramblas or to catch the airport bus.

I had such a great time in Barcelona and when I come back, I want stay here again - I really cannot imagine anywhere better to stay in the city. Thank you Xavi & Luna for everything :-)
